title: ေရႀကီးေျမၿပိဳဒဏ္ခံရတဲ့ ဟားခါး
content:
ေတာင္ၿပိဳ ရတဲ့ အေၾကာင္းရင္းဟာ မိုုးမ်ားေရႀကီးတာေၾကာင့့္ျဖစ္ႏိုုင္သလိုု ငလ်င္ဒဏ္ ေၾကာင့္လည္း ျဖစ္ႏိုုင္ပါတယ္။ခ်င္းျပည္နယ္ေနရာ အေတာ္မ်ားမ်ားဟာ ေတာင္တန္းေတြ ျဖစ္ၿပီး ဒီေဒသမွာ မိုုးႀကီးရင္ ေတာင္ၿပိဳေလ့ ရွိသလိုု ငလ်င္ငယ္ေတြ ငလ်င္လတ္ေတြကလည္း မၾကာခဏ လႈပ္ေလ့ ရွိပါတယ္။

ေတာင္ေပၚၿမိဳ႕ကေလး တၿမိဳ႕ျဖစ္တဲ့ ခ်င္းျပည္နယ္ ဟားခါးၿမိဳ႕မွာ ဒီႏွစ္ မိုုးႀကီးေျမၿပိဳမႈ ေတြေၾကာင့္ ၿမိဳ႕ေတာင္ေျပာင္းေရႊ႕ရမယ့္ အေျခေနေရာက္ေနတာပါ။

ဒီအခါမွာ ဘယ္ေနရာမ်ိဳးကိုု ေျပာင္းေရႊ႕ဖိုု႔သင့္မယ္၊ ဘယ္ေနရာက ထပ္ၿပိဳဖိုု႔ကိန္း ပိုုမ်ားေနတယ္၊ တည္ၿငိမ္မႈ ပိုုရွိႏိုုင္တဲ့ ေနရာက ဘယ္ေနရာလဲ ဆိုုတာေတြကိုု သိႏိုုင္ဖုုိ႔ ဘူမိေဗဒ ပညာ ရွင္ေတြရဲ့ အႀကံဥာဏ္ကိုု ေမ ွ်ာ္လင့္ ၾကပါတယ္။

လက္ရွိအေနအထားကိုု ဘယ္လိုု ေကာင္းေအာင္လုုပ္မယ္ ဘယ္လိုု သက္သာေအာင္လုုပ္မယ္၊ ဆိုုတာေတြအတြက္ ေသေသခ်ာခ်ာ ေလ့လာ ၿပီးမွ ဘယ္လိုုမ်ိဳး အေျခေနရွိရင္ ေတာင္ၿပိဳေျမၿပိဳတတ္တယ္၊ ဘယ္လိုုေနရာ ေတြက ေနာက္ထပ္ အနာဂါတ္မွာ ျဖစ္ႏိုုင္ေခ်ရွိတယ္၊ လတ္တေလာ ျဖစ္ေနတာေတြ ကလည္း ပိုုႀကီးထြါးလာမလား၊ ရပ္သြားမလား ဆိုုတာေတြကိုု အေသးစိတ္စဥ္းစား ရမယ္လိုု႔ ဘူမိပညာရွင္ ဦးစိုုးသူရထြန္းကေျပာပါတယ္။

ဒါ့အျပင္ အသစ္ေျပာင္းမယ့္ ေနရာအတြက္လည္း ေသေသခ်ာခ်ာ ေလ့လာ ဆန္းစစ္ဖိုု႔ လိုုၿပီး အေသးစား ေျမၿပိဳမႈေတြ ထပ္ရွိႏိုုင္တယ္ ဆိုုရင္ ဘယ္လိုု ကာကြယ္မလဲ ဆိုုတာေတြကိုုပါ ထည့္စဥ္းစားရမယ္လိုု႔ဆိုုပါတယ္။ ဒီေနရာမွာ ေက်ာက္အမ်ိဳးအစား၊ အက္ေၾကာင္း၊ ျပတ္ေရြ႕ရွိမႈေတြကိုု ထည့္သြင္းစဥ္းစားဖိုု႔လိုုသလိုု ေျမေအာက္ေရကလည္း ထိမ္းခ်ဳပ္တဲ့ အခ်က္တခုုမိုု႔ သူကလည္း အေရးပါပါတယ္။ အေပၚယံေက်ာက္ေျမေတြရဲ့ အရည္အေသြးဟာ ေျမေအာက္ေရေပၚ မူတည္ေနတာေၾကာင့္ သူ႔ကိုု ေလ့လာဖုုိ႔ လိုုတာပါ။ တကယ္လိုု႔ ျပဳျပင္ထိမ္းသိမ္းလိုု႔ ရႏိုုင္တဲ့ ေနရာမ်ိဳးျဖစ္ေနရင္ အင္ဂ်င္နီယာေတြနဲ႔ တုုိင္ပင္ၿပီး အႀကံဥာဏ္ ယူရမွာ ျဖစ္ပါတယ္။

ေျမၿပိဳမႈ တိုုင္းဟာ ရုုတ္တရက္ ထျဖစ္တတ္တာမ်ိဳး မဟုုတ္ပါဘူး။ ကနဦးအေျခေနကိုု ျပတဲ့ လက္ခဏာေတြနဲ႔ ႀကိဳၿပီး သိႏိုုင္တာေတြ ရွိပါတယ္။ အထူးသျဖင့္ ေတာင္ရဲ့ အထက္ပိုုင္းမွာ အက္ေၾကာင္းေလးေတြ စေပၚလာတတ္ပါတယ္။ ေတာင္ကပါးစြန္းနဲ႔ မလွမ္းမကမ္းမွာ ေပၚလာတတ္တာမိုု႔ ဒါေတြကိုု ရွာၾကည့္ဖိုု႔ လိုုပါတယ္။ ေတြ႔ခဲ့ရင္ လတ္တေလာျဖစ္ေစ၊ အနာဂါတ္မွာ ျဖစ္ေစၿပိဳဖိုု႔ လမ္းမ်ားပါတယ္။ တကယ္လိုု႔ လက္ရွိအေျခေနမွာပဲ ေတာင္ၿပိဳမႈေတြ ရပ္သြားၿပီး တျခားသေကၤတေတြ မေတြ႔ရဘူး ဆိုုရင္ေတာ့ အေရးတႀကီး စိုုးရိမ္ဖိုု႔ထက္ ေရရွည္ကိုု စဥ္းစားသင့္တယ္လိုု႔လည္း အႀကံေပးပါတယ္။

ျမန္မာႏိုုင္ငံဟာ ေတာင္တန္းထူထပ္တာမိုု႔ ေတာင္ၿပိဳမႈအႏ`တရာယ္ ႀကံဳႏိုုင္တဲ့ ေဒသက မ်ားပါတယ္။

အေစာပိုုင္းမွာ ေတာင္တန္းေဒသဘက္က ေျမၿပိဳမႈေတြ မ်ားေနေပမယ့္ ေနာက္ပိုုင္းမွာေတာ့ ျမစ္ဝကၽြန္းေပၚေဒသမွာ ျမစ္ေၾကာင္း ကမ္းၿပိဳ ေျမၿပိဳမႈေတြက စိုုးရိမ္ရေလာက္ေအာင္ ပိုုမ်ားလာပါတယ္။ ဒါဟာ စည္းကမ္းမဲ့ သစ္ခုုတ္မႈ၊ ကမ္းပါးၿဖိဳ ေရႊတူးေဖၚမႈနဲ႔ မဆင္မျခင္ ေသာင္တူးတာေတြက တရားခံမိုု႔ ျမစ္ေၾကာင္းထိမ္းသိမ္းေရး ကိုု စံနစ္တက် လုုပ္ေဆာင္ဖုုိ႔ လိုုအပ္ေနပါတယ္။
summary: ဒီႏွစ္မိုးရာသီ အဆက္မျပတ္ရြာတဲ့ မုတ္သုန္မိုးနဲ႔ မုန္တိုင္းေၾကာင့္ ျမန္မာႏိုင္ငံတဝွမ္း ေရႀကီးေရလွ်ံတဲ့ဒဏ္ခံရၿပီး ခ်င္းျပည္နယ္ၿမိဳ႕ေတာ္ ဟားခါးကိုေတာင္ ေျပာင္းေရႊ႕ရမလို ျဖစ္ေနတာပါ။ ဒီေရႀကီးေျမၿပိဳမႈေတြနဲ႔ ပါတ္သက္ၿပီး ျမန္မာႏိုင္ငံ ဘူမိသိပၸံအသင္းအတြင္းေရးမႈး ဦးစိုးသူရထြန္းကို ေမးျမန္းတင္ျပေပးထားပါတယ္။

title: Virginia Mabhiza: Abalezihlobo Ezabulawa yiGukurahundi Hambani Komsitheli Liyathatha AmaBirth Certificates
content:
Uhulumende kaMongameli Emmerson Mnangagwa uthi bonke abantu abafelwa yizihlobo ngesikhathi sombhuqazwe weGukurahundi sebevunyelwa ukuthatha amaphepha okuzalwa amaBirth Certificates komsitheli kungelakuthandabuza.

Lokhu kwethulwe namuhla koBulawayo nguNkosikazi Virginia Mabhiza, unobhala wohlangothi lukahulumende oluphathelane lezemithetho.

UNkosikazi Mabhiza uthe uthunywe nguMnangagwa ukuthi azekwethula umbiko lo kulandela umhlangano asanda kuwenza labamele inhlanganiso ezizimele zodwa edolobheni leli abakumbuthano obizwa ngokuthi yiMatabeleland Collective.

Ugcizelele esithi abafelwa yizihlobo sebelakho ukuthola amaphepha alabo ababhubhayo amaDeath Certificates.

UNkosikazi Mabhiza uthe sebetshele lohlangothi olunika abantu izithupha ukuthi kumele bancedise labo abalahlekelwa ngabazali lezihlobo ngesikhathi sombhuqazwe weGukurahundi ukuthi bathole amaphepha la aqakathekileyo.

Uphinde wathi abantu bakhuthazwa ukuthi bakhulume ngombhuqazwe weGukurahundi bakhululekile njalo uhulumende uzabaphathisa ukuthi bathole amaphepha okuzalwa lawalabo ababulaw ngesikhathi sombhuqazwe weGukurahundi.

Kulabantu abanengi eMatabeleland leNkabazwe abakhala ngokuthi kabanelisi ukuthola amaphepha la kulandela ukufelwa ngabazali lezihlobo ngesikhathi sombhuqazwe weGukurahundi.

Owayengumongameli uMnu. Robert Mugabe wasebenzisa ibutho leFifth Brigade ezabelweni lezi ezangingaphansi kwebandla leZapu eyayikhokhelwa ngumuyi uJoshua Nkomo owayecatshangelwa ukuthi wasekela abahlamuki ababelwisana lohulumende wakhe. UNkomo wakuphika lokhu wacina ebaleka elizweni kulandela ukuhlaselwa kwendlu yakhe koBulawayo libutho leli.

Abantu abazwe umbiko lo batshele umsakazo weStudio 7 ukuthi bayakuthakazelela lokhu loba abanye besithi kumele ukulumende avume ukuthi wabulala abantu mahlayana kusukela ngomnyaka ka1982 kusiyafika umnyaka ka1987.
summary: Lokhu kwethulwe namuhla koBulawayo nguNkosikazi Virginia Mabhiza, unobhala wohlangothi lukahulumende oluphathelane lezemithetho.

title: Hilalalala sa tsy hilalalala hoan’ny filoha Obama? Mifanontany ny Kenyana · Global Voices teny Malagasy
content:
Julie Gichuru, Kenyana mpanentana sy mpanolotra fandaharana amin'ny Fahitalavitra. Sary Creative Commons avy amin'ny World Trade Organisation (Fikambanana Iraisampirenena momba ny Varotra).

Niarahaba ny filoha Amerikana Barack Obama tonga soa tamin'ny Zaikaben'ny Fandraisan-Draharaha an-tanana Manerantany tamin'ny fihetsika miavaka i i Julie Gichuru: Nilalalalam-pifaliana izy raha nandray azy nandritra ny fitsidihany ofisialy tao Kenya.

Mahazatra ao Afrika ny milalalala (kiririokam-behivavy amin'ny lelany fahitantsika amin'ny Sakalava vavy rehefa miantsa) rehefa miarahaba am-pifaliana, misaona na manao izay itodihana. Mampiseho an'i Gichuru mihiaka ity lahatsary Youtube eto ambany nalefan'ny fandaharana Citizen TV ity:

VIDEO Nandrehitra adihevitra antserasera raha antonona ilay fotoana ny lalalala nataony na tsia. Manohana mafy azy ny sasany raha tsy izany kosa ny hafa.

Taorian'ny fandefasana ny vaovaon'ny lalalalany tao amin'ny habaka Kenya Today, niditra aterineto ny mpamaky mba haneho ny fijeriny.

Nankafizin’ i Eve ilay fihetsika :

she is an African woman. I liked it too.

Vehivavy Afrikanina izy. Tiako koa ilay izy.

Mpamaky iray tsy nitonona anarana nanontany hoe:

Whats wrong with ululating? I thnk it was a very unique way of welcoming the heads..its different from the usual official ways….sometimes its good to appreciate we are Africans and this is part of us! Stop hating!

Inona no maharatsy ny milalalala? Mino fa fomba tokana handraisana olobe izany..hafa noho ny fomba mahazatra fahita… indraindray mba tsara koa ny mankasitraka fa Afrikana isika ary ao anatintsika izany! Atsaharo ny fankahalana!

I liked it.It’s African and I dont think President Obama took offense to it.I bet he wanted to know about it’s origin and meaning.

Tiako ilay izy. Fihetsika Afrikanina izany ary tsy mino aho fa raisin'ny filoha Obama ho fanevatevana ilay izy. Sahiko ny miloka fa hitady ny niaviany sy ny dikany izy.

Wakisome nieritreritra fa ao anatin'ny kolontsaina afrikana ny zavatra nataony :

it depends on which angle you look at it. infact the African way of appreciating our kings, heroes and heroins to the podium is through ululation. it is very African and I remember her saying to do it African way. I mean what’s wrong with that? I think she right.

Miankina amin'ny zoro ijerenao azy ihany io. Ny zavanisy ny fomba afrikana hankasitrahana ny mpanjaka, ny maherifo teny amin'ny lampihazo dia tamin'ny alalan'ny lalalala. Afrikana madiorano izany ary tsaroako izy nilaza azy io ho fomba afrikana. Milaza aho hoe inona no tsy nety tamin'ilay izy? Mieritreritra aho fa nety ny nataony.

Mimi niteny fa voasasan'ny imperialista atidoha izay mitaraina amin'ilay izy :

These complainants Guchurus welcome is a direct evidence of how western cultural imperialism has brainwashed black Africans to turn against their modes of speech and communication. Keep it up Gichuru.

Ireo mimenomenona amin'ny fandraisam-bahiny nataon'i Guchurus no porofo mivantana amin'ny fanasana atidoha ny Afrikana mainty nataon'ny kolontsaina imperialista tandrefana hanoherana ireo fomba firesaka sy fomba fifandraisana fanaony. Asandrato hatrany ry Gichuru a!

Ilay lalalala no nahatonga an'i Onyango ho afa-mirehareha amin'ny vakoka Kenyana sy Afrikana ao aminy:

I liked the way Julie did it, it is unfortunate that some of us are unable to appreciate themselves to the extent that they extend their self-hatred to other people, Julie is Julie and let her be Julie and she cannot be anyone else but herself. She made me proud to be a Kenyan and an African and I appreciate our diversity.

Tiako ny fomba nanaovan'i Julie azy, mampalahelo fa misy ny sasany amitsika tsy mahay mnkasitraka ny tenany ka mamindra ny fankahalany ny tenany amin'ny olona hafa, izay no maha-julie azy ary avelao izy haneho ny maha-julie azy fa tsy afaka ny ho olon-kafa izy. Mahatonga ahy hirehareha amin'ny maha-Kenyana sy Afrikana ahy ny nataony ary ankasitrahako ny fahasamihafantsika.

Ary lasa lavidavitra kokoa i Mimi tamin'ny fanoloran-kevitra fa tokony atao ofisialy io fomba io :

Julie give us more and more of this! Actually, why not make it the official Kenyan welcome style!

Manome zavatra ho antsika hatrany i Julie! Fa maninona moa raha mba ampidirina ho fomba fandraisam-bahiny kenyana amin'ny fomba ofisialy izy io!

Raha miresaka momba ireo mitsikera an'i Gichuru dia nampitandrina i Justus Atuti :

I thought Gichuru did so well and her did was so African, a reflection of who we are as a people. With this level of hatred, Kenya is as good as dead. 2017 is a dangerous year for us all.

Nieritreritra aho fa nataon'i Gichuru tsara tokoa ilay izy ary tena Afrikana tokoa, mitaratra ny hoe iza isika amin'ny maha-vahoaka iray antsika. Amin'izao ambaratongam-pankahalana izao, dia tsara amin'i Kenya ny maty. Taona mampididoza ho antsika rehetra ny 2017.

Saingy, mpamaky iray no nanandratra fa manimba fahasalamana ny milalalala amin'ny micro :

Why must we hide behind culture and tribalism when avoiding correction?Then why do we go to school? Journalists have their ways of doing things and 2 wrap it all,it is health hazard to spat on mike in the name of ululation,just for your good ears to listen. African ululate a lot but this time round,my sister Julie,it was a little bit bad so next time try and change on it. Let’s avoid ths political mood,it has cost Auma to reign where it’s known well as your domain and actually,she won. Wish u better next time my sister Julie.

Fa maninona isika no tsy maintsy miafina ambadiky ny kolontsaina sy ny foko rehefa te-hiala fanitsiana? Ka inona no andehanantsika any an-tsekoly? Manana ny fomba fanaovan-javatra ny mpanao gazety sy ny fomba hamonosany azy, manimba fahasalamana ny miady amin'ny fanamafisam-peo amin'ny fanaovana lalalala, mba handrenesan'ny sofinao azy tsara. Milalalala im-betsaka ny Afrikana saingy tamin'ity indray mitoraka ity ry ranabaviko Julie, tahaka ny tsy dia nety loatra ka amin'ny manaraka miezaha ary ovay ilay izy. Andao ovaina io toe-po ara-politika io fa io no nahatonga an'i Auma hanjaka amin'ny toerana fantatra fa kianjanao ary ny zavanisy dia nandresy izy. Mirary soa anao ho tsara kokoa ranabavy Julie.

Utamaduni nieritreritra fa tsy matihanina ilay izy:

Its all got to with journalists putting aside professionalism to pander to the whims of politicians and its rampant in this country.

Vita ny mpanao gazety mametraka eo anilany ny mahamatihanina azy hiforetana amin'ny sitrapon'ny mpanao gazety sy ny fandadizany amin'ity firenena ity.
summary: Fahita mahazatra ao amin'ny kolontsaina afrikana ny fahaiza-milalalala. Lasa tsy matihanina ve ny Kenyana mpanentana sy mpanolotra fandeharana amin'ny fahitalavitra iray raha nilalalala tamin'ny fandraisana an'i Obama?

title: အေမရိကန္ေရြးေကာက္ပြဲ ႐ုရွား ဝင္ေရာက္ စြက္ဖက္ဖို႔ ရည္ရြယ္ခ်က္မရွိ
content:
ရုရွားတို႔ အေနနဲ႔ အေမရိကန္ ေရြးေကာက္ပြဲကို စြက္ဖက္ဖို႔ ရည္ရြယ္ခ်က္ မရွိဘူးလို႔ ရုရွားသမၼတနန္းေတာ္ သမၼတရဲ႕ ေျပာခြင့္ရ Dmitry Peskov က အေမရိကန္ မဲဆႏၵရွင္ေတြကို အသိေပးခ်က္ ထုတ္တဲ႔ အထဲမွာ ေျပာဆိုထားပါတယ္။ အေမရိကန္ သမၼတ ေရြးေကာက္ပြဲ မဲဆြယ္စည္းရံုးမႈ ေနာက္ဆံုးနာရီပိုင္းကို ခ်ဥ္းကပ္လာခ်ိန္မွာ ရုရွားဘက္က အခုလို ထုတ္ျပန္တာ ျဖစ္ပါတယ္။

ရုရွား အစိုးရက အေမရိကန္ ဒီမိုကရက္ ပါတီရဲ႕ ကြန္ပ်ဴတာေတြကို ေဖာက္ထြင္းပါတယ္လို႔ အေမရိကန္ အစိုးရရဲ႕ စြပ္စြဲခ်က္ကိုလည္း စိတ္ထဲ မထားပါဘူးလို႔ ဆိုၿပီး ဟီလာရီ ကလင္တန္ရဲ႕ ေရြးေကာက္ပြဲ မဲဆြယ္စည္းရံုးေရး အဖြဲ႔ရဲ႕ အီးေမလ္းေတြကို ၀ီကီလိခ္က ဖြင့္ခ်လိုက္တဲ႔ ကိစၥအေပၚမွာ အေမရိကန္ ေထာက္လွမ္းေရးေတြက ရုရွား လ်ိဳ႕၀ွက္ေထာက္လွမ္းေရး အဖြဲ႔ေတြထံက ဒီအခ်က္အလက္ေတြ ရရွိခဲ႔တာလို႔ စြပ္စြဲထားတဲ႔ အေပၚမွာလည္း ရုရွား အေနနဲ႔ အေရးမထားဘူး၊ ရုရွား ႏုိင္ငံပိုင္ သတင္းမီဒီယာကေန အေမရိကန္ သမၼတေလာင္းေတြထဲမွာ တဦးကို ဦးစားေပး စည္းရံုးမႈေတြကို ျပည္တြင္း ျပည္ပ ေတာက္ေလွ်ာက္ လုပ္ေနတယ္ဆိုတဲ႔ ေျပာဆိုခ်က္ကိုလည္း အေလးမထားဘူးလို႔ ေၾကညာခ်က္မွာ ေဖာ္ျပပါတယ္။

ရုရွားဘက္က ၀င္ေရာက္ စြက္ဖက္မႈ မရွိဘဲနဲ႔ကို အေမရိကန္ဟာ ကိုယ့္ျပသနာနဲ႔ကိုယ္ ရႈပ္ေနတာ ျဖစ္တယ္လို႔လည္း ရုရွား သမၼတနန္းေတာ္ သမၼတရဲ႕ ေျပာခြင့္ရ မစၥတာ Peskov က ေျပာပါတယ္။

အေမရိကန္ သမၼတ ေရြးေကာက္ပြဲမွာ ဘယ္သူဘဲ အႏုိင္ရသည္ ျဖစ္ေစ အေမရိကန္ ဒီမိ္ုကေရစီရဲ႕ ပ်က္ဆီးမႈေတြ အက်င့္ပ်က္ခ်စားမႈေတြကို ေရြးေကာက္ပြဲ ရလဒ္က သက္ေသျပမွာ ျဖစ္တယ္။ ဒီအတြက္ ရုရွား အစိုးရက ျပင္ဆင္ထားတယ္လို႔လည္း ေဖာ္ျပထားပါတယ္။
summary: ရုရွားတို႔ အေနနဲ႔ အေမရိကန္ ေရြးေကာက္ပြဲကို စြက္ဖက္ဖို႔ ရည္ရြယ္ခ်က္ မရွိဘူးလို႔ ရုရွားသမၼတနန္းေတာ္ သမၼတရဲ႕ ေျပာခြင့္ရ Dmitry Peskov က အေမရိကန္ မဲဆႏၵရွင္ေတြကို အသိေပးခ်က္ ထုတ္တဲ႔ အထဲမွာ ေျပာဆိုထားပါတယ္။

title: UZamcolo Uqhubeka Esidla Ubhedu Elizweni
content:
Umsakazo we ZBC lamuhla ubike ukuthi abantu abedlula amakhulu ayisikhombisa babanjwe ngamandla ukubalekela imizi eChipinge le Sabi kulandela ukugcwala komfula uSave.

Lokhu kwenzakala ngoba kusina izulu likazamcolo elizweni.

UNkosikazi Esther Okwanga isiphathamandla se Southern African Zone for the International Federation of Red Cross-and Red Crescent Societies utshele istudio 7 ukuthi sebaziswe ukuthi uzamcolo lo uselubhekise eTsholotsho njalo inhlanganiso yakhe imelele ukuncedisa abazathinteka ngalesisehlakalo.

USithandekile Mhlanga uxoxe lengcwethi kwezomkhathi UMnu Mandla Nkomo ukuze sizwe ukuthi okubangela ozamcolo laba elizweni kuvele kuyini.

Ezinye indaba ze studio 7…

title: Sezizinengi Izizalwane zeZimbabwe Ezingasadli Inyama
content:
Ngesikhathi uncwaningo kwezempilakahle seluveza ukuthi kulemikhuhlane eminengi engabangelwa yikudla inyama, inani labantu asebekhetha ukungadli inyama lalo lilokhu lisanda.

Ukwanda kwabantu emhlabeni ikakhulu emadolobheni lapho okungelazifuyo khona sekwenze kwanda ubunengi benyama efunakalayo.

Ingcitshi zezifundo zescience sezenze ukudla lemithi eyenza inyamazana okutholakala kuzo linyama zikhule ngesivuvu esikhulu ukuze inyama ingasileli.

Abezempilakahle bathi lokhu sekwengezile imikhuhlane efana leyenhliziyo lemvukuzane isikhathi esinengi ebangelwa yikudla inyama.

Isizalwane seZimbabwe uNkosazana Sehlule Moyo, uthi ngenxa yalesi sizatho, sekuleminyaka eyekele ukudla inyama.

“Ngiyabenefitha ke ngokuba yi vegetarian ngoba angibanjwa yimikhuhlane eminingi esiyithola kulezizinto esiyithola ngokudla okunama animal products ... Ngoba izinyamazana ezinengi zihlatshwa amajekiseni, zilemikhuhlane and sisuka sithathe imikhuhlane le siyifake emizimbeni yethu obekungafanelanga ukuthi ngabe siyayithola limikhuhlane, then sesizithola silale mikhuhlane.”

Ngomnyaka ka1980 kusiya ku 1986, ingcitshi kwezescience eHarvard University, zikhokhelwa ng Dr. Frank Hu, owesikolo se Harvard School of Public Health, ziqhube ucwaningo lokubona ukuthi kambe inyama ilomthelela onganani kumpilakahle yabantu.

Abantu ababekulolucwaningo babesedlula izinkulungwane ezilikhulu (120,000) kanti futhi babesidla inyama ngokwesilinganiso esehlukileyo. Ekuqaleni kwalolucwaningo bahlolwa kwatholakala ukuthi abalazifo zenhliziyo loba esemvukuzane.

Kusiyaphela lolucwaningo kwasekufe abedlula inkulungwane ezingamatshumi amabili (24,000). Kuleli nani kwatholakala ukuthi ababesidla inyama kakhulu abedlula izinkulungwane ezihlanu (5,900) babulawa yizifo zenhliziyo kwathi abaphose bafike izinkulungwane ezilitshumi (9,500) babulawa ngumkhuhlane wemvukuzane.

Omunye wabeZimbabwe abangadli inyama, ngenxa yocwaningo olufana lalolu uNkosikazi Ntandoyenkosi Moyo, uthi kunengi ukudla kwemvelo abakudlayo ukuze kuthathe indawo yenyama abangasayidliyo.

“Ukuba yivegetarian akutsho ukuthi umuntu akalanto yokudla. Silamagwadla, silombila, silengqoloyi, silama beans, abo ma lentils lendumba ama sugar beans. Ama vegetables akhona futhi for ama enzymes. So konke kukhona. Okubalulekileyo yikuthi njengomuntu ubekwazi ukuthi umzimba wakho udingani, udinge yonke into eyakha umzimba.”

Ngomnyaka ka2013 kuvele ukuthi enyameni okwenziwa ngazo amaburger kweleSouth Africa abazenzayo bebehlanganisa lenyama yabobabhemi lengulube kodwa bekufihla ukuthi lezo nyama zikhona phakathi. Ngomnyaka ophelileyo eZimbabwe indaba ebisegudwini ngeyomunye usomabhizimusi obephakathi kokuvula ibhutsha yabobabhemi okuthiwa yinyama ezathengiselwa kuphela amazwe empumalanga.

Kodwa-ke abanengi bathi sekungenzeka linyama icine isingena emabhutsha eZimbabwe ngudlu badliswe obabhemi mfihlo.

Lobake kunjalo, inengi lezizalwane zeZimbabwe lithi akusonto elula ukwekela ukudla inyama. Isizalwane seZimbabwe uMnu. Nkosana Ncube uthi yena kusukela ekhula akwaziyo yikuthi ezitshebeni zonke okutshetshwa ngazo inyama yiyo umaqhuzu.

“Inyama ngendlela engiyithanda ngakhona! Ngiyezwa sibili bathi kule zifo ezifana labo gout lezinyenje izifo ezehlukene, kodwa inyama akusinto engingahlukana layo. Ma sengiyicabanganje etshisiwe, ngiyicabanga ngalo lonke uhlobo lwenyama nje lama spice nani nani, akusinto elula ukuthi ngingahlukana nayo inyama. Ngiyikhonzile sibili kakhulu.”

Abezezempilakahleke bona bakhuthaza labo abadla inyama ukuthi bangayidli okwedlulise amalawulo ngoba lokho yikho okungabenza babanjwe yimikhuhlane. Labo abangasayidliyo bakhuthazwa ukuqakathekisa ukudla okuzathatha indawo yenyama okufana lendumba, amakhowa, amazambane, amagwili lokunye ukudla okwakha umzimba.
summary: ​​Omunye wabeZimbabwe abangadli inyama, ngenxa yocwaningo olufana lalolu uNkosikazi Ntandoyenkosi Moyo, uthi kunengi ukudla kwemvelo abakudlayo ukuze kuthathe indawo yenyama abangasayidliyo.

title: Nahazo ny Twitter ny Fetiben’ny biriky Lego 2019 tany Japana · Global Voices teny Malagasy
content:
Sarivongana kely Lego. Sarin'i Nevin Thompson.

Natao tao Kobe tamin'ny 8 Jona sy 9 Jona 2019 ny Japan Brickfest 2019, lanonana tontosaina ao amin'ny firenena ahitana mpiondana lalao Lego be indrindra. Mpakafy Lego maherin'ny 270 no nampiseho ny famoronany, ary olona an'arivony nanatrika ny Brickfest nandritra ny faran'ny herinandro no nizara sary tao amin'ny Twitter tamin'ny fampiasana ny tenirohy #JBF2019.

I went and took some photos.

Nandeha tany aho naka sary maromaro.

Tsy fantatro tsara hoe iza no nanao azy, fa tena mahafinaritra. Tena mahafinaritra ny fampiasana ny lamasinina haingam-pandeha Lego amin'ny fomba toy izao.

Tanàna madinidinika naseho tao amin'ny JBF 2019. Tamin'ny fampiasana sary avy amin'ny zanabolana, naverina noforonina tamin'ny alàlan'ny taratasy fananganana Lego 16X16 ny zava-drehetra .

Nanontany tena aho hoe inona no tao anatin'ilay valizy. Nosokafako ilay izy, ary izao no hitako tao. Tena mety tsara ho an'ny fitondrana Lego!

Miha-lehibe sy mivoatra hatrany isan-taona ireo sarivongana kely lego ireo !

Nokarakarain'ny sekoly tsy miankina ao Kobe Canadian Academy sy ny KLUG (ny vondrona mampiasa Lego Kansai) isan-taona nanomboka hatramin'ny taona 2016 , lanonana hanaovam-panasoavana ny Japan Brickfest, izay hanomezana ny ampahany amin'ny vola azo amin'ireo anton-javatra mendrika hanaovana izany marobe.

Jereo ny famoronana Lego maro mahagaga ao Kobe ao amin'ny tenirohy Twitter #JBF2019.
summary: Mpakafy Lego maherin'ny 270 no nampiseho ny famoronany, ary olona an'arivony izay nanatrika ny Brickfest nandritra ny faran'ny herinandro no nizara sary tao amin'ny Twitter tamin'ny fampiasana ny tenirohy #JBF2019.

title: I Save Zimbabwe Campaign Ithi U Mongameli Thabo Mbeki Kumele Alalele Izikhalazo Zika Zulu We Zimbabwe
content:
Umanyano wabezinkonzo, amabandla ezombusazwe lenhlanganiso ezizimeleyo owe Save Zimbabwe Campaign uqoqa ugwalo oluzakwethulelwa u Mongameli Thabo Mbeki wele South Africa kunsuku ezimbalwa ezilandelayo. Injongo yomanyano lo ngeyokuthi u Mbeki avume ukuthi udaba lwe Zimbabwe alusoze lulungisiswe ngamabandla e MDC le ZANU PF kuphela kodwa uzulu wonke we Zimbabwe kumele aphatheke kunkulumo azazenza lamabandla la.

U Pastor Ray Motsi isiphathamandla se Christian Alliance ebumba umanyano we Save Zimbabwe Campaign uchasisela i Studio 7 ukuthi kungani uzulu we Zimbabwe kumele atsho laye akufisa kwenziwe elizweni.
summary: Hatshi ukukhangela amabandla aphikisayo awe MDC le ZANU PF kuphela emizameni yokulungisisa okuhluphayo elizweni.

title: I-ZEC Yengezelela Amalanga Okubhalisela Ukuvota
content:
Iqula lamalunga edale lephalamende asuka kumabandla ehlukeneyo, kanye lamalunga alamabandla asezabelweni ezilitshumi zelizwe abaphiwa usekelo lwemali yiSwiss Embassy ngemizamo yokuguqula imithetho yokhetho ahlangene izolo esigodlweni lenhlanganiso yeZimbabwe Electoral Commission bavumelana ukuthi amalanga okubhalisela ukuvota engezelelwe ngamaviki ayisithupha.

Ekhuluma loMsakazo weStudio 7 ngoMgqibelo lamhlanje ngemva komhlangano wamabandla ezombangazwe obuhlafuna ukuqhubeka kohlelo lweBVR, uPolitical Liason Officer kubandla leMDC-T, uNkosikazi Nomvula Mnguni uveze ukuthi amalanga ohlelo lokubhalisela ukuvota azakwengezelelwa ngamaviki ayisithupha. Isiqinti esisodwa sizaphiwa amalanga ayisikhombisa.

Elinye ilunga ledale lephalamende uDokotela Ruth Labode uthe lesisinqumo bayasamukela ngezandla zombili njalo bazafinqa amalogwe baphume ngobunengi bayekhankasela ukuthi abantu beMaNdebeleni bayebhalisela ukuvota ngoba inani labantu asebebhalisile liphansi kakhulu uma liqathaniswa lezinye izigaba zelizwe.

UMabhalane wabasakhulayo kubandla leMDC, uMnunzna Discent Bhajila uthe abatsha labadala bayethuselwa njalo kunengi okubi okwenzakalayo okungabenqabela ukuba bayebhalisa ukuvota.

Isikhulumeli sebandla leZAPU, uMnunzna Iphithule Maphosa uthe bayasamukela isinqumo sokwengeza amalanga okubhalisela ukuvota eBVR, ngoba kuzakuba lithuba elihle kuzizalwane Zezimbabwe ezisuka kwamanye amazwe.

Uhlelo lokubhalisa ukuvota belukhangelelwe ukuphela kuviki ezayo NgoLwesibili njalo kwezinye indawo zelizwe ababhalisela ukuvota basebedlule kwasekulandela abathathisa izithupha, obesekubangele ukuthi behluleke ukubhalisa.

Ezigabeni zeMatabeleland, inengi labantu liyehluleka ukuvota ngoba ingwalo zabo zokuzalwa lezithupha kwatshabalala ngesikhathi sombhuqazwe weGukurahundi njalo kunzima ukuthi bazithole lezo ncwadi ukuze benelise ukuvota.
summary: Inhlanganiso yeZEC amabandla, aphikisayo, kanye lenhlangnaiso ezizimeleyo bavumelene ukuthi amalanga okubhalisela ukuvota engezelelwe ngamaviki ayisithupha.

title: Sifuna Inkulumo Zigqitshwe Ngempelaviki - MDC
content:
Icele leMDC elikhokhelwa nguMnu Morgan Tsvangirai lithi lifuna inkulumo zokulungisisa okuhluphayo kuhulumene womanyano zigqitshwe ngempelaviki.

Ekhuluma lentathelizindaba eHarare, isikhulumeli salelibandla uMnu Nelson Chamisa uthe abamabandla womathathu akuhulumende womanyano kumele ehloniphe isivumelwano seGlobal Political Agreement, kubika intathelizindaba yethu uThomas Chiripasi.

Kunjalo nje, imbiko esiyamukeleyo iveza ukuthi inkulumo phakathi kweZanu PF leMDC zizaqala ngesonto hatshi ngoMgqibelo njengobekuhleliwe. Abakhokheli bamazwe eSadc abahlangane ngoLwesine eMozambique bakhuthaze iZanu PF le MDC ukuthi zigcwalise isivumelwano seGPA.

Umlamulankunzi kudaba lweZimbabwe uMongameli Jacob Zuma ngoLwesihlanu ukhuthaze iMDC ukuthi iyekethise kudaba lukaMnu Gideon Gono loMnu Johannes Tomana esithi lokhu yiko okubangela ukuthi inkulumo zingagqitshwa ngesiphangiphani.

Ingcwethi ecubungula ezombusazwe uMnu Qhubani Moyo utshele uNtungamili Nkomo weStudio 7 ukuthi amabandla akuhulumende kumele eyiqakathekise inkuthazo yeSadc.
summary: Abakhokheli bamazwe eSadc abahlangane eMozambique ngoLwesine bathe bafuna amabandla akuhulumende elondoloze isivumelwano seGPA

title: ACE ကုမၸဏီက ဖမ္းမိလက္နက္မ်ား ျမ၀တီမွ ၀င္ေရာက္
content:
ေနျပည္ေတာ္အျပည္ျပည္ဆိုင္ရာေလဆိပ္မွာ ဖမ္းဆီးရမိတဲ့ တရားမ၀င္လက္နက္ေတြဟာ ျမ၀တီလမ္းေၾကာင္းကေန၀င္လာတဲ့ လက္နက္ေတြလို႔ ကနဦးစစ္ေဆးခ်က္အရသိရၿပီး ထြက္ေျပးလြတ္ေျမာက္ေနတဲ့ တရားခံ ၂ ဦးကို ဖမ္းမိရင္ေတာ့ ကြင္းဆက္ေတြထပ္ေပၚႏိုင္တယ္လို႔ တာ၀န္ရွိသူေတြကေျပာပါတယ္။ အျပည့္အစံုကိုေတာ့ ဗြီအိုေအျမန္မာပိုင္း သတင္းေထာက္ ကိုထက္ေအာင္ခန္႔က သတင္းေပးပို႔ထားပါတယ္။

ေနျပည္ေတာ္ အျပည္ျပည္ဆိုင္ရာေလဆိပ္မွာ ေအာက္တုိဘာ ၁၅ ရက္ညပိုင္းက အရင္ျပည္ေထာင္စု၀န္ႀကီးေဟာင္း ဦးတင့္ဆန္းရဲ႕သားျဖစ္သူ ၿဖိဳးကိုကိုတင့္ဆန္းဆီကေန တရားမ၀င္လက္နက္နဲ႔မူးယစ္ေဆး၀ါးေတြကို ဖမ္းဆီးရမိခဲ့တာျဖစ္ပါတယ္။ ကနဦးစစ္ေဆးခ်က္ေတြအရ အခုလိုဖမ္းဆီးရမိတဲ့လက္နက္ေတြဟာ ျမ၀တီဘက္က ၀င္လာတဲ့လက္နက္ေတြလို႔သိရၿပီး ဆက္လက္စစ္ေဆးမႈေတြျပဳလုပ္ ေဆာင္ရြက္လ်က္ရွိၿပီးေတာ့ ထပ္တိုးဖမ္းမိတာမရွိေသးဘူးလို႔ ေနျပည္ေတာ္ရဲတပ္ဖြဲ႕မွဴး ရဲမွဴးေဇာ္ခင္ေအာင္က VOA ကိုေျပာပါတယ္။

“အင္းဟုတ္တယ္။ အၾကမ္းဖ်င္းေတာ့အဲ့လိုသိရတယ္။ ျမ၀တီတဖက္ႏိုင္ငံေနၿပီးေတာ့သြင္းတာေပါ့ေနာ္။ သြင္းတယ္ဆိုတာဒီလို အလံုးလိုက္ႀကီးသြင္းလာ တာေတာ့မဟုတ္ဘူး။ ဟိုတလက္စႏွစ္လက္စေန တေျဖးေျဖးကိုင္ရင္းကိုင္ရင္းနဲ႔မ်ားသြားတာေပ့ါ။ လုပ္ေနတယ္သူတို႔ကိုစစ္ေနတယ္။ တခ်ိဳ႕ကမေျပာဘူး တို႔ကလည္းတခ်ိဳ႕ဟာ ဟိုဘက္ေထာက္စစ္ဒီဘက္ေထာက္စစ္ရင္းနဲ႔ အခုအဲ့လိုေပါ့ ေပၚလာတာေပါ့ေနာ္။ သူ႔ဟိုတယ္ကစ၀င္စစ္တယ္။ ၀င္စစ္တဲ့အခါမွာ ၇ လက္မိတယ္။ အဲ့ဒါမွာကုန္ၿပီလို႔ေျပာတယ္။အဲ့အေပၚမွာမူတည္ၿပီးေတာ့မွ သူ႔ဆီမွာရွိတဲ့စာရြက္စာတမ္းအေထာက္အထားနဲ႔ ျပန္ၿပီးေထာက္ၿပီးျပန္စစ္လိုက္ တဲ့အခါၾကေတာ့ ထပ္ေပၚလာျပန္တယ္။ အဲ့လိုမ်ိဳးေပါ့အခုေတာ့တေျဖးေျဖးေျဖးေထာက္စစ္ေနတာေပါ့။ ေနာက္ဆက္တိုးတာေတာ့ ထပ္ရွာေတြ႕တာေတာ့ မရွိေသးဘူး။”

ဒီကေန႔အထိ လူ ၁၂ ေယာက္ လက္နက္ ၂၁ လက္ အထိ ဖမ္းဆီးရမိစစ္ေဆးထားၿပီး ၿဖိဳးကိုကိုတင့္ဆန္းနဲ႔ ပတ္သက္ ဆက္သြယ္သူ တရားခံ ၂ ဦးမွာ ထြက္ေျပးလြတ္ေျမာက္ေနၿပီး ဖမ္းဆီးရမိပါက ကြင္းဆက္ေတြေပၚလာႏိုင္တယ္လို႔ ရဲမွဴးေဇာ္ခင္ေအာင္က ဆက္ေျပာပါတယ္။

“ေနာက္ ၂ ေယာက္လြတ္ေနတာရွိတယ္။ ၂ ေယာက္လြတ္ေနတာ အဲ့ ၂ေယာက္ကိုရရင္ ေနာက္ထပ္ ထပ္ေပၚလာႏိုင္တဲ့အလားအလာေတြရွိတယ္ေနာ္။ ဖမ္းဆီးရမိမႈ သူရဲ႕တပည့္တပန္းေတြထဲ ဖမ္းဆီးရမိဖို႔ ၂ ေယာက္ရွိေသးတယ္။ အဲ့၂ေယာက္လိုအပ္ေသးတယ္။ အဲ့ ၂ ေယာက္ကိုရရင္ ကြင္းဆက္ႀကီး တခုလံုးက ျပည့္စံုၿပီးေပၚလာလိမ့္မယ္။”

ျပည္ထဲေရးဒု၀န္ႀကီး ဗိုလ္ခ်ဳပ္ေအာင္စိုးက က်န္ရွိတဲ့လက္နက္နဲ႔ ကြင္းဆက္ေတြကိုဖမ္းဆီးသိမ္းဆည္းရမိဖို႔က ဦးစားေပးေဆာင္ရြက္ေနၿပီး တည္ဆဲဥပေဒ ေတြအေပၚခ်ိဳးေဖာက္တဲ့လုပ္ငန္းစဥ္ေတြအားလံုးကို ေဖာ္ထုတ္ၿပီးေဆာင္ရြက္သြားမယ္လို႔ မေန႔ကေနျပည္ေတာ္မွာ သတင္းေထာက္ေတြကို ေျပာၾကားခဲ့ပါတယ္။

ေနျပည္ေတာ္အျပည္ျပည္ဆိုင္ရာေလဆိပ္မွာ လက္နက္နဲ႔မူးယစ္ေဆး၀ါးေတြဖမ္းဆီးရမိတဲ့အတြက္ ၿဖိဳးကိုကိုတင့္ဆန္းနဲ႔အေပါင္းအပါ ၂ ဦးကို ေနျပည္ေတာ္ ေအလာနယ္ေျမရဲစခန္းက မူးယစ္ပုဒ္မ လက္နက္ပုဒ္မေတြနဲ႔အမႈဖြင့္ေဆာင္ရြက္ထားခဲ့ပါတယ္။ အစပထမပိုင္းဖမ္းဆီးရမိခ်ိန္မွာေတာ့ လက္နက္ပုဒ္မ ၁၉ (စ) နဲ႔ဖြင့္လွစ္ထားရာမွ လက္နက္ေတြထပ္မံေတြ႕ရွိတဲ့အတြက္ လက္နက္ဥပေဒပုဒ္မ ၁၉(က) နဲ႔ေျပာင္းလဲဖြင့္လွစ္ခဲ့ပါတယ္။

ေနျပည္ေတာ္ အျပည္ျပည္ဆိုင္ရာ ေလဆိပ္္မွာ ေအာက္တိုဘာ ၁၅ ရက္ေန႔က တရားမ၀င္လက္နက္ငယ္နဲ႔ မူးယစ္ေဆး၀ါးေတြကို ဖမ္းဆီးရမိတာနဲ႔ ဆက္စပ္ၿပီး၊ ရန္ကုန္နဲ႔ ေနျပည္ေတာ္မွာရိွတဲ့ ၿဖိဳးကိုကိုတင့္ဆန္းပိုင္ ACE ရံုးေတြ ဟိုတယ္ေတြကို ၀င္ေရာက္စစ္ေဆးရွာေဖြရာကေန ေနာက္ထပ္ တရားမ၀င္လက္နက္ေတြနဲ႔ မူးယစ္ေဆး၀ါးေတြ ဖမ္းဆီးရမိတာပါ။ ၿဖိးကိုကိုတင့္ဆန္းဟာ ACE လုပ္ငန္းစု အႀကီးအကဲတဦးျဖစ္သလို၊ ၂၀၁၂ ခုႏွစ္က ဧရာ၀တီတိုင္းေဒသႀကီး ေျမာင္ျမၿမိဳ႕နယ္ လႊတ္ေတာ္ကိုုယ္စားလွယ္အျဖစ္ ျပည္ခိုင္ၿဖိဳးပါတီကေန ၀င္ေရာက္ယွဥ္ၿပိဳင္ခဲ့သူလည္းျဖစ္ပါတယ္။
summary: ေနျပည္ေတာ္အျပည္ျပည္ဆိုင္ရာေလဆိပ္မွာ ဖမ္းဆီးရမိတဲ့ တရားမ၀င္လက္နက္ေတြဟာ ျမ၀တီလမ္းေၾကာင္းကေန၀င္လာတဲ့ လက္နက္ေတြလို႔ ကနဦးစစ္ေဆးခ်က္အရသိရၿပီး ထြက္ေျပးလြတ္ေျမာက္ေနတဲ့ တရားခံ ၂ ဦးကို ဖမ္းမိရင္ေတာ့ ကြင္းဆက္ေတြထပ္ေပၚႏိုင္တယ္လို႔ တာ၀န္ရွိသူေတြကေျပာပါတယ္။

title: Isilinganiso Esikhulu Sabaphila Lesimo Sokungaboni Emehlweni Sibikwa Silakho Ukulungiseka
content:
Ngesikhathi ingcwethi zezempilakahle, zihlolisisa okumayelana lamehlo lomthambo osekela ukubona owe Retina, odokotela bathi kuqakathekile ukuba abantu bazi ukuthi inengi lalabo abacina befika esibangeni sokungaboni babengakwenqabelavimba ukuthi lokhu kwenzakale kumbe batholelwe indlela zokubatholisa uncedo lokwelatshwa ngokuhlinzwa kumbe bathole amangilazi.

“I Retina ngumthambo otholakala phakathi kwelihlo ngangemuva ophathisa ilihlo ukuba libone ukukhanya liphinde lenze ukuthi ubuqopho bubone yonke into. Ukuphazamiseka kwayo kungaba ngenxa yokuzalwa I retina ingamanga kuhle kumbe ukuhlaselwa yisifo esifana leDiabetes okwenza icine ingasebenzi kuhle."

U Dokotela Tawanda Mhute oyincitshi kwezamehlo, eyiOphalmologist uthi abantu kumele bananzelele ukuba phakathi kwabangamabillion edlula amabili-2,2 billion abangaboni kuhle emehlweni, emhlabeni jikelele abayibiza ngokuthi, yiVision Impairment, ingxenye yabo yayingabe yenelise ukwenqabela lesisimo kumbe ukusilungisisa. “Ku Congenital ozalwa ulayo lapha lalaphaya silendlela ezokulungisisa ngayo loludubo noma kungalula okufana le gene therapy lama operation owokufaka ama electrical signals aya ku brain etshiya eceleni I retina ngokwayo kube sokusiza umuntu ukuba ebone kakuhle”.

Indlela yesibili uthi umuntu uyithola hatshi ngokuzalwa kodwa ngezinye indlela ezikhanya sezisisanda hatshi emazweni athuthukileyo kuphela kodwa lalawo asathuthukayo anjengeZimbabwe, ngenxa yendlela esesiphila ngayo kulezinsuku.

Kodwa noma kunjalo, uthi abantu kabaqakathekise ukudinga usizo lokwelatshwa olugoqela imitshina yakulezi nsuku efana lesetshenziswa ngabaphila ngokungezwa kuhle endlebeni ama Hearing Aid aphathisa emehlweni ukuze umuntu aphile kangcono abona laye. “Omunye umuntu angabe edinga ama glasses nje kuphela ukuze ebone kuhle, omunye njalo engabe ele cataract eyabe ifuna I operation encane nje kulunge ngoba abantu abanje abale vision impairement elungisekayo befika ku half yabantu bonke abangafika ku 2.2 billion abale visio impairement emhlabeni jikelele.”

Inhlanganiso ezimela abantu abakhubazeke kokungaboni bathi inkinga enkulu yibuyanga okubangela abanengi bengafinyeleli indlela ezinje ezikhona ngoba lomumo womnotho eZimbabwe ungamuhle abantu beziphilele benjalo bengaboni beqakathekisa impilo kuphela.

Unkosikazi Lindiwe Sibanda okhubazekileyo emehlweni uthi nxa umuntu esengasaboni kudala enye inkinga iba ngeyokuzinakekela becine bebanjwa ngamandla ukuphila ngokuthengithengisa lokucela uncedo. “Umuntu ongaboniyo ulobunzima sibili.Khathesi sibili kunzima kakhulu lokuthi noma ucela emgwaqweni ungamthola ngitsho lomuntu ongakunika yona nje indibilitshi so inkinga zangakhona ziba zinengi.”

Umqondisi wenhlanganiso ye Zimbabwe Council for the Blind uthi baquba kanzima kubangelwa yimumo womnotho oselizweni okubenza bengenelisi ukwethekelela abantu abalenkinga ezinje emaphandleni ngokusilela kwamafutha, imitshina lemithi edingakalayo loncedo lwabongi abangayophathisa ethi noma kunjalo uhulumende uyazama ngakucele lakhe. “Uhulumende sisebenza laye sibili. Uzama ngazo zonke izindlela. Uyasincedisa number 1 ukuthi sifike ebantwini futhi laye efaka imithi angabe eikwanisa kodwa udubo lolu lukhulu kulalokho akwenelisayo ngomumo esikiwo okwamanje.” Idolobho lako Bulawayo lodwa libikwa lilabantu abakhubazeke emehlweni abedlula inkulungwane ezimbili. Uhulumende obikwa ethi isikhwama sakhe sandelwa ngemisebenzi amele ayenze kubangelwa yikoma, I cyclone Idai,lezijeziso zenotho, usebenzelana lenhlanganiso ezizimeleyo kulumsebenzi kugoqela labathiwa ngama partners kwezempilakahle afana labo world health organization , Unicef lezinye inhlanganiso ezilwisana lokungaboni zizimele.

Kuma billion edlula ayisikhombisa-7,3 billion yabantu emhlabeni jikelele abangamabillion edlula amabili babo-2,2 billion ngabantu abangaboni kuhle abale Vision Impairement, engalungiseka ngemitshina yangalezi nsuku, kuthi I billion ephezu kweyodwa 1,1 billion yabo bengabantu ababengenelisa ukuvimba ukufika kulesi simo kumbe ukusilungisisa.
summary: Ingccwethi ezibona ngezempilakahle yamehlo zithi isilinganiso esikhulu salabo abacina sebengasaboni silakho ukuba sasingalungiseka nxa abantu bethe badinge usizo ngokuphangisa isimo singakabi sibi ngamandla.

title: တရုတ္ ဒုေထာက္လွမ္းေရးအႀကီးအကဲေဟာင္း ေထာင္ဒဏ္တသက္ ခ်ခံရ
content:
တရုတ္အစိုးရ ဒုတိယ ေထာက္လွန္းေရးအႀကီးအကဲေဟာင္း Ma Jian ကို အဂတိလိုက္စားမႈနဲ႔ ၾကာသပေတးေန႔က ေထာင္ဒဏ္ တသက္ျပစ္ဒဏ္ ခ်မွတ္ခဲ့ပါတယ္။

Ma ဟာ လာဘ္ေငြရယူမႈနဲ႔ စီးပြါးေရးကုမၸဏီေတြရဲ့ စေတာ့အေရာင္းအဝယ္မသမာမႈ အပါအဝင္ ရာဇဝတ္ျပစ္မႈေတြ က်ဴးလြန္ခဲ့တာ ေတြ႔ရေၾကာင္း တရုတ္ႏုိင္ငံ အေရွ႕ေျမာက္ပိုင္း Dalian ဆိပ္ကမ္းၿမိဳ႕ တရားရံုးက ေျပာပါတယ္။ တရုတ္ ႏိုင္ငံေတာ္ လံုၿခံဳေရးဗ်ဴရိုမွာ ဒုတိယဝန္ႀကီးတာဝန္ ထမ္းေဆာင္ခဲ့သူ Ma ကို ဒဏ္ေငြအျဖစ္ ယြမ္- သန္း ၅၀ (အေမရိကန္ေဒၚလာ ၇.၂၆ သန္း) က်ခံေစဖုိ႔လည္း အမိန္႔ခ်ထားပါတယ္။

Ma ဟာ သူ႔ႏိုင္ငံေရးအာဏာကို အသံုးခ်ၿပီး တရုတ္အာဏာပိုင္ေတြ အလိုရွိေနတဲ့ အိမ္ၿခံေျမဘီလ်ံနာသူေဌးႀကီး Guo Wengui ရဲ့ စီးပြါးေရးလုပ္ငန္းေတြကို ပံ့ပိုးကူညီခဲ့တယ္ လို႔လည္း တရားရံုးေၾကညာခ်က္ထဲမွာ ေဖၚျပထားပါတယ္။ နယူးေရာက္မွာ အေျခစိုက္ေနထုိင္တဲ့ သူေဌးႀကီး Guo က လက္ရွိတရုတ္ကြန္ျမဴနစ္ပါတီ အႀကီးတန္းအရာရွိႀကီးေတြ လါဒ္စားေၾကာင္း စြပ္စြဲထားတဲ့ ဗီဒီယို္ေခြေတြ ကြန္ျပဴတာ အြန္လိုင္းမွာ တင္ခဲ့တာပါ။

ပုဂၢလိက လုပ္ငန္းရွင္ေတြကို သူတို႔ရဲ့ အစုရွယ္ယာေတြ Guo ကုိ လႊဲေပးဖုိ႔ ဖိအားေပး ၿခိမ္းေျခာက္စာေတြကို Ma က ႏိုင္ငံေတာ္ လံုၿခံဳေရးဗ်ဴရိုကေန ေပးပို႔ခဲ့တဲ့ေနာက္မွာ Guo ဟာ ႏို္င္ငံရဲ့ ေငြစုလက္မွတ္ ကုမၸဏီကို ထိန္းခ်ဳပ္သြားႏုိင္ခဲ့ပါတယ္။ ဒါ့အျပင္ အဲ့ဒီကုမၸဏီရဲ့ အတြင္းေရးေတြကို သူက ေပါက္ၾကားေစၿပီး ဒီကုမၸဏီရဲ့အစုရွယ္ယာေတြကို Ma ရဲ့ ေဆြမ်ိဳးေတြက ေနာက္ပိုင္းမွာ ဝယ္လိုက္တာေၾကာင့္ အက်ိဳးအျမတ္ရခဲ့မႈနဲ႔ သူ႔မွာအျပစ္ရွိတဲ့အတြက္ ဒဏ္ေငြအျဖစ္ ယြမ္ေပါင္း ၄၉ သန္းေက်ာ္ကိုပါ ဒဏ္ေဆာင္ခဲ့ရတာပါ။

အဂတိလုိက္စားမႈ တုိက္ဖ်က္ေရး လုပ္မယ္လုိ႔ ေၾကြးေက်ာ္ၿပီး ၂၀၁၂ မွာ တက္လာတဲ့ သမၼတ Xi Jinping လက္ထက္မွာ Ma ဟာ အဂတိလုိက္စားမႈနဲ႔ ေနာက္ဆံုး အေရးယူခံရတဲ့ အရာရွိႀကီးတဦးျဖစ္ပါတယ္။ ဒါေပမယ့္ Guo အပါအဝင္ ေဝဖန္သံုးသပ္သူေတြကေတာ့ သမၼတ Xi ဟာ ဒီနည္းနဲ႔ သူ႔ႏိုင္ငံေရးၿပိဳင္ဘက္ေတြကို ေျခမႈန္းေနတယ္လို႔ စြပ္စြဲၾကပါတယ္။
summary: တရုတ္အစိုးရ ဒုတိယ ေထာက္လွန္းေရးအႀကီးအကဲေဟာင္း Ma Jian ကို အဂတိလိုက္စားမႈနဲ႔ ၾကာသပေတးေန႔က ေထာင္ဒဏ္ တသက္ျပစ္ဒဏ္ ခ်မွတ္ခဲ့ပါတယ္။

title: Usomabhizimusi Unika Abesifazane Izembatho Zokudlala Ibhola
content:
Usomabhizimusi, uMnu. David Moyo, olamankampani edolobheni lako Bulawayo lasedolobheni leGwanda, usephathise iqembu le Street Set ngempahla egoqela amakawuso awokugqoka nxa lidlala ibhola.

UMoyo uthi amantombazana kawatholi usekelo olwaneleyo njengabafana yikho ekubone kufanele ukuba aphathise iqembu le Street Set.

“Abantwana abangamankazana isikhathi esinengi balesifiso esokudlala ibhora kodwa akulabantu ababasekelayo. Yikho ke sahlala phansi le management sakubona kufanele ukuba sincede abantwana abangamankazana sathenga ikit sabanika saphinda sabathengela njalo lama pads umntwana ngamunye samupha ama set angamatshumi amabili.”

Iqembu le Street Set elabunjwa yintathelizindaba uLee Mangena, lidlala kusigaba se Southern Region Women’s Football League njalo lisebenzisa inkundla ye Sizinda. UMoyo olezitolo ezithengisa ukudla lezigayo edolobheni lako Bulawayo lase Gwanda, useqhatshe amanye amankazana adlalela iqembu le Street Set ukuze bengacini beyekela ukudlala ibhola njengoba bengatholi iholo ngokudlala ibhola.

“Umntwana wesilisa angathi uyadlala ezemidlalo abantu baphanga bamphathise okwedlula umntwana owesifazane yikho thina sikubone ukuthi kasiphathise abantwana abangamankazana labo bephumelele emidlalweni abangabe befisa ukuyenza nxa kusenza befike phetsheya kolwandle.”

Inkampani ye Falgen Enterprise ithengele iqembu le Street Set ama unifomu amabili njalo eyinye yakhona ngebomvu elombala olithanga kuthi eyinye yakhona ngemnyama elombala omhlophe. Iphinde yabathengela njalo lamabhola.

title: UMnangagwa Ukhangelelwe Ukuhlangana Lezizalwane zeZimbabwe eNew York
content:
UMongameli Emmerson Mnangagwa okhonapha eMelika emhlanganweni weUnited Nations General Assembly (UNGA), eNew York, ukhangelelwe ukuhlangana lezizalwane zeZimbabwe ezihlala kuleli ngeSonto ukuze ezwe imbono yazo ngendlela okungathuthukiswa ngayo umnotho weZimbabwe.

UMnangagwa ukhangelelwe ukuphatheka kweminye imihlangano yeUNGA, kanye lokwethula umbiko wakhe welizwe leZimbabwe ngeviki ezayo. Ukhangelelwe njalo ukuxoxisana lenkokheli kanye labosomabhizimusi bakwamanye amazwe, ngendlela yokubahuga ukuthi besebenzelane leleZimbabwe ekuthuthukiseni umnotho welizwe.

UMnangagwa ukhatshwe yiziphathamandla zikahulumende ezigoqela umphathintambo wezemali, uMnu. Mthuli Ncube, usibalukhulu webhanga le Reserve, uMnu. John Mangudya, labanye.

Osaphende isikhundla sakhe eZimbabwe ngomunye wabasekeli bakamongameli uMnu. Kembo Mohadi.

Ukuzwa okunengi ngomhlangano wezizalwane zeZimbabwe lomongameli Mnangagwa sixoxe loMnu. Den Moyo, isiphathamandla seMDC-T khonapha eMelika.

UMnu. Moyo uthi umbuthano lo ungaphumelela, uzakuba ngowakuqala lomongameli weZimbabwe eMelika, njengoba owayephethe lesi isikhundla uMnu. Robert Mugabe wayengafuni ukuhlangana labo.

Kodwa amalunga ebandla leMDC abikwa esithi azatshengisela esola uMnu. Mnangagwa, ngesizatho sokuthi bakholwa ukuthi umkhokheli wabo uMnu. Nelson Chamisa nguye owanqobayo kukhetho lokudinga umongameli.

title: Kufa Abangamatshumi Ayisithupha Ekudutshulweni Kwabantu Mahlayana eMelika
content:
Uzulu weleMelika usosizini olukhulu kulandela ukufa kwabantu abangamatshumi phose ayisithupha abadutshulwe ngowesilisa omhlophe edolobheni leLas Vegas eNevada ngeSonto ebusuku.

Abantu laba bebesegigini lomhlabeleli wengoma zeCountry, uJason Aldean.

NgoMvulo emini amapholisa athe ebesefumene izidumbu ezingamatshumi amahlanu lasitshiyagalombili (58) njalo athe kulabantu abalimeleyo abedlula amakhulu amahlanu.

Athe njalo inani labafi lilakho ukuqansa.

Asenelisanga ukuthola imbiko yokuthi zikhona na izizalwane zeZimbabwe ezingaba zifele kulesi sehlakalo kumbe zilimele.

UMongameli weleMelika uMnu. Donald Trump kanye lamalunga edale lephalamende bethule amazwi endunduzo basola kakhulu isehlakalo lesi.

Isizalwane seZimbabe esihlala eMelika, uMnu. Den Moyo, ongumgcinisihlalo njalo weMDC-T laye ukusolile kakhulu lokhu.

Amapholisa igama likamsolwa nguSteven Paddock njalo athi utholakale efile ehoteleni yezitezi adubule abantu laba ekiyo.

Lokhu ngokwakuqala eMelika ukuthi kufe abantu abanengi kangaka kusehlakalo sokudutshulwa kwabantu, imass shooting ngesingisi.

Ukudutshulwa kwabantu mahlayana kuyinsakavukela umchilo wezidwaba eMelika ngoba kulula kakhulu ukuthenga umbobho.

title: Iqembu leCaps United Lehluleka Ukunqoba eleBulawayo City
content:
Iqembu le Bulawayo City libe ngutshiki lobhanqa lele CAPS United emdlalweni weCastle Lager Premier Soccer League odlalelwe enkundleni yeHartsfield ngoLwesithathu.

Iqembu leBulawayo City yilo eliqale ukuhlohla ngehlandla lakuqala elomdlalo njalo lihlohlelwe nguIshmael Wadi kwathi iqembu leCAPS United lona lilinganise ngomzuzu wakuqala owehlandla lesibili njalo lihlohlelwe ngu John Zhuwawo.

Ekhuluma lentatheli ekupheleni komdlalo umqeqetshi weqembu leBulawayo City, uMandla Mpofu, uveze intokozo ngokuthola kwabo umklomelo owodwa kulumdlalo.

“Ngokubona kwami umdlalo uhambe kuhle njengoba ngavela ngatsho phakathi kweviki ukuba iqembu esidlala lalo akusilo iqembu elincane elilula, ukuze sithole yonke imiklomelo emithathu bekumele sisebenze gadalala. Sisebenzile gadalala njalo wonalowo owodwa umklomelo esiwutholileyo ungcono ngoba sesisiya emaphethelweni eligi njalo sekusiba nzima, okokuthi nxa udobha kungcono yikho ke ngithabe kakhulu ngomklomelo esiwutholileyo.”

Iqembu leBulawayo City linqobe ele ZPC Kariba nge 3 ka 2 emdlalweni olandelwe ngowanamhla njalo ngempelansonto lizadlala lele Black Rhinos esigodlweni.

Umsekeli kamqeqetshi weqembu le CAPS United uMark Mathe laye uthi benze kuhle kakhulu ngokuthola umklomelo owodwa.

“Umdlalo lo siwudlale kuhle njalo ubungumdlalo ongekho lula kodwa sibona ukuthi ngendlela ebesiqoqe ngayo sense kuhle lanxa uphele ungutshiki lobhanqa. Asisoli ngoba kasidliwanga njalo besisuka ekunqotshweni liqembu leDynamos yikho kuzamele sibuyele esigodlweni silungiselela umdlalo weBantu Rovers ongekho lula.”

Iqembu leCAPS United lizaphenduka njalo ko Bulawayo ukuzodlala lele Bantu Rovers emdlalweni walo olandelayo.

Kusenjalo, imidlalo iyaqhubekela phambili kusasa lapho iqembu leHwange elizadlala khona lele Bantu Rovers enkundleni ye Colliery.
summary: Ekhuluma lentatheli ekupheleni komdlalo umqeqetshi weqembu leBulawayo City, uMandla Mpofu, uveze intokozo ngokuthola kwabo umklomelo owodwa kulumdlalo.

title: ထိုင္း၀န္ႀကီးခ်ဳပ္ေဟာင္း Yingluck မ်က္ကြယ္ေထာင္ဒဏ္ ၅ႏွစ္ ခ်မွတ္ခံရ
content:
စပါး ၀ယ္ယူမႈ အစီအစဥ္ကို ကိုင္တြယ္ေဆာင္ရြက္တာမွာ ညံ႔ဖ်င္းခဲ႔တာနဲ႔ ဆက္စပ္ၿပီး ေပါ့ေပါ့ဆဆ ေဆာင္ရြက္မႈ စြဲဆိုခ်က္နဲ႔ ရာထူးက ဖယ္ရွားခံရတဲ႔ ထိုင္း၀န္ႀကီးခ်ဳပ္ေဟာင္း Yingluck Shinawatra ကို မ်က္ကြယ္ေထာင္ဒဏ္ ၅ ႏွစ္ စီရင္ခ်က္ ခ်မွတ္လုိက္ပါတယ္။

ကနဦး ၾကားနာမႈေတြမွာ ၀န္ႀကီးခ်ဳပ္ေဟာင္း Yingluck တလၾကာ ပ်က္ကြက္ခဲ႔ၿပီးေနာက္မွာ ထိုင္း တရားရံုးခ်ဳပ္က စီရင္ခ်က္ကို ဒီကေန႔ ဗုဒၶဟူးေန႔မွာ ထုတ္ျပန္လိုက္တာ ျဖစ္ပါတယ္။ အကိုျဖစ္သူ ၀န္ႀကီးခ်ဳပ္ေဟာင္း Thaksin Shinawatra ရွိရာ ဒူဘိုင္းကို ၀န္ႀကီးခ်ဳပ္ေဟာင္း ယင္းလတ္ ထြက္ေျပးသြားတာလို႔လည္း ယံုၾကည္ထားၾကတာပါ။

၀န္ႀကီးခ်ဳပ္တာ၀န္ယူစဥ္ ကာလအတြင္း ေဆာင္ရြက္ခဲ႔တဲ႔ ေဒၚလာ ေထာင္ခ်ီ ကုန္က်တဲ႔ စပါး၀ယ္ယူေရး အစီအစဥ္ကို ကိုင္တြယ္ေဆာင္ရြက္မႈ မွားယြင္းခဲ႔တယ္ ဆိုၿပီး မစၥ ယင္းလတ္ စြပ္စြဲခံခဲ႔ရတာပါ။ ဒီအစီအစဥ္ အရ ခ်ိဳ႕တဲ႔တဲ႔ လယ္သမားေတြဆီကေန စပါးကို ေစ်းကြက္ေပါက္ေစ်းထက္ ေစ်းပိုေပးၿပီး အစိုးရက ၀ယ္ယူၿပီးေနာက္မွာ ေစ်းတင္ၿပီး ျပန္ေရာင္းတာ ျဖစ္ပါတယ္။

ဒါေပမယ့္ စပါး၀ယ္ယူေရး အစီအစဥ္က မွန္းထားသလို ျဖစ္မလာဘဲ ေဒၚလာ သန္း ၁ ေထာင္ေက်ာ္ ဆံုးရံႈး၊ ေနာက္ မေရာင္းရဘဲ ေလွာင္ထားရဲ႕ ဆန္လက္က်န္ ပမာဏကလည္း အမ်ားႀကီး ရွိေနခဲ႔တာပါ။ ၀န္ႀကီးခ်ဳပ္ေဟာင္း ယင္းလတ္ကေတာ့ စြဲခ်က္ကို ျငင္းဆိုၿပီး ဒါက ႏုိင္ငံေရး ရည္ရြယ္ခ်က္နဲ႔ ေဆာင္ရြက္တာလို႔လည္း တုံ႔ျပန္ေျပာဆိုထားတာပါ။

title: Bayakhala Abanye Abafuna Ukungena Kuzifundo Zabongi
content:
Abadinga ukufundela ukuba ngabongi bebebuzisiswa ngoLwesine ngabogatsha lwezempilakahle esibhedlela seUnited Bulawayo Hospitals koBulawayo kodwa abanye abenelisanga ukufinyelela esigabeni sokubuzisiswa ngoba bebengela ncwadi ezeneleyo ebezifuneka.

Abangaphumelelanga bacelwe ukuba babhalele ugatsha lwezempilakahle besazisa izizatho ezibavimbe ukufinyelela isigaba lesi sokubuzisiswa.

Omunye wabangaphumelelanga ukungena kulesi sigaba nguNkosazana Percy Maseko othi bamukelwe kuhle kodwa inkinga ibekuye ngoba ubengela ncwadi yempumela yezifundo zeOrdinary Level.

“Mina ngikhethe ukuthi ngihambe ngelanga lokuqala ekufikeni kwethu basamukele kuhle kakhulu bakhuluma lathi kuhle basebecela ukubona ama certificate. Mina inkinga ebekhona yikuthi amacertificate bengilawo kodwa eyeMaths bengingelayo ngoba ngiyibhale ngoJune last year ngakho icertificate besingakaphumi basebengazisa ukuthi iresult slip ayifunakali lakho ku advert kwakubhaliwe kuthi no result slip kodwa mina ngihambe ngilethemba ukuthi bazavuma ngoba icertificate asikaphumi. Basebesibhalisa izingcwadi ukuthi sibhale ukuthi asisa interview ngoba besilama result slip.”

Osakhulayo njalo ongumqondisi wenhlanganiso yabaphila ngokuthengisa eyeBulawayo Vendors Association uMnu. Mike Ndiweni, uthi bazama ngamandla wonke ukuthi bancede labo abasebuzimeni lobu.

Kodwa kulabanye abathi benze kahle ngesikhathi bebuzisiswa yiziphathamandla zikahulumende.

Omunye wabafundi uNkosiphile Dliwayo ofinyelele isigaba sokubuzisiswa uthi konke kuhambe kahle.

“Kuma interviews bekumnandi kakhulu sihlangane labo bakhuluma lathi kuhle. Into akade bezifuna basitshelile njalo okade kushota basitshelile. Basitshela futhi okumele sikulungisise ngaphi langaphi, kodwa hayi ama interviews ahambe kahle bekungekho nzima.”

UMnu. Prince Ncube uthi konke kuhambe kahle laloba kungayisikho akade ekukhangelele ubethi kuzaba nzima kakhulu.

Abazaphumelela bazangena ezifundweni lezi lonyaka.
summary: Omunye wabangaphumelelanga ukungena kulesi sigaba nguNkosazana Percy Maseko othi bamukelwe kuhle kodwa inkinga ibekuye ngoba ubengela ncwadi yempumela yezifundo zeOrdinary Level.

title: Ayaphithizela Amalunga eZanu PF Ngaphambilini KwamaPrimaries
content:
Amalunga eZanu PF ayaphithizela elizweni lonke edinga usekelo kubalandeli balelibandla ngaphambilini kokhetho lwama-primaries oluzakwenziwa ngeSonto.

Ukhetho lolu ngolokudinga abazamela lelibandla kukhetho lwamakhansila lamalunga edale lephalamande oluzakwenziwa yiloba nini phakathi kukaNtulikazi 21, kusiya ku 21 Ncwabakazi.

Omunye wabazancintisa edinga ukuba ngumeli weBulilima West ephalamende nguMnu Dingumuzi Phuti.

UMnu Phuti uzangqikilana loMnu Lungisani Nleya onguye umeli walesisigaba okwamanje.

UPhuti utshele umsakazo weStudio 7 ukuthi ngolwazi kanye lobuciko aselabo ngendaba zombusazwe lezinye nje inhlangothi zempilo, nguye olungele ukuba ngumeli weBulilima West.

Uthi zinengi inhlelo zentuthuko azaziletha kulesisigaba ezigoqela ukulungisa imigwaqo, ukwakha izibhedlela lokuthuthukisa ezivele zikhona.

UPhuti uthi uzakwenza lokhu ngokusebenzelana lenhlanganiso eziphathisa ngezimali zentuthuko kanye labatshali bezimali.

title: Lokhe Likhokhela Iqembu leChicken Inn
content:
Lilokhu lihlezi phezu kwengalane iqembu le Chicken Inn loba nje linqotshwe ngele Yadah ngoMgqibelo odluleyo.

Iqembu le Chicken Inn linqotshwe nge 2 ka 1 liqembu le Yadah ngoMgqibelo okuyimpumela ebingakhangelelwanga ngabanengi abalandela umdlalo wenguqu njengoba abafana beGamecocks bebetshaya eziwayo phambilini kokudibana leqembu le Yadah lona elingelinye lamaqembu aqhuba nzima lonyaka.

Loba kunjalo iqembu le Chicken Inn lale lilokhu lihlezi phezu kwengalane yemiklomelo lilemiklomelo engamatshumi amahlanu lanye njengoba lelo ebelilethuba lokulihwitha ele Dynamos libe ngutshiki lobhanqa 1 ka 1 lele Highlanders ngeSonto.

Ukwehluleka ukuthola imiklomelo emithathu kweqembu le Dynamos kudale ukuba lehle liyehlala endaweni yesithathu engalaneni lilemiklomelo engamatshumi amane lathoba munwe munye kuthi iqembu le FC Platinum yilo eselihlezi endaweni yesibili lilemiklomelo elingene leye Chicken Inn ngemva kokunqoba ele How Mine nge 1 ka nya ngoMgqibelo.

Kundawo yesine kuleqembu le Ngezi Platinum Stars lona elinqobe ele Harare City nge 2 ka 1 ngoLwesihlanu njalo elilingene leye Dynamos.

Emsileni wengalane ikhuba liyala lilokhu litshona kuqembu le Bantu Rovers lona elinqotshwe nge 3 ka 1 ngele CAPS United okuyimpumela etsho ukuba liyale lilokhu lijeke amanye amaqembu engalaneni lilemiklomelo elitshumi lambili ikanti phezu kwalo iqembu le Tsholotsho lilemiklomelo elitshumi lesithupha njalo libe ngutshiki lobhanqa leqembu le ZPC Kariba ngoMgqibelo.

Umqeqetshi njalo engumnikazi weqembu le Bantu Rovers uMethembe Ndlovu uthi yena yebo kambe ukunqoba kuyala kuqembu lakhe kodwa okuqakathekileyo kibo yikuba abafana babo befunde ibhola.

“Badlalile abafana kwehlule yebo imiklomelo kasiyitholanga kodwa ngibona angathi sizamile kakhulu yikuthi nje besidlala leqembu eliqinileyo. Inhlanhla esilayo yikuthi asifani lamaqembu amanengi esikwenzayo yikuthi sizama ukuba sibengcono ngemihla ngemihla asikhangeli kakhulu impumela loba sinqotshiwe sikhangela ukuba yikuyini esikufundileyo. Labafana bethu sihlezi sibatshela ukuba bengazikhathazi kakhulu ngempumela bona babe lendaba lokufunda ibhola.”

Kolunye udaba olumayelana lomdlalo wenguqu umncintiswano we Cosafa Women’s Championships ukhangelelwe ukuqala ngoLwesithathu edolobheni lako Bulawayo njalo uzadlalelwa enkundleni ezibalisa eye Barbourfields kanye leye Luveve.

Iqembu le Zimbabwe likusibaya sika Group A ndawonye le Zambia, Madagascar kanye le Malawi. Kusibaya sika Group B kuleqembu le Kenya, ele Mauritius, Swaziland kanye lele Mozambique.

Iqembu le South Africa likusibaya sika Group C ndawonye lele Namibia, ele Lesotho kanye lele Botswana.

Abaqali besiziba liqembu le Namibia lele Botswana wona azadibana kugamanxa ihola letshumi ekuseni kulandele umdlalo ozakuba phakathi kweqembu le Zambia lele Malawi ngehola lesibili emini kuthi iqembu le Zimbabwe lizangqikilana lele Madagascar kugamanxa ihola lesine emini yantambama.

Yonke limidlalo izaqhutshelwa enkundleni yeBarbourfields kuthi ngoLwesine imidlalo izadlalelwa enkundleni yeLuveve lapho iqembu le Mauritius elizadlala khona lele Swaziland, ele Kenya lizadibana lele Mozambique kuthi ele South Africa lizadlala lele Lesotho.
summary: Iqembu le Chicken Inn linqotshwe nge 2 ka 1 liqembu le Yadah ngoMgqibelo okuyimpumela ebingakhangelelwanga ngabanengi abalandela umdlalo wenguqu.

title: Ngelanga Lakhe Lokuzalwa, uMugabe Uthi Usaqinile
content:
UMongameli Robert Mugabe ufikise iminyaka yokuzalwa engamatshumi ayithoba minwemibili lathoba minwemibili-88, ngoLwesibili esithi uzimisele ukuqhubeka esembusweni lanxa bekhona abathi sokumele atshiye umsebenzi ngoba seluphele.

Kungxoxo ayenze lomsakazo weZBC, uMugabe uthe ingamanga imbiko yokuthi impilakahle yakhe ayimanga kuhle. Uthe uziphilele njalo uqine okumangalisayo. Uthakazelele lelilanga lemmuli yakhe.

Abasekeli bebandla lakhe bazakuba lomkhosi omkhulu eMutare ngoMgqibelo. UMugabe uthe okunye okwenza impilakahle yakhe ihlale ikahle yikuthi nsuku zonke uvuka eselula lokuqinisa umzimba wakhe okwehola elilodwa.

Kulembiko ethi ulomkhuhlane wemvukuzane ehlasela abesilisa, iprostate cancer. Kodwa uMugabe uyakulandula lokhu.

Esipha inkuthazo kwabatsha ukuthi baphile okweminyaka eminengi, uthe akumelanga banathe kakhulu, kanti lokubhema igwayi kumele batshiyane lakho. Wengeze wathi abantu kumele baziphathe ukuze kwenqatshelwe umkhuhlane wengculaza.

Isikhulumeli seZanu PF uMnu Rugare Gumbo uthi bamtshayela ihlombe uMugabe. Umqondisi weNational Youth Development Trust uMnu Liberty Bhebhe uthe uMugabe sokumele atshiye umsebenzi.
summary: UMongameli Mugabe uthi imbiko yokuba kaphilanga kuhle ingamanga, njalo uthi uzaqhubeka esembusweni lanxa seluphele

title: Ama Warriors Alubhekisa kwele Kenya
content:
Iqembu lenguqu elimela iliwe elamaWarriors lisuka kusasa lilubhekise eKenya lapho elikhangelelwe ukuhlasela njengesilo libhaxabule eleKenya emdlalweni wokudinga amaqembu azaphatheka kunkezo yeWorld Cup le Afcon Cup ngo 2010.

Lumdlalo uzadlalelwa enkundleni ye Nyayo eNairobi ngoMgqibelo. Amaqembu womabili angena kulumdlalo eqaphise imisila ngemva kokunqoba kwawo emidlalweni esanda kwedlula.

Elekenya linqobe eleGuinea nge 2 ka 0 ngoMgqibelo kwathi eleZimbabwe labhuqa eleNamibia ngemiklomelo efanayo ngeSonto. I Zimbabwe ikusibaya sinye leNamibia, Kenya le Guinea njalo iZimbabwe yiyo ekhokhelayo.

Umqondisi wama Warriors u Ernest Mapepa Sibanda utshele uNtungamili Nkomo weStudio 7 ukuthi laloba iqembu le Kenya belihlonipha bakhangelele ukuliwisa ngophondo.
summary: Iqembu lenguqu elimela iliwe lisukuma kusasa lilubhekise eKenya lilanda umdlalo wangoMgqibelo

title: I Zimbabwe Iqinisa Ubudlelwano LeSouth Africa
content:
EleZimbabwe ngolweSihlanu lilobelane phansi isivumelwano leleSouth Africa, esijonge ukuthuthukisa ubudlelwano kwezamabhizimusi phakathi kwamazwe womabili.

Umphathintambo obona ngenhlelo eziphathelane lokuthuthikiswa komnotho eZimbabwe, uMnu Elton Mangoma nguye olobelane phansi isivumelwano lesi loMnu Rob Davis obemele iSouth Africa, emkhosini oqhutshelwe eHarare.

Isivumelwano lesi sibizwa ngokuthi yi Bilateral Investment Promotion and Protection (Bippa) ngesingisi.

Ekhuluma emkhosini lo, uMangoma uthe uhulumende weZimbabwe uzimisele ukudlelana lamazwe atshiyeneyo. Ukhuthaze njalo abavela kwamanye amazwe ukuthi baze eZimbabwe ngobunengi bazevula amabhizimusi.

Isivumelwano phakathi kwamazwe womabili lesi sikubeka sobala ukuthi eleSouth Africa kumele lihloniphe amabhizimusi ezizalwane zeZimbabwe kanti njalo eleZimbabwe lalo kumele lihloniphe amabhizimusi ezizalwane zeSouth Africa.

Kodwa kulokwesabela ukuthi uhulumende weZimbabwe ulakho ukuhluthuna amabhizimusi ezizalwane zeSouth Africa kungelani lalesi sivumelwano ngoba elembali yokungahloniphi izivumelwano azenza lamanye amazwe.

Kulabalimi beSouth Africa abanengi abathathelwe amapulazi abo nguhulumende kaMongameli Mugabe eminyakeni edluleyo laloba bekulesivumelwano phakathi kwamazwe womabili ebesivikela abalimi laba.

Ingcwethi ecubungula ezombusazwe, uMnu Rejoyce Ngwenya utshele uNtungamili Nkomo weStudio 7 ukuthi kaboni uhulumende weZimbabwe ehlonipha isivumelwano seBippa lesi.
summary: Amazwe womabili alobelane phansi isivumelwano ngolweSihlanu esijonge ukuthuthukisa ubudlelwano kwezamabhizimusi phakathi kwawo

title: Uqhubekela Phambili Umhlangano weUS-Africa Leaders Summit
content:
Uqhubekela phambili umhlangano omkhulu wenkokheli yezwekazi leAfrica loMongameli Barack Obama weMelika owethule umbiko wokuthi osomabhizimusi beMelika sebebeke amabillion adlula itshumi lane lamadollar – $14 billion yokwenza okutshiyeneyo eAfrica.

UMongameli Obama uthe imali le ngeyokwakha okutshiyeneyo okunjengemigwaqo, ukulungisa umlilo kagetsi, ukuvuselela imisebenzi yamabhanga lokuthuthukisa ezobulembu beInternet.

UObama uthe kukhangelelwe ukuthi eleMelika lidlelane ngamandla lamazwe wezwekazi leAfrica.

Uhlangane njalo lenkokheli yeAfrica emhlanganweni weUS-Africa Business Forum lapho okulabosomabhizimusi beMelika lamazwe atshiyeneyo.

Asebengene emhlanganweni lo bagoqela owayenguMongameli weMelika, uMnu. Bill Clinton, uNkosazana Dlamini Zuma wenhlanganiso yeAfrican Union Commission, osomabhizimusi abenengi abavela emazweni atshiyeneyo abagoqela uMnu. Strive Masiyiwa wenjampani ye Econet Wireless.

UMasiyiwa uthi sokwendlalwe intambo zobulembu beInternet obusuka eCape Town kwele South Africa kusiyafika eSomalia lapho asememiswe ngabalwisana lohulumende walelolizwe ababizwa yikuthi Al-Shabaab.

Uthi kumele kuthuthukiswe abasakhulayo emazweni wonke kuzwekazi leAfrica ukwenzela ukwenzela ukuthuthukisa umnotho wamazwe atshiyeneyo.

uMongameli Robert Mugabe kabizwanga emhlanganweni lo oqalise ngoMvulo. Kukhangelelwe ukuthi uhlangano lo ugqhitswa kusasa.

UMongameli Jacob Zuma weSouth Africa uthi uMongameli weMelika usebenza ngonanzelelo lenkokheli yezwekazi leAfrica esebenzisa ijwabu lakhe loba nje kukunengi akade kumele akwenzele abantu beAfrica engakatshiyi umsebenzi ngomyaka ka2016.

UZuma utshele osomabhizimusi, inkokheli yenhlanganiso ezizimele zodwa lentathelizindaba eU.S National Press Club ukuthi uObama wenza kahle kuzwekazi leAfrica njengoba engumuntu omnyama.

Amazwe kuzwekazi le Africa adlelana leMelika esebenzisa umthetho obizwa ngokuthi yiGrowth and Opportunity Act (AGOA), owenza ukuthi amazwe afika angamatshumi amabili athengise impahla eMelika leyo impahla ingabhadali umthelo wemigcele i-customs duty.

Lokhu kukhangelelwe uku phela ngomnyaka ozayo loba kusobala ukuthi amazwe ezwekazi leAfrica afuna kuqhubekele phambili. Ele Zimbabwe kalikho kulukho njengoba uMongameli Robert Mugabe, ongabizwanga emhlanganweni lo oweUS-Africa Leaders Summit oqalise izolo, njengoba wafakelwa izijeziso zenotho labanye bakhe kubandla le Zanu PF.

UZuma uphinde wathi impi yeIsrael lePalestine kumele imiswe ngenxa yokuthi sokufe abantu abanengi okwamagama abagoqela abantwana labomama.

Ingcwethi kwezombusazwe ezimele yodwa uMnu. Bekezela Maduma utshele iStudio 7 ukuthi uZuma ulubeke kahle udaba lobudlelwano bamazwe kuzwekazi leAfrica leMelika njalo wethule umgqondo okhaliphileyo ngempi yeIsrael lePalestine.

Izizalwane zeZimbabwe zikazatshengisele ezitaladeni zeHarare zikhonona ngokubulawa kwabantwana labantu bePalestine. Amazwe la alobudlelwano obaqalisa iZimbabwe ilwisana lohulumende kaIan Douglas Smith.
summary: Asebengene emhlanganweni lo bagoqela owayenguMongameli weMelika, uMnu. Bill Clinton, loNkosazana Dlamini Zuma wenhlanganiso yeAfrican Union Commission

title: Charamba: Amaphephandaba Ajonge Ukungcolisa Imuli kaMnangagwa Ngodaba Lwegolide
content:
Ihofisi kaMongameli Emmerson Mnangagwa ithi kungamanga ukuthi imuli yakhe iphatheke kumisebenzi emibi kundaba zokwenjiwa kwamatshe aligugu.

Isikhulumeli sikaMnangagwa uMnu George Charamba wethule umbiko izolo esola iphephandaba leNewsDay lamanye adinda ebulenjini kuphela esithi akhuluma amanga ngemuli kaMongameli ngenjongo yokuyingcolisa.

UCharamba ulandule udaba olwethulwe yiNewsDay izolo obelusithi umntakaMnangagwa uTarirai David Mnangagwa wetheswa icala lokuhluthunela omunye umgodi wegolide eGweru.

UMnu Charamba uthe uTarirai kayisiyo ndodana kaMnangagwa. Ngokunjalo uthe iphephandaba leli kumele lixolise kumbe liveze ubufakazi bokuthi umsolwa yindodana kaMongameli Mnangagwa.

Uthe amaphephandaba amanengi akhanya elenjongo yokungcolisa lemuli kaMnangagwa ngokuqamba amanga esithi ilesandla kumacala avelela kugatsha lwamatshe aligugu.

Kumaviki edluleyo uhulumende ulandule njalo ukuthi imuli kaMnangagwa ilobudlelwano loHenrietta Rushwaya ngemva kokuba omunye owabotshelwa igolidi elatholakala kuRushwaya ethe lelogolide lalingelikaNkosikazi Mnangagwa lendodana yakhe uCollins.

Ukuhlaziya loludaba sixoxe lohlaziya ezombusazwe uMnu Effie Dlela Ncube yena othe nxa uMnangagwa engakhohlakalanga, kumele azisuse ebantwini abakhohlakeleyo abaduzane laye.
summary: Ihofisi kaMongameli Emmerson Mnangagwa ithi kungamanga ukuthi imuli yakhe iphatheke kumisebenzi emibi kundaba zokwenjiwa kwamatshe aligugu.

title: Fametraham-Pialàn’ny Filohan’ny Parlemanta Noho Ny Resa-Betaveta · Global Voices teny Malagasy
content:
Michael Palmer, Filoha teo aloha tao amin'ny Parlemanta

Nametra-pialàna ny Alarobia teo ny solombavambahoaka mpikambana tao amin'ny Parlemanta, hany tokana avy amin'ny Punggol East SMC sady Filohan'ny Parlemanta, Michael Palmer, rehefa avy niaiky ny fanànany raharaha maizina ivelan'ny tokantranony, niarahany taminà talen'ny Fikambanam-Bahoaka, mpikarakara seho an-tsehatra malaza, avy amin'ny fari-piadidian'ny Pasir Ris-Punggol, GRC (Group Representative Constituency)

Vara-datsaka ho an'i Singapore ilay fametraham-pialàna, nahatonga ny tontolon'ny fitorahana bilaogy hafanafanan'ny sahoan-dresaka samihafa.

“Alex Au” manontany ny dikan'ilay fametraham-pialàn'i Palmer :

Eny e, fantatro fa niaiky ho nanana raharaha taminà manampahefana iray avy amin'ny Fikambanam-Bahoaka izy, izay mifandray amin'ny fomba tsy mivantana amin'ny fari-piadidiany, saingy raha ny fanànana raharaha ivelan'ny tokantrano fotsiny no hanilihana olona iray amin'ny birao politika, dia heveriko fa midim-pidinana malama isika. Tsy voatery ho olo-masina ireo mpanao politika. Raha toa ny fepetra fahazoana mitàna birao ka ampidinintsika amin'ny resaka fenitra ara-maoraly toy izany, dia ny talenta/fahaiza-manao mihitsy no atositsika vohon-tànana.

Ampy tsara ireo antony tokony hametrahan'ny mpanao politika ny fialàny, ohatra, ny fiainam-pitiavana izay miteraka fifanoheran-tombontsoa, ny fanararaotam-pahefàna na fivadiham-pitokisana. Tonga tamin'ny iray amin'ireo teo-javatra ireo ve ny raharahan'i Palmer? Ny olana hatreto dia isika tsy misy mahafantatra .

Ny fametraham-pialàn'i Palmer koa dia mametraka ny Punggol East SMC tsy hanana intsony solontena ao amin'ny Parlemanta. Kanefa, ny fahefana hiantso fifidianana fanoloan-toerana dia miankina amin'ny Praiminisitra Lee Hsien Loong, izay tsy mazava ny valinteniny tamin'ny fanambaràna an-gazety nataony.

Mampiahatsiahy olana iray tany ampiandohan'ny taona ity ampahan-tantara ity, fony Yaw Shin Leong, mpikambana avy amin'ny Antokon'ny Mpiasa nahilika tsy ho ao amin'ny antokony intsony tao anatin'ireo sahoan-dresaka mikasika raharaha fanitsakitsahana tokantrano. Nisalasala ihany koa ny praiminisitra tamin'ny hiantsoana fifidianana fanoloan-toerana, na dia nisy ihany aza iray natao tamin'ny volana Mey nony farany.

Ao amin'ny matoan-dahatsorany, “The Online Citizen” dia manakiana ny praiminisitra noho ny tsy fampanantenany fifidianana fanoloan-toerana:

Kanefa, tsy tonga saina tanteraka na misafidy ny tsy hiraharaha, ny PAP izany nody fanina tamin'ireo fanontaniana fototra izay hita ho sarotra ho an'ny firaketan'ny andrim-panjakany ny hanadino azy: Rahoviana no hisy fiantsoana fifidianana fanoloan-toerana iray? Ho solon'izay, naleon'i Teo niala ilany tamin'ilay fanontaniana, namela azy io ho anjara fanapahan-kevitry ny PM na hisy na tsia ny fiantsoana fifidianana fanoloan-toerana. Notohanan'ny PM bebe kokoa ny toerana noraisiny.

Taoriana avy hatrany tamin'ny fifidianana fanoloan-toerana ny Hougang SMC, tokony ho efa naminavina ny PAP fa ho izany no fanontaniana any an-tsain'ny tsirairay any. Tokony ho efa tonga teny ambony latabatra io, nomanina niaraka amin'ny eny na tsia mazava tsara. Ny fialàna bàla amin'io dia tsy manome rariny sy toy ny ompa atao amin'ny faharanitan-tsain'ny mponina.

Ng E- Jay dia midera an'i Low Thia Khiang – Sekretera Jeneralin'ny Antokon'ny Mpiasa WP– sy ny fanehoan-keviny tamin'ny fametraham-pialàn'i Palmer :

Ny fanenjehana tsy mitsahatra ny WP ifandrimbonan'ny PAP sy ny media eo ambany fifehezan'ny fanjakàna nandritra ny raharaha Yaw Shin Leong dia fampitahàna mazava ny fomba fijery noraisin'Ing Low Thia Khiang tamin'ny raharaha Palmer tsy ela teo.

Tsy nanararaotra ny fotoana Ing Low hampietrena ny PAP na niditra taminà resaka fanaratsiana, saingy nanasongadina ny fandraisan'anjaran'i Palmer tao amin'ny Parlemanta tamin'ny maha-filoha, sady naneho alahelo tamin'ny nitrangan'ny zavatra toy izao. Tena tsy mba nanisy tombo sy hala tamin'ny olan'ireo antoko rehetra Ing Low ary tsy nikatsaka ny haka mora foana tombony ara-politika avy amin'ny olana manokan'ny olona iray hafa.

Izany no — sy tokony ho — politika.
summary: Nametra-pialàna i Michael Palmer, Filohan'ny Parlemanta, rehefa avy niaiky ny fanànany raharaha maizina ivelan'ny tokantranony. Vara-datsaka ho an'i Singapore ilay fametraham-pialàna, nahatonga ny tontolon'ny fitrahana bilaogy hafanafanan'ny sahoan-dresaka samihafa.

title: Ukusebenzelana Kwamabandla Aphikisa Elibusayo Kuyala Isikhathi Sokhetho Sesisondela
content:
Ukulobelana isivumelwano sokusebenzelana, iMemorandum of Understanding phakathi kwebandla le MDC-T lele Transform Zimbabwe, sokuvuselele njalo inkulumo phezu kodaba lokumanyana kwamabandla aphikisayo.

Ibandla le MDC-T selilobelane lesi sivumelwano lamabandla amanye amabili, ele MDC ekhokhelwa nguMnu. Welshman Ncube leNational People’s Party (NPP) ekhokhelwa nguNkosikazi Joice Mujuru.

Kodwa lokhe kungela kusebenzelana ngoba amabandla la awavumelani ukuthi ozakhokhela umanyano ngubani.

Ibandla le NPP lithi lifuna umongameli walo, uNkosikazi Mujuru, abe nguye ozakhokhela umanyano lo kodwa ele MDC-T lithi umkhokheli walo, uMnu. Morgan Tsvangira, nguye olosekelo ngalokho nguye omele akhokhele.

Sixoxe lengcwethi ecubungula ezombusazwe, uMnu. Zenzele Ndebele, louNkosazana Rita Ndlovu, unobhala jikelele webandla le MDC ekhokhelwa nguMnu. Welshman Ncube.

UNkosikazi Ndlovu uthi: "Ngilethemba lawe uyazi ukuthi lapho okukhulunyiswana khona kuyathatha isikhathi. Ungabona into ephangisa ukwenzakala vele kayisoze iye phambili."

UNdebele uthe kusobala ukuthi amabandla la angamanyana phambilini kokhetho oluzakwenziwe ngomnyaka ka2018, ibandla le Zanu PF linganqontshwa.

"Nxa sebefika okulezikhundla yikho okuzaxatshwana khona ... Abantu balokuzikhukhumeza, lokhu esingathi ngama ego ngeSilungu besithi vele nxa kungayisimi okhokhelayo akwenzakali."
summary: UNdebele uthi kusobala ukuthi amabandla la amanyana phambilini kokhetho olukamnyaka ka 2013 ngabe ibandla le Zanu PF lanqontshwa.

title: EleZimbabwe Lilahlekelwa Ngontanga Abanengi
content:
EleZimbabwe lilahlekelwa ngabasakhulayo abanengi abaya kwamanye amazwe besiyafunda kumbe ukusebenza ngenxa yokusilela kwemisebenzi elizweni.

Abanengi abaqhuba izifundo phandle kwelizwe bathi bengaqeda bahlale kulawo mazwe basebenze khona.

Abasakhulayo abasemazweni atshiyeneyo bathi kunzima ukuthi babuyele eZimbabwe ngoba imisebenzi ayitholakali kanti njalo umnotho uqhubeka ubhidlika.

Omunye wabasakhulayo laba nguNkosazana Kimberly Bhebhe, yena ofunda ekolishini leCoventry University kweleBhilithani.

“Abantu abanengi bayafuna sibili ukubuyena eZimbabwe kodwa okuhluphayi yikuthi uyabuyela ufike wenzeni ngoba imisebenzi kayikho,” kutsho uBhebhe.

title: UMnu. Gideon Gono Ulandula Ukuthi Ufuna Ukucela EleSouth Africa Ukuthi Kusetshenziswe Amarands
content:
Usibalukhulu webhanga lesizwe, iReserve Bank of Zimbabwe, uMnu. Gideon Gono uselandule imbiko ethi ufuna ukwenza irand lakwle South Africa libe yimali esetshenziswa kweleZimbabwe okusemthethweni. UGono uthi incwadi ekhombisa ukuthi nguye owaloba esithi uzacela uhulumende wakwel South Africa ukuthi avumele lokhu ingamanga ngoba lanxa kulegama lakhe kulincwadi ayisuye owayilobayo.

UMongameli weSouth Africa, uMnu. Kgalema Motlanthe ngoMvulo utshele umasakazo we South African Broadcasting Corporation ukuthi uyavumelana lalenyathelo nxa uhulumende weZimbabwe engathi ufuna ukulithatha. Kodwa uGono utshele inthathelizindaba lamuhla ukuthi kasoze akuvumele lokho.

Ingcwethi kwezenotho yelizwe, umnu. Rejoice Ngwenya utshele uChris Gande weStudio 7 ukuthi kaboni ugono eqhubeka esebenza kuhulumende omutsha ngoba esehluleka umsebenzi.

title: Ukuxolelwa Kwezibotshwa Kuzaphathisa Na?
content:
Umongameli Mugabe usexolele izibotshwa eziyinkulungwane eyodwa lamakhulu amahlanu le kuyindlela yokunciphisa inani lezibotshwa emajele aseminyene okwesabekayo. Lezi zibotshwa, ezigoqela abesifazane abafika phose ikhulu, zibikwa zizasuswa emajele amaphepha okuzikhulula engaqedwa ukulotshwa. Ugatsha lwezamajele, iZimbabwe Prisons Services izolo lwethule umbiko othi inyathelo lokukhulula izibotshwa lukhangelelwe ukuphathisa ngoba emajele kungasela mpahla zezibotshwa, ukudla, ingubo lokunye.

Ngenyanga kanhlangula umsakazo weSouth African Broadcasting Corporation wethula imfanekiso eyayitshengisa izibotshwa ezicakileyo okwesabekayo zidatshukelwe okuzwisa usizi okwabangela ukuthi inhlanganiso ye Red Cross icele uhulumende ukuthi aphathise izibotshwa lezi ezaziminyene okwesabekayo. Imbiko kahulumende ithi kuzakhululwa bonke abagulayo kungakhathelekile ukuthi badala cala bani.

Izibotshwa ezileminyaka engaphansi kwetshumi lathoba minwe bili lezingabomama abazithweleyo lazo zizaxolelwa. Kodwa izibotshwa ezabulala abantu ezingaguliyeo, ezabhinya abesifazane, ezatshontsha izimota azisoze zikhululwe. UChris Gande weStudio 7 uxoxe lomgcinisihlalo wenhlanganiso yeMediation For Peace Centre njalo elilunga le ZimRights ukuze sizwe imbono yakhe.
summary: Ingcwethi zithi ezinye izibotshwa lezi zilakho ukubuyela emajele kungakabi lansuku zatshwala

title: Ukudla Kubolela Eziphaleni Zenhlanganiso Ezizimeleyo, Uzulu Elamba
content:
Ingcwethi kwezokulima lezokudla zithi zikhangelele inguquko masinyane kudaba lokwabelwa kokudla kuzulu obhekane lendlala emangalisayo elizweni lonke jikelele. Ingcwethi lezi zithi njalo zilethemba inkulumo eziqhutshwa ngamabandla ezombusazwe kweleSouth Africa zizaletha inguquko elizweni.

Isivumelwano phakathi kwamacele womabili eMDC lebandla leZanu PF esilotshelwane phansi ngoMvulo siqakathekisa ukuqedwa kwendlala elizweni. Uhulumende uvimbe inhlanganiso eziphathisa ngokudla ekuqhubeni umsebenzi wazo, ngaphambilini kokhetho lwe Run-Off.

Esinye isiphathamandla seWorld Vision esingathandanga ukubethwa ngegama sitshele iStudio 7 ukuthi inhlanganiso le, engenye yenhlanganiso ebeziphathisa uzulu ngokudla, ilokudla okunengi eziphaleni zayo njalo iphakathi kokukhulumisana laboSikomitshi bezigaba ezitshiyeneyo ama District Administrators (DA) icela imvumo yokuthi iqalise ukwabela abantu ukudla.

Kodwa oSikomotshi laba bathi labo abalamandla okuvumela inhlanganiso lezi ukuthi ziqalise umsebenzi. Ingcwethi kwezokulima njalo elilunga ledale lePhalamande, emela iMangwe uMnu Edward Mkhosi utshele uBrenda Moyo weStudio 7 ukuthi kuyadanisa ukuthi abantu abanengi bayalamba khona kulenhlanganiso ezilokudla okubolela eziphaleni zazo.

Omela isigaba seBinga edaleni leSenate, uMnu Herbert Sinampande utshele uBrenda Moyo weStudio 7 njalo ukuthi ngempela uzulu uyalamba, esithi ulethemba lokuthi uhulumende uzavumela inhlanganiso ezizimeyo ukuthi ziqalise ukwabela uzulu ukudla ngokuphangisa.
summary: Kodwa ingcwethi kwezokulima zithi zilethemba lenkulumo eziqhutshwa kwele South Africa

title: UKhama weBotswana Kasoze Enze Idili Elikhulu Lokuzalwa Elifanana Lelika Mugabe
content:
UMongameli Robert Mugabe wazalwa mhlaka 21 Nhlolanja 1924 kwathi ngemva kweminyaka engamatshumi amabili lasitshiyagololunye, mhlaka 27 Nhlolanja 1953, kwazalwa uMongameli Ian Khama owabelethelwa kwele Bhilithani.

Kuyonale iviki, uMugabe ulungiselela ukuthakazelela ilanga lakhe lokuzalwa eRhodes Estate Preparatory School (REPS) ngaphandle kwakoBulawayo, lapho okubikwa izikhamizi azilali zizama ukuncedisa ukuthi indawo ibukeke.

Sokulethwe kanye lemitshina yokulungisa imigwaqo kukanti izakhamizi zibikwa zikhiphe inkomo kanye lemali. Idili lonke lizakudla izigidi ezimbili lengxenye yamadola eMelika (i$2.5million).

Lokhu kuchothozwe ngabanye abafana loMnunzana Dumi Ncube oseGaborone othe konke lokhu ukugida kuyenzakala ngesikhathi abanye beZimbabwe belala ngendlala.

“Kambe ngeqiniso kungathi ilizwe liphakathi kwendlala engaka umuntu oyedwa asebenzise imali engaka ukunanza ilanga lakhe lokuzalwa.”

Kukanti ngaphetsheya komfula uRamokgwebana, eBotswana, lapho inengi elilala lidlile njalo umumo womnotho unganeno, akula dili elikhona ngesikhathi uMongameli Khama ethakazelela ilanga lakhe lokuzalw.

“Siyake sibone umongameli Khama evakatshela noma izibotshwa ngelanga lakhe lokuzalwa, esidla nje ikhekhe kanye lokudla kwemini okungayi ngaphi. Kazidubi ngokuchitha izigidi lezigidi.”

Kukanti omunye weBotswana, uMnu. Joel Serema, uthi bona bayathakazelela indlela umongameli wabo oyenza ngayo engachithi imali kumadili.

“Yikho esikukhangeleleyo kumkhokheli ongachithi imali kumadili afana lokunanza ilanga lakhe lokuzalwa.”

Langakucele lezombusazwe, uMongameli Mugabe lo Mongameli Khama ngamanzi lamafutha. UMugabe usebuse iZimbabwe iminyaka engamatshumi amathathu lasikhombisa kukanti uKhama wangena esihlalweni ngomnyaka ka2008.

UKhama ulungiselela ukwehla esihlwalweni ngomnyaka ozayo, enikeza umsekeli wakhe, uMnu. Mokgweetsi Masisi, intambo.

Kukanti nga kwelinye icele, uMugabe, oyenelisa iminyaka engamatshumi ayisitshiyagalolunye lantathu (93), ulungiselela ukumela ibandla lakhe leZANU PF kukhetho lomnyaka ozayo.
summary: “Kambe ngeqiniso kungathi ilizwe liphakathi kwendlala engaka umuntu oyedwa asebenzise imali engaka ukunanza ilanga lakhe lokuzalwa.”

title: Amapholisa Aqhubeka Ebopha Iziphathamandla ZeMDC-T Ngokubulawa Kuka Inspector Petros Mutedza
content:
UKhansila ka Ward 17 eMount Pleasant, eHarare uMnu. Warship Dumba owecele le MDC elikhokhelwa nguMnu. Morgan Tsvangirai ngomunye wababotshwe ngempelaviki esethedwa icala lokuphatheka ekubulaweni kwepholisa umuyi Inspector Petros Mutedza ngenyanga edluleyo kulelidolobho.

UDumba ulokhu esezandleni zamapholisa, njalo ukubotshwa kwakhe kuletha inani lamalunga e MDC abotshelwe lelicala kumatshumi amabili lane.

Igqwetha elibamelayo, uMnu. Marufu Mandevere utshele iStudio 7 ukuthi abathathu ababotshwe ngeviki edluleyo bamiswe phambi komthethwandaba kamantshi okwakuqala ngoMvulo, njalo bazaphindela khona ngoLwesibili, kuthi abanye abangamatshumi amabili bephindele kulelidale ngoLwesihlanu.

UKhansila Peter Moyo we Harare utshele uSithandekile Mhlanga we Studio 7 ukuthi ibandla lakhe lesabela ukuthi uMnu. Dumba ujeziselwa ukuveza ukungathembeki kweziphathamandla zebandla le ZANU PF ekwabiweni kwezithanda zekhansili yeHarare lalelidolobho.

Kusenjalo, amapholisa angene ngamandla ngoLweSihlanu endlini esemzini we Suburbs esetshenziswa yinhlanganiso yeWomen of Zimbabwe Arise, iWOZA ukwenza imihlangano, abikwa esesala ukuphuma kuyo. Abesifazana abangafika isithupha babalekile lapho amapholisa awomvukela ehlasela lindlu.

Imota ezimbili ebeziphandle kwalindlu lazo abanikazi kabasenelisi ukuzithatha ngoba amapholisa asesalela abantu abagoqela amagqwetha ukuthi bangene kuleyondlu.

Umkhokheli we WOZA, uNkosikazi Jenny Williams utshele uChris Gande weStudio Seven ukuthi isehlakalo lesi sitshengsia mgceke ukuthi amapholisa awakenelisi ukufinyelela ukugcwalisa esinye sezibopho zesivumelwano se Global Political Agreement esithi ilungelo likazulu kumele linakekelwe.
summary: Abathathu ababotshwe ngeviki edluleyo ngecala linye bamiswe phambi komthethwandaba kamantshi okwakuqala ngoMvulo

title: Abatsha Kubandla leZanu PF Bathi UChiwenga Kayekele Ukungenela Ezombusazwe
content:
Abatsha bebandla leZanu PF bathi kabasoke bagoqe izandla abakubutho leZimbabwe beveza mgceke ukuthi sebefuna ukuhluthuna umbuso kaMongameli Robert Mugabe.

Eqondisa amazwi akhe kumkhokheli weZimbabwe Defence Forces, uGeneral Constantino Chiwenga, umkhokheli wohlangothi lwabatsha be Zanu PF Youth League uKudzanayi Chipanga uthe njengentsha yebandla bazinikele ukuvikela umongameli wabo.

Amazwi kaChipanga alandela umhlangano wabakubutho ngoMvulo lapho ababike ukuthi njengabezomvikela kabasoke bavumela uMugabe eyengana labanye abaku Zanu PF ukuxotshana labalwa impi yenkululeko kulelobandla.

Laloba abakubutho bekhokhelwa nguGeneral Chiwenga bengaqambanga amagama abalwa impi yenkululeko bekusobala ukuthi ubehlanganisela ukuxotshwa komsekeli kamongameli uEmmmesrson Mnangagwa ngumongameli Mugabe, emethesa icala lokuphambuka kumsebenzi ayewuphiwe.

UChipanga ubuye wathi ngokuya komthetho amabutho yiwona okumele athole iziqondiso kubakhokheli belizwe lonke jikelele hatshi ukuthi ibutho libe yilona eligijimela phambili.

Uphinde wethesa abakubutho icala lokweba amatshe aligugu amadayimani akoMarange abikwa elentengo yamabillion alitshumi lanhlanu amadola-$15 billion, okuyimali eyabikwa nguMugabe ukuthi yanyamalala.

Ingcwethi ehlaziya ezombusazwe uMnu. Givemore Maphosa uthi laloba evumelana loChipanga ukuthi abakubutho kumele bavalelwe emabhalakini, akasekeli ukuthi abeZanu PF babasola kuphela uma kuyibona abaqotshwe ngabakubutho.

Ukuxabana phakathi kukaMongameli Mugabe labesibuthweni kulandela njalo amazwi omkhokheli weMDC-T, uMnu Morgan Tsvangirai, otshele intathelizindaba zakwele South Africa kuviki ephelilelo ukuthi ukuxotshwa kukaMnangagwa kulakho ukudala ingxabangxoza elizwe kukhokhelele empini yomdeni.

title: UObadiah Tarumbwa Sedlalela I Circle Bruge
content:
Umdlali weqembu leHighlanders uObadiah Tarumbwa usethole umsebenzi wokudlalela iqembu le Circle Bruge e Belgium. UTarumbwa sezadlalela qembu linye loVusa Nyoni kanye loHonour Gombami labo abake badlalela iHighlanders.

Ukusuka kukaTarumbwa kuBosso kutshiye abadlali abanengi bekhala ngokuthi selifile iqembu ngoba kungaselamdlali olohlonzi othenjiweyo ngendlela obekuthenjwe ngayo uTarumbwa. Kakukaphumi sobala ukuthi iqembu leli limthenge ngemalini.

Kodwa umsakazo wenu uyakuveza ukuthi uTarumbwa unikwe i contract yenyanga eziyisithupha njalo engadlala okusuthisayo i contract yakhe ilakho ukwengezelelwa ngeminyaka emibili.

title: Abenhlanganiso Ezizimeleyo Bathi Akubaphathi Kuhle Ukunyamalala KukaChizuze
content:
Inhlanganiso ezizimeleyo seziveze ukukhathazela ngokunyamalala komlweli wamalungelo oluntu oselamaviki amathathu engabonakali.

UMnu Paul Chizuze ubikwa esuke emzini wakhe koBulawayo mhlaka 8 kulinyanga etshayela imota yohlobo lweNissan Hardbody kodwa kazange abe esaphenduka.

UChizuze usebenze kakhulu lenhlanganiso ezigoqela iAmani Trust, ZimRights, Churches in Bulawayo, Catholic Commission for Justice and Peace kanye lezinye ezitshiyeneyo.

Embikweni eziwethule ngoLwesibili, inhlanganiso ezigoqela iZimbabwe Lawyers for Human Rights, Radio Dialogue lezinye zicele umphakathi ukuthi uncedise ekudingeni uChizuze.

Zengeze zathi zesabela ukuthi engaba ebulewe kumbe ukuthunjwa, kodwa azizange ziveze ukuthi zicabangela ukuthi ngubani ongaba enze lokhu.

UChizuze usebenze njalo lomphathintambo wezemfundo uMnu David Coltart ekudingeni owayekhokhela umkhankaso kaColtart kukhetho luka2000 uMnu Patrick Nabanyama.

UNabanyama wanyamalala kokuphela njalo lanamuhla lokhu akwaziwa ukuthi wadliwa yini. UMnu Coltart yena uchaze uChizuze njengendoda elokuzinikela okukhulu kundaba zamalungelo oluntu.

Umqondisi weHabakkuk Trust, uMnu Dumisani Nkomo utshele iStudio 7 ukuthi abalwela amalungelo oluntu elizweni jikelele badane kakhulu ngesehlakalo lesi.
summary: UMnu Paul Chizuze ubikwa esuke emzini wakhe koBulawayo mhlaka 8 kulinyanga etshayela imota njalo kazange aphenduke

title: Inkulumo Phakathi KweMDC LeZanu PF Ziqhubekela Phambili
content:
EleBhilithani lithi lilokufuthelana okukhulu ngokuvinjwa yiRussia kanye keChina kwezijeziso ebezizakwethulelwa uhulumende kamongameli Robert Mugabe yiUnited Nations.

Inhloko kahulumende walelilizwe uMnu Gordon Brown uveze lamuhla ukuthi ilizwe lakhe lizabuyela ku United Nations ngodaba lweZimbabwe likhankasela ukwethulwa kwezijeziso lezi.

UBrown uthi ulethemba lokuthi izijeziso ze European Union zizabandezela uhulumende kaMugabe kabuhlungu. Ngakwelinye icele iziphathamandla ezimela iZanu PF lamacele womabili eMDC eziphatheke kunkulumo ezilawulwa ngumongameli Thabo Mbeki, zikhangelelwe ukuhlangana kuliviki zihlaziya udaba lwenkulumo ezimqoka ezizalandela emizameni yokulungisisa udaba lweZimbabwe.

UmMbeki yena ubikwa ezakuba lomhlangano lomgcinisihlalo weAfrican Union Commission uMnu Jean Ping ngoLwesihlanu kweleSouth Africa. UMnu Ping ubikwa ezahlangana njalo lomgcinisihlalo weAfrican Union uMnu Jakaya Kikwete kuliviki behlaziya udaba lweZimbabwe.

Ababili laba bakhangelelwe ukubhekisa amabombo eZimbabwe kumalanga ambalwa alandelayo ukuyakhulumisana leZanu PF leMDC. Isikhulumi sikaMbeki uMnu Mukoni Ratshitanga utshele iStudio 7 ukuthi uMbeki nguye ocele lumhlangano lo Ping ukuthi amazise ngenkulumo azilawulayo phakathi kweMDC leZanu PF.

Ingcwethi ecubungula ezombusazwe uMnu Mandlenkosi Gatsheni utshele uNtungamili Nkomo weStudio 7 ukuthi ukuhlanganisa amakhanda kuka Ping, uMbeki loKikwete kulakho ukuthela izithelo ngoba uMbeki eyedwa kukhanya seyehlulekile ukulungisisa udaba lweZimbabwe.

title: Isibathwalele Ubhulo iCovid 19 abeZimbabwe AbaseGauteng kweleSouth Africa
content:
Bethukile abeZimbabwe kweleSouth Africa ngemva kokuba isabelo seGauteng esilabeZimbabwe ababengi sekuyiso esihlaselwe yicoronavirus ukwedlula zonke elizweni. UBenedict Nhlapho usipha loludaba eseJohannesburg kweleSouth Africa.

Sekuzalele ingwe esabelweni seGauteng ngemva kwesimemezelo sikahulumende sokuthi sebesedlula izinkulungwane ezilikhulu (over 100,000) asebehlaselwe ligciwane lecoronavirus kulesisabelo. Le yinto esitshiye inengi labeZimbabwe bethwele amathumbu ngezandla njengoba kulapho inengi abafikele khona, basebenza khona bahlala khona.

Isizalwane seZimbabwe umnumnzana Jonathan Mbedzi uthi osekubuye kwafaka ibilebile esilondeni yilokhu ukuthi edolobheni leJohannesburg, lapho abanengi khona okwedlula zonke indawo elizweni kulapho leligciwane elidla khona amahabulo.

“I think kuzobanzima kakhulu ebantwini beZimbabwe ukuthi bengcwabe abantu babo ngoba kusazofiwa impela. Abantu bayafa la eGauteng. Abantu abasasebenzi ubuningi babo. Abantu abasatholi ukudla nazo zonke lezi izinto ezikhona. Ma kuyikhona ukufa sizofela khonalapha. Ma kuyikuthi asikhoni ukuyobangcwaba emakhaya abantu bakithi sizobangcwabanje khonalapha.”

Emalangeni kube lembiko engakagcizelelwa nguhulumende ethi lesi sabelo siphakathi kokwemba amangcwaba ayisigidi kulungiselelwa labo okukhangelelwe ukuthi babulawe yicoronavirus. Le yinto izizalwane zeZimbabwe ezithi isibalalisa phandle kwengubo.

Ngakolunye uhlangothi umnumnzana Greatman Mkhwebu yena uthi njengoba bekuvele kulomoyana wokungemukeli abakwamanye amazwe ezibhedlela, sebesesaba ukuthi funa labo abazobanjwa yilo umkhuhlane ngeke baphume ezibhedlela.

“Kutsho ukuthi amangcwaba la azogcwala thina. Kutsho ukuthi ma ungenanje uyiforeigner they will do okwakuvele kusenzeka ungena esibhedlela last time ukuthi ma ungelazincwadi awuvunyelwa ukungena ezibhedlela kumele kuncedwe amaSouth Africans first. So kunzima abantu kufanele baziphathe ngoba ungaya esibhedlela sekungenzeka ungajiki.”

Umgcinisihlalo wenhlanganiso yeZimbabwe Community in South Africa umnumnzana Ngqabutho Mabhena uthi vele lumkhuhlane usuqalisile ukuhlasela kuzulu weZimbabwe kweleSouth Africa.

“Kumele sizame ukwenza lokhu ngolwemnzini abathi yisocial distance. Singahambi endaweni lapho okugcwele khona abantu. Kumele ma siphuma emakhaya sifake ama mask sigeze izandla. Kumele futhi ma ubuya emsebenzini ufuthe. Kumele ungesabi ukunuka umlomo udle amagarlic lalezi ezinye izinto abathi sizidle.”

Okwamanje sebebanga kunkulungwane ezingamakhulu amathathu (about 300,000) asebehlaselwe ligciwane lecoronavirus kweleSouth Africa kanti sebesedlula izinkulungwane ezine (over 4000) asebefile.
