title: Amagqwetha Ayafola Esola Ukwephulwa Kwelungelo Loluntu Elizweni
content:
Amagqwetha abegqoke izembatho zawo zomsebenzi afolile ngoLwesibili esuka enzikini yedolobho leHarare esiyakhweza izikhalazo zawo emthethwandaba weConstitutional Court, esola ukwephulwa kwamalungelo oluntu elizweni.

Ukufola lokhu bekuqoqwe yinhlanganiso elwela amalungelo amagwetha eyeZimbabwe Law Society, yona ethi omantshi behlulela amacala ngesiphange-phange abantu bengakadingi abammeli kukanti bencitshwa mahlayana ithuba lokuhlawula imali yesibambiso se bail.

Lokhu kulandela ukutshengisela kwabantu kumaviki amabili edluleyo besola isimo somnotho elizweni, okwabangela ukubulawa, ukutshaywa, kanye lokulimala kwabanye, lembiko ethi abesifazana badlwengulwa libutho.

Ukuhlaziya loludaba, sixoxe loMnu. Rejoice Ngwenya, ingcwethi ecubungula ezombusazwe yena othi ukutshengisela kwamagqwetha kunika isisindo kumikhankaso yokuzama ukutshengisa umhlaba okwenzakala eZimbabwe .

Kusenjalo, ibandla leMDC lithi ukwephulwa kwelungelo loluntu nguhulumende sokufike kuzinga elibi kakhulu njalo kufanele umanyano weSADC, inhlanganiso ezizimeleyo, kanye lamazwe omhlaba angenele kuloludaba.

Ekhuluma emhlanganweni lentathelizindaba ngoLwesibili eHarare, umkhokheli weMDC uMnu. Nelson Chamisa usole amanye amazwe ngokungangeneli kokwenzakala eZimbabwe esithi akufanelanga bamelele ukuthi inani lezidumbu zababulawa libutho kumbe abesifazana abadlwengulwayo liqonge.

Isikhulumeli sikaMnu. Chamisa, uMnu. Nkululeko Sibanda uchasisa okunengi okukhulunywe kulumhlangano.
summary: Amagqwetha abegqoke izembatho zawo zomsebenzi afolile ngoLwesibili esuka enzikini yedolobho leHarare esiya emthethwandaba weConstitutional Court, esola ukwephulwa kwamalungelo oluntu elizweni nguhulumende.

title: Ezemaphandleni: Inkomo Seziqalisile Ukucuba Kwezinye Indawo
content:
Inkomo zibikwa seziqalisile ukucuba kwezinye indawo ezansi yeMaNdebeleni ngenxa yedlala lokusilelwa kwamanzi ngoba amanye amadamu esesitsha.

Indlala ehlasele nyakenye ibulale inkomo ezedlula izinkulungwane ezilitshumi lasithupha, 16,000, endaweni ezitshiyeneyo zeMatabeleland South.

Lanxa izanusi zomkhathi zisithi lonyaka kukhanya kuzakuna izulu elaneleyo eZimbabwe lasemhlubulweni wezansi yeAfrica, ezinye izakhamizi zithi izifuyo zazo seziqalisile ukucuba ngenxa yendlala lokusilela kwamanzi.

“Abadala lapha baphila ngokuthengisa imbuzi lenkomo kodwa lonyaka kuyafiwa ngoba inkomo seziqalile ukucuba zibuthene eMzingwane khonangale eziyake zidle khona,” kutsho isakhamuzi seTshanyawugwe, uMnu Jephias Dube.

Isigaba seBeitbridge yiso esafelwa zinkomo ezinengi ukwedlula zonke eMatabeleland South nyakenye silandelwa ngeseBulilima, kuzobuya iGwanda yona eyalandelwa yiInsiza.

Ngaphandle kwezifuyo, abantu abanengi abakhulume leStudio 7 eGwanda South labo bakhala ngokuthi umangoye uselala eziko.

Bathi ngaphandle kokuthi bathole uncedo oluvela kuhulumende, bazabulawa yindlala.

Esinye njalo isakhamuzi, uNkosikazi Mnyadziwa Siziba, olima imbhida esivandeni seSibambene Garden, uthi udubo yimpuphu.

“Ngikhonapha angikwazi ukuthi ngizakudlani, imbhida yonale ngizafika ngisikelele ngifake lamatamatisi sipheke, impuphu akusela,” kutsho uNkosikazi Siziba.
summary: Inkomo zibikwa seziqalisile ukucuba kwezinye indawo ezansi yeMaNdebeleni ngenxa yedlala lokusilelwa kwamanzi ngoba amanye amadamu esesitsha.

title: Amaqembu AkumaLower Divisions: Lathi Siyayifuna Imali yeFIFA
content:
Inhlanganiso eqondisa umdlalo wenguqu eyeZimbabwe Football Association ngeviki eyedluleyo yazise ukuba izakupha amaqembu adlala esigabeni se Premier Soccer League inkulungwane ezinhlanu ezilamakhulu amahlanu zamadola ase Melika.

Lokhu kuza ngemva kokuba inhlanganiso ye ZIFA iphiwe imali yinhlanganiso ye FIFA kanye leye CAF eyokuphathisa amaqembu omdlalo wenguqu ngesikhathi umhlaba uhlaselwe ngumkhuhlane we Covid 19.

Linhlanganiso kayisatshongo ukuba izaphathisa lamaqembu adlala ezigabeni eziphansi ezikumaLower Divisions, kodwa umqondisi weqembu le Ajax Hotspurs uSiphambaniso Dube uthi ulethemba lokuba labo bazaphathiswa.

“Esintwini bathi inhlwa kayibanjwa ngekhanda. Inhlanganiso yeZimababwe Football Association mhlawumbe ilayo indlela ezakhangela ngayo amaqembu adlala kuzigaba eziphansi okokuthi singagijimela ukuthi bakhangele abe PSL kuphela sibe sesizihlabe ngowethu. Yikho ke njengoba ubaba uKamambo ekhulume nge PSL asingakuthathi njengokuthi uqedile kodwa sikuthathe njengokuthi kukhona abakulungiselela amaqembu adlala kuzigaba eziphansi wona avele angelalo losekelo lwezimali,” kutsho uDube.

Intathelizindaba yezemidlalo uNash Mkokwayarira laye uthe inhlanganiso ye ZIFA kumele ikhumbule ukuba akungeke kube le PSL kungela zigaba ezingaphansi kwayo.

“Kuhle ngoba amaqembu azaphathiseka kodwa iqiniso yikuba limali ayiyeneli. Ngokubona kwami inhlanganiso ye ZIFA kumele ithi ngipho ngipho ihlephunele ngitsho lamaqembu adlala kuzigaba eziphansi ngoba phela akungeke kube le PSL kungela abo division one,” kutsho uMkokwayarira.

Inhlanganiso ye ZIFA ithe izaphathisa amaqembu ngemali, iphinde njalo kube yiyo ebhadala indleko zabonompembe kanye lokubhadalela ukuhlolwa kwabadlali ukuba kabalalo yini igciwane le Corona.

Amaqembu abesifazane abadlala umdlalo wenguqu lawo azathola inkulungwane ezingamakhulu amahlanu zamadola aseMelika eyokuwaphathisa.

Imidlalo yenguqu kwele Zimbabwe bekumele iqale ngenyanga kaMbimbitho kodwa yasimiswa ngemva kokuba sekuqhamuke umkhuhlane we Covid – 19 njalo ikhangelelwe ukuba isingaqhubekela phambili ngemva kokutholakala kwemali evele kwabe FIFA kanye le CAF.
summary: Amaqembu omdlalo wenguqu adlala ezigabeni zaphansi, kumaLower Divisions, lawo athi akhangelele ukuthola usizo lwemali evela kunhlanganiso eye Zimbabwe Football Association-ZIFA, njengalokhu okuzakwenzakala kumaqembu adlala esigabeni se Premier Soccer League.

title: Human Rights Watch: Ukhetho Oluzayo Alusoze Lube Ngolukhululekileyo Kungelanguquko
content:
Inhlanganiso elwela ilungelo loluntu eyeHuman Rights Watch ithi ukwehluleka kukaMongameli Emmerson Mnangagwa ukuthi aguqule imithetho ephathelane lezokhetho lokunye, kungabangela ukuthi ukhetho oluzayo lungabi ngolukhululekileyo.

Embikweni awethule ngoLwesine, isiphathamandla seHuman Rights Watch uMnu. Dewa Mavhinga uthe uMnangagwa kufanele atshengise inguquko ngezenzo hatshi ukukhuluma nje kuphela.

Inhlanganiso le iphinde yasola ukungenela kwebutho kwezokhetho kanye lezehlakalo zodlakela eziqhamuka kubandla leZANU PF, kanye lakuMDC-T ekhokhelwa nguMnu. Nelson Chamisa.

Ukuhlaziya loludaba, uSithandekile Mhlanga uxoxe loMnu. Joseph Tshuma, isiphathamandla sebandla leZANU PF.

UMnu. Tshuma uthi kusobala ukuthi inhlanganiso ye Human Rights Watch isekela amabandla aphikisayo ngoba umongameli Mnangagwa useguqule inhlelo ezinengi ezazisephula ilungelo loluntu, kodwa ilokhu imsola.

content:

Embikweni eziwethule ngoMvulo inhlanganiso lezi zithe uMaguwu kumele akhululwe njalo angaze ahlukuluzwa. UMaguwu ubotshwe ngamapholisa eMutare ngeviki edluleyo esetheswa icala lokwethula imbiko yamanga ngokuntshontshwa kwamadayimana eMarange.

title: Izizalwane zeZimbabwe Ezise Botswana Kazelatshwa Ezibhedlela
content:
Ezinye izizalwane zeZimbabwe eBotswana zikhonona ngokuthi azitholi usizo ezibhedlela ngenxa yokuthi azilamaphepha aqondileyo awokuhlala elizweni.

IBotswana ithi yona inceda labo abasesimeni esibi kuphela noma bengelamaphepha.

Umama uMaNdlovu yena oleminyaka engamatshumi ayisithupha (60) uthi usexotshwe kanengi emaklinika esiyadinga uncedo lwabongi ngenxa yokuthi akalamaphepha okuhlala eBotswana.

uMaNdlovu uthi ayisikho kwakuqala exotshwa ngenxa yokungabi lamaphepha…

Uqhubeke ethi uyazi abanye ababiselwa emuva noma nje isimo somkhuhlane sisezingeni esibi. UMaNdlovu uthi bayabizelwa amapholisa uma bengelamaphepha…

Udubo lolu kukhanya lubheke ngitsho lalabo abalamaphepha okuhlala elizweni. UPeterson Sibanda uthi bengakelwatsha kuqala kudingakale ukuthi bayehlawula kweyinye ihofisi ekhatshana lesibhedlela…

Omunye oweZimbabwe oseGaborone, uMnqobi Ncube uthi uhulumende weBotswana kumele azibuze ukuthi kuyini okuqakathekileyo phakathi kwempilo yomuntu lamaphepha.

Isizalwane seBotswana uBaboki Gopolang uthi uhulumende wakhe kumele ananzelele ukuthi ukuthola impilakahle lilungelo lomuntu wonke…

Isikhulumi sesibhedlela esikhulu sePrincess Marina eGaborone uDonnell Kutlapye utshele iStudio 7 ukuthi labo abasesimeni esibi yibo abathola usizo noma bengelamaphepha. Kodwa abanye bavalelwa ngaphandle…

Okwenzakalayo yikuthi labo abasesimeni esibi yibo abathola uncedo, kodwa abanye abafuna uncedo nje kumele bakhiphe amaphepha akhombisa ukuthi balelungelo lokuba selizweni.

Umongameli Ian Khama weBotswana wacela ukuthi abantu, kungakhethi mhlobo, bathole usizo ezibhedlela. Wethula lumbiko ngemva kokukhonona kwabomama abavela eZimbabwe ababekhulelwe kodwa bancitshwa usizo ngesizatho sokuthi abalamaphepha wokubaseBotswana.

title: IZimbabwe Imanyana leZambia Ekulwiseni i-Malaria
content:
Uhulumende weZimbabwe usemanyene loweZambia kuhlelo lokuvimba ukumemetheka komkhuhlane woqhuqho lweMalaria olweZambia/Zimbabwe Cross Border Malaria Initiative.

Ukusebenzelana kwamazwe womabili kulolu hlelo kwenziwa ngesikhathi elungiselela umhlangano omkhulu kwezokwethekelelana ozakwenzelwa eVictoria Falls eZimbabwe kanye le Livingstone kwele Zambi owe United Nations World Tourisim Organisation General Sssembly (UNWTO).

Umhlangano weUNWTO ukhangelelwe ukungenwa zinkokheli zamanye amazwe, amalunga enhlanganiso le, inkokheli zamankampani aphatheke kwezokwethekelelana kanye lozulu umhlaba wonke jikelele.

Ngakho ohulumende bobabili bakubone kufanele ukuba babambisane empini yokulwisana lomkhuhlane woqhuqho lweMalaria anduba umhlangano wenziwe.

Insuku zokuba lumhlangano wenziwe ngenyanga kaNcwabakazi sezisondele ngakho inkokheli kwezempilakahle zikubone kufanele ukuba ziqinise inhlelo zazo ukuze zivikeleke izethekeli ngesikhathi kuqhutshwa lumhlangano.

Yiziphithiphithi ngesikhathi ohulumende bobabili bezama ukuqedisa osokusele ukuze kusiyafika insuku zokuqhuba lumhlangano konke besekulungule.

Amadolobho omabili enzelwa lumhlangano abhekane lodubo oluhlezi lusaziwa kwezempilakahle olweMalaria.

Udubo lomkhuhlane woqhuqho lubhahe kakhulu ezigabeni zemingceleni wamazwe womabili okugoqela i- Vic Falls le Livingstone kwele Zambia.

Lokhu kuvezwe emhlanganweni lentatheli owenzelwe eVictoria Falls kuphawulwa loluhlelo lwe Zam/Zim ngasikhathi sinye kunanzwa usuku lapho okuqakathekiswa khona umsebenzi wokuvimba ukumemeteka komkhuhlane woqhuqho lweMalaria, iWorld Malaria Day.

Isilinganiso sokungamatshumi amahlanu ekhulwini sikazulu weZimbabwe sisengozini yokuhlaselwa yilomkhuhlane woqhuqho elizweni.

Abezempilakahle bakhuthaza uzulu ukuba aguqule imicabango yakhe alandele imfundiso ayiphiwayo phezu kokuzivikela kumiyane eyiyona ethwala igciwane elibangela umkhuhlane woqhuqho.

Babika njalo ukuba phakathi komnyaka 2011 kusiya ku 2012 uzulu owedlula kancane inkulungwane ezilitshumi lantathu-13 303, owesigabeni se Matebeleland North nguye oye waya dinga usizo ezibhedlela ngoba ecabangela ukuba usehlaselwe ngumkhuhlane woqhuqho.

Abazinkulungwane ezintathu - 3000 balaba bantu batholakale belezibonelo ezikhomba ukuba balawo umkhuhlane woqhuqho kwathi abalitshumi yibo abalahlekelwe yimpilo.

Abezempilakahle bathi kunje abenhlanganiso yePopulation Services International –PSI, baphakathi kokwabela uzulu we Matebeleland North kusiya kubo Kariba eMashonaland West,ohlala bucwadlana lomfula uZambezi amambule wokuzivikela ukulunywa yimiyane angaba zinkulungwane ezedlula amakhulu amane-457 000.
summary: Ohulumende bamazwe womabili sebesungule uhlelo lokuvimba ukumemetheka komkhuhlane lo olwe Zambia/Zimbabwe Cross Border Malaria Initiative

title: Zapu: Bhaliselani Ukuvota Ngobunengi Sisuse iZanu PF Embusweni
content:
Ibandla leZapu lenze umhlangano emavinkilini eHomestead, eKezi ngeSonto lakhuthaza abantu abangakabhaliseli ukuvota ukuthi babhalise ukuze benelise ukuvota kukhetho oluzayo.

Umgcinisihlalo walelibandla eMatabeleland South, uMnu. Mathew Sibanda, utshele izakhamizi ukuthi zikhuthaze izihlobo, abantwana kanye labangane abakwamanye amazwe ukuthi labo bazebhalisela uhlelo lolu lungakavalwa.

“Nxa ungayanga vota uyabe ungatshengisanga amalungelo akho ngento oyisolayo ongayithandiyo ngezinto ezenziwa nguhulumende obusayo,” kuchasise uMnu Sibanda.

Esinye isakhamuzi esingene lumhlangano, uMnu Similo Nyathi uthe njengesigaba esahlaselwa ngumbhuqazwe weGukurahundi, abanye kabasoze benelise ukubhalisa ngoba bengela zithupha kathi njalo inengi liphandle kwelizwe.

Umhlangano weZapu lo ungenwe ngabantu abambalwa njalo uyingxenye yemihlangano yalelibandla eyokukhankasela ukhetho oluzakwenziwa maduze nje.

Uhlelo lokubhalisa abantu abazavota obeluqhutshwa yikomishini yokhetho, iZimbabwe Electoral Commission lapho ebijonga khona uzulu ezigabeni zonke zelizwe lufike emaphathelweni kumaviki amabili edluleyo.

Kodwa abangakabhalisi bayenelisa ukuyabhalisa emawofisini alikomishini atholakala kuzo zonke izabelo zelizwe lanxa nje abanengi bekhala ngomango.

title: Kuqhutshwa Ingxoxo- Mpikisano eMelika Ngengxabangxoza eseZimbabwe
content:
Omunye wabasekeli benhloko kahulumende uMnu. Arthur Mutambara uyagcizelela umvbono wokuthi uhulumende weMelika kufanele ethule izijeziso azethesa eleZimbabwe ukwenzela ukuthi umnotho welizwe uthuthuke. UMutambara, ukhulume lamazwi emhlanganweni oqoqwe yinhlanganiso ye National Endowment for Democracy owenzelwe eMelika ngolweSibili, lapho obekunxuswe iziphathamandla zikahulumende weZimbabwe kanye lamalunga enhlanganiso ezizimeleyo ukuhlafuna udaba lweZimbabwe.

UMutambara uthe kusobala ukuthi eleMelika lincindezela eleZimbabwe ngoba abantu makhaza elizweni kanye lamabandla ezombusazwe atshiyeneyo sebekubeke sobala ukuthi bafuna izijeziso lezi zikhutshwe.

UMnu. Machivenyika Mapuranga, ummeli weZimbabwe eMelika uvumelana loMutambara, wagcizelela ukuthi eleMelika lisekela amanye amazwe angananzi amalungelo oluntu.

Kodwa isiphathamandla sikahulumende weMelika esibona ngokwenzakala ezwekazi leAfrica uMnu. Reuben Bridgety wesibili uthe izijeziso lezi azisoze zikhutshwe nxa eleZimbabwe lingananzanga amalungelo oluntu.

UMnu. Ibbo Mandaza, umhleli njalo eyingcwethi ecubungula ezombusazwe, usole ibandla le MDC esithi kusobala ukuthi alingeke labusa ngemfanelo. UMandaza uthe inengi lamalunga alelibandla aphiwa izikhundla kuhulumende womanyano wona engakwazi lokuthi asebenze njani.

Omunye okhulume kulumhlangano nguMnu. Godfrey Kanyenze, ingcwethi ecubungula ezombusazwe, yena ogcizelele ukuthi abantu makhaza elizweni baswela okokusebenzisa okugoqela imfundo, imithi ezibhedlela, kanye lamanzi okunatha. UKanyenze uthi isizatho yikuthi uhulumende kacabangi ngokuhlawulela indingeko zabantu makhaza kuqala.
summary: Omunye wabasekeli benhloko kahulumende uMnu. Arthur Mutambara uthi uhulumende weMelika kumele ethule izijeziso azethesa eleZimbabwe

title: 'Uqhubeke Esephula Amalungelo Oluntu Uhulumende Ngo2016'
content:
Abalwela amalungelo oluntu bathi uhulumende weZanu PF uqhubeke ehlukuluza uzulu lonyaka njalo engawahloniphi amalungelo oluntu.

Bathi ukubotshwa lokutshaywa kwabantu betshengisela ezitaladeni kuveze mgceke ukuthi uMongameli Mugabe kazimiselanga ukuwaqakathekisi amalungelo.

Izehlakalo zokuhlukuluzwa kukazulu lokwephulwa kwamalungelo akhe ngo2016 zigoqele ukubotshwa lokubotshwa kwamalunga emikhankaso etshiyeneyo egoqela iTajamuka/Sesijikile le#This Flag.

Isiphathamandla sebandla lePeople’s Democratic Party (PDP), uMnu. Edwin Ndlovu. utshele iStudio 7 ukuthi akulathemba lokuthi kungaba lenguquko kwezamalungelo oluntu ngomnyaka ozayo.

Amazwi kaNdlovu agcizelelwe yingcwethi kwezombusazwe, uMnu. Rejoice Ngwenya, othe ukwephulwa kwamalungelo abantu yiZanu PF kulakho ukudlondlobala ngamandla ngomnyaka ozayo.

“Umnyaka ka2017 weyame ukhetho, okutsho ukuthi sizabona ibandla leZanu PF lilola amahloka lezikhali zonke lihlukuluza uzulu ukuze alivotele,” kutsho uMnu. Ngwenya.
summary: Bathi ukubotshwa lokutshaywa kwabantu betshengisela ezitaladeni kuveze mgceke ukuthi uMongameli Mugabe kazimiselanga ukuwaqakathekisi amalungelo.

title: EleMelika: Abahlamuki beISIS Bahlela Ukuhlasela eSouth Africa
content:
Uhulumende wakweleSouth Africa usekhuthaze abantu bonke abakulelo lizwe ukuthi bengesabi kulandela isixwayiso esivele kuhulumende weMelika loweBhilitane esokuthi amalwecatsha awe ISIS ahlela ukuhlasela indawo ezitshiyeneyo ezithandwa yizizalwane zakwele Melika eJohannesburg le Cape Town okungafinyelela labe Zimbabwe.

Ngomgqibelo uhulumende wakweleMelika wethule umbiko exwayisa izizalwane zelizwe lakhe kwele South Africa ukuthi ziqaphele nxa zisethekelela indawo zokudla lempahla ezidumileyo kweleSouth Africa njengoba amalwecatsha e ISIS ehlela ukuhlasela lezo ndawo.

Lokhu kulandela umbiko owethulwe zinkokheli ze ISIS e Iraq zikhuthaza amalwecatsha azo ukuthi ahlasele kakhulu emhlabeni jikelele ngale inyanga egcwele kwabokholo lwesiMoslem abayibiza ngokuthi yi Ramadan. iRamadan le iqale lamhlanje izaze iyephela mhlaka 5 Ntulikazi.

IMelikake ithi ilolwazi olubambekayo ngenhlelo ze ISIS zokuhlasela kweleSouth Africa.

Loba kunjalo ugatsha lwezomvikela kweleSouth Africa luthi kungabi lomuntu owqethuswa yile imibiko ngoba abazomvikela kuleli bakulungele ukuvikela wonke umuntu elizweni ngaso sonke isikhathi.

Umnumnzana Brian Dube yisikhulumeli salolugatsha.

Kutsho uDube: “Sesifinyelele kusinqumo sokuthi okwamanje akulandingeko yokuthi kube lokwesaba elizweni. Yebo linto kasiyithathi kancane. Sizoqhubeka ngomsebenzi wethu wokubona ukuthi yiloba ngubani oselizweni uvikelekile.”

Kodwake osekubuye kwethusa abanengi yikuthi eleBritain lalo ngoMvulo lethule umbiko ufakazayo ukuthi i ISIS ihlela ukuhlasela kweleSouth Africa loba nini ikakhulu endaweni ezivame abavela phestheya.

Kodwa uDube uthi basebenzisana lengatsha zonke zamazwe atshiyeneyo eziliswa amalwe catsha ukuze kungabi lengozi eyehlela loba ngubani kweleSouth Africa.

“Sithola imibiko eminengi kakhulu lakwawethu amaviyo omvikela. Imbiko efana lale kufanele ihlolisiswe ukuze senqabele ukwesabisa uzulu kungelasizatho. Sisebenza labezomvikela bakwamanye amazwe kugoqela leMelika ngopba alikho ilizwe elingaqeda udlakela lwamalwecatsha lilodwa,” kutsho uDube.

Isizalwane seZimbabwe unkosikazi Florence Tapera, ohlala eJohannesburg uthe kabasakhululekanga loba sebengena ezitolo ngoba bengazi ukuthi lokhu kuhlasela kuzakuba nini.

“Eishh! Sifeeler nje engani there is i threat. So kufuze umuntu abe at least careful ukuthi ma uhamba uyahamba only when its necessary kuma Mall because siyayibona lento kunews, so akumelanga vele just nje siyi brashe aside kumele siyithathe serious,” kutsho uTapera.

Kakusikho kwakuqala ukwethulwa kwesixwayiso sokuthi i ISIS ihlela ukuhlasela kwele South Africa. Ngo 2009 iMelika yethula isixwayiso esifanayo kodwa akwenzakalanga lutho. Iphinde yethula esinye futhi nyakenye kodwa lokho kuhlasela akwenzakalanga.
summary: Loba kunjalo ugatsha lwezomvikela kweleSouth Africa luthi kungabi lomuntu owqethuswa yile imibiko ngoba abazomvikela kuleli bakulungele ukuvikela wonke umuntu elizweni ngaso sonke isikhathi.

title: Umkhokheli weARTUZ uMasaraure Uthunjiwe Ngabantu Ekade Behlome Ngemibhobho Phakathi Kobusuku
content:
Umkhokheli wenhlanganiso emela ababalisi bemaphandleni eyeAmalgamated Rural Teachers Union of Zimbabwe (ARTUZ), uMnu Obert Masaraure uthunjiwe ngabantu ekade behlome ngemibhobho ebusuku izolo.

Umkakhe uSabrina Kundai Masaraure utshele iStudio 7 ukuthi bangenelwe ngamadoda ayisithupha endlini yabo eseWaterfalls eHarare ahudula umyeni wakhe amfaka emoteni ahamba laye.

UNkosikazi Masaraure uthe njalo amadoda la kazange aziveze ukuthi angobani lokuthi afunani kumkakhe. Wengeze wathi amanye awo ebezivale ubuso.

Isehlakalo lesi siza ngemva kokukhalala umsebenzi kwamalunga enhlanganiso kaMasaraure ekhala ngeholo eliphansi njalo esithi kumele uhulumende awahlawulwe ngedola laseMelika.

Ukukhalala umsebenzi lokhu kuqale ngoMvulo kwaphela izolo.

Ngesikhathi ekhuluma lalumsakazo, uNkosikazi Masaraure uthe ubengakayimangala emapholiseni ngoba bekuphakathi kobusuku, ngakho ubesesaba ukuhamba yedwa.

Asenelisanga ukukhuluma lamapholisa ngaloludaba. Inengi lithi isehlakalo lesi siyethusa ngoba kulabanye abanengi abathunjwayo banyamalala kokuphela abafana loMnu Itai Dzamara.

Kusenjalo, enye njalo inhlanganiso yababalisi eyeZIMTA, ithi uhulumende kumele engezelele ababalisi iholo ngenkulungwane ezintathu zemali yamaRTGS njalo enye ibe ngeyedola leMelika.

Isiphathamandla seZIMTA uMnu Sifiso Ndlovu uthi ababalisi bathwele nzima ngoba imali abayiholayo ayibenelisi lutho.

title: Odokotela Abakhalala umsebenzi Bala Ukubuyela Emsebenzini
content:
Odokotela abasanda kuqalisa umsebenzi ama junior doctors abaphakathi kokukhalala umsebenzi balile ukubuyela emsebenzini namhla ngemva kokokhulumisana le Health Service Board. I board le ivumile ukuthi odokotela banikwe ama allowances ezindlu zokuhlala, impahla zomsebenzi, lokusebenza ebusuku wona ayesemisiwe.

Umnumzana Agostino Zacharias isikhulumi se United Nations Development Fund ephathisa izisebenzi zikahulumende uthembise ukuthi inhlanganiso yakhe isebenza gadala ukuthi odokotela bathole ama allowances la. Namhla besekulemibiko njalo yokuthi ama senior doctors ayiwo abeqhuba umsebenzi lawo asebambane lama junior doctors ukukhalala umsebenzi, kodwa bekungakacaci ukuthi kuziphi izibhedlela.

Omunye udokotela ophakathi kokukhala umsebenzi utshele iStudio 7 ukuthi sebeselaphela abagulayo ezindlini zabo bethola imali edlula i$50 U-S dollars ngamuntu. UBrenda Moyo weStudio 7 ukhulume lodokotela Samukeliso dube othi uhulumende weZimbabwe kumele akhulumisane labodokotela kulungisiswe izikhalazo zabo masinyane.

title: Abantu Abanengi Bathi Akulanhlelo Zokuthuthukisa Uzulu Emaphandleni
content:
Izakhamizi zeGwanda zithi uzulu wemaphandleni uncedwa zinhlanganiso ezizimeleyo ngoba uhulumende kenelisi ukuthuthukisa impilo yabo.

Lokhu kuphume emhlanganweni eGwanda ngoLwesibili oweTown Hall obuqoqwe ngumsakawo weVoice of America imanyane lenhlanganiso yeMedia Centre.

UNkosikazi Julieth Nkiwane, owenhlanganiso yabomama eyeWomen Development Association of Zimbabwe, uthi abaziboni inhlelo eziqhutshwa nguhulumende.

“Nxa kungasabuyanga iNGO ezosincedisa akula olunye uhlelo lukahulumende esilubonayo ngoba nxa sokubuya abanye abantu babuya belande abanye abantu, uhulumende nje ukuthi athi isigaba sami eseNqameni, isigaba sami seMatshetsheni, isigaba sami seBolamba isigaba sami esangaphi asikaluboni sisaludinga.”

Amazwi akhe agcizelelwe nguMnu. Bekezela Maduma Fuzwayo othi akula uhulumende asekwenzile ukuthuthukisa impilo zabantu bemaphandleni selokhu ilizwe labalozibuse.

“40 years sikuIndependence mina ngisuka eGwanda North, akumelanga ukuthi nga sichapha uMtshabezi onje akumelanga nga sihamba ngendlela esihamba ngazo sisiyakithi sikhuluma ngezikolo ezakhiwa ntolontolo ezibuya uphahla luthathwe ngumoya nxa kungasabuyanga amaNGO ezobambabamba akulalutho olwenzakalayo.”

UNkosikazi Lobukhosi Malila, ukhansila kaWard 4 eStanmore, uthi loba zikhona inhlelo eziqhutshwa nguhulumende, zisuka ziphambaniseke ngenxa yokusilela kwemali.

“Sibe sesikhangela ekudleni khonapho,ukudla kukhona emaphandleni kodwa kuyasilela ngoba lubuya lulabanikazi ukuthi lukhangele abadala, izigoga , abadubekileyo kube sekusithi inengi lisala ngaphandle ngoba abantu abathathwayo ngabantu abalutshwane.

Ukhansila kaWard 17 eFumukwe, uMnu. Ephraim Nyathi owebandla leZanu PF, uthi loba umnotho welizwe ungamanga kahle kukhona uhulumende akwenzayo ukunakekela impilo zabantu bemaphandleni.

“Loba sisebunzimeni obunjalo siyandosa kunjalo silwisana lakho ukuthi sikwenze njalo labangane bethu esithi ngama partners labo bayasifakela izandla kokunye okuyabe kuncedisa abantu bethu emakhaya.

UMnu. Khulekani Sithole, obona ngokuqhutshwa kwenhlelo zekhansili yemaphandleni, uthi babhekane lodubo lokusilela kwemali okudala ukuba inhlelo zabo zokunakekela uzulu wemaphandleni zingahambi kahle.

“Imigwaqo esihlanganisa lezinye iziqinti kanye laphakathi kwezigaba kusiya kwesinye uhulumende uphatheke kakhulu ekusixhaseni ekulungiseni imigwaqo ngemva kwezulu elike lana elesiqotho elalidiliza imigwaqo.”

Umsakazo weVoice of America usebenzelana labeMedia Centre unxusa abantu ukuthi baze emhlanganweni ofanayo eLupane ngoLwesithathu emini lapho okuzaxoxiswana ngodaba lombhuqazwe weGukurahundi.
summary: UNkosikazi Julieth Nkiwane, owenhlanganiso yabomama eyeWomen Development Association of Zimbabwe, uthi abaziboni inhlelo eziqhutshwa nguhulumende.

title: Amapholisa Ayalisa Abamasonto Ukutshengisela
content:
Amapholisa seyalise abamasonto koBulawayo ukutshengisela ngoLwesihlanu besola umthetho omutsha obamba abantwana besikolo ngamandla ukuthi bakhonze iflag yeZimbabwe.

Uhlelo lolu lusolwa kakhulu nguzulu esithi lwephula amalungelo abantwana besikolo.

Abamasonto laba bathi sebesungule umkhankaso okhuthaza abazali ukuthi balobele abaphathi bezikolo incwadi bebazisa ukuthi kabafuni abantwababo bafunge kumbe bakhonze iflag.

“Lincwadi iyabe itshela ke umphathi ukuthi umzali kavumeli umntwanakhe ukuthi abe yingxenye yohlelo lolu,” kutsho omunye wabafundisi abaqoqa umkhankaso lo uMnu Useni Sibanda.

Izikolo zivuliwe ngoLwesibili abantwana befungiswa ukukhonza iflag lokuhlonipha amaqhawe elizwe, njalo bethembisa ukuthi bazakuba ngabantu abathembekileyo.

Isifungo lesi, esisungulwe ngumphathintambo wezemfundo yaphansi uMnu Lazarus Dokora, sesicunule abantu abanengi abafuna sesulwe.

Amagqwetha abona ngokulondolozwa kwamalungelo oluntu labazali sebephikise isifungo lesi emthethwandaba wesisekelo sombuso.
summary: Abamasonto laba sebesungule umkhankaso okhuthaza abazali ukuthi balobele abaphathi bezikolo incwadi bebazisa ukuthi kabafuni abantwababo bafunge kumbe bakhonze iflag.

title: Izisebenzi Zikahulumende Ziyatshengisela Ngokuthula eHarare
content:

Kusenjalo, uMnu. Vusumuzi Mahlangu, isiphathamandla senhlanganiso yababalisi eye Progressive Teachers’ Union of Zimbabwe uthi inengi lezisebenzi zikahulumende koBulawayo lemaphandleni ezigabeni zeMatabelelandi sezimanyene lezikhalala umsebenzi.

title: Iza moa i Abduweli Ayup, mampiantrano ny kaonty Twitter @AsiaLangsOnline mandritra ny 26 nov - 2 Des 2019
content:
Ao anatin'ny fanentanana media sosialy hankalazana ny fimaroam-piteny an-tserasera manerana an'i Azia, hifandimby ireo mpikatroky ny teny sy mpanandrateny hitantana ny kaonty Twitter @AsiaLangsOnline isa-kerinandro hizara ny zava-niainany tamin'ny famelomana aina indray sy fampahafantarana ireo fitenin-drazany. Niarahan'ny Rising Voices, ny Digital Empowerment Foundation, ary ny O Foundation niasa ny fanentanana.

Isa-kerinandro dia hamaly fanontaniana maromaro momba azy ny mpampiantrano tsirairay ary hanome fomba fijery fohy momba ny fiteniny. Miaraka amin'i Abduweli Ayup (@abduwela) ny fanontaniana sy valiny etoana izay manolotra ny zavatra horesahiny mandritra ny herinandro amin'ny maha-mpampiantrano azy.

Rising Voices: lazalazao anay ny momba anao azafady.

I am Abduweli Ayup, a linguist and Uyghur rights activist from Kashgar, one of the oldest city on the ancient and modern silk road.

I mainly study Uyghur language, literature, and culture. I studied for my Master's degree in ancient Uyghur literature at Xinjiang University in 2000, and I also studied for my Master's degree in linguistics in 2009.

I started my mother language campaign in 2011, in Kashgar. I had two mother language kindergartens, one was in the city of Urumchi and another was in Kashgar. I gave several lectures on how to protect and preserve Uyghur language in Chinese legal pretexts. In 2013, I was imprisoned because of my mother language campaign.

Since 2016, I have been working on to preserve Uyghur language in the diaspora. I published two textbooks and some other teaching materials. I worked at two language schools and ran one in Ankara, Turkey. Now I am teaching at the Uyghur language school in Bergen, Norway. I am also continuing to write the next volume of my Uyghur textbook.

I am also the president of Uyghur Hjelp, an charity organization based in Norway.

Abduweli Ayup no anarako, mpitia teny sady Uyghur mpikatroky ny zo avy ao Kashgar, iray amin'ny tanàna antitra indrindra amin'ny lalan'ny lasoà tranainy sy maoderina. Mianatra fiteny, literatiora ary kolontsaina Uyghur aho.Nianatra aho hahazoako ny diplaoma Master tamin'ny literatiora Uyghur tranainy tao amin'ny Oniversite Xinjiang tamin'ny taona 2000, ary nianatra ihany koa aho hahazoako Master amin'ny fandinihana sy fampitahana ny teny samy hafa tamin'ny taona 2009. Nanomboka ny fanentanana ny tenindreniko aho tamin'ny taona 2011, tao Kashgar. Nanana fitenindreny roa aho tany amin'ny akaninjaza. ny iray tany an-tanànan'i Urumichi ary ny iray hafa tao Kashgar. Efa nanome fampianarana betsaka amin'ny fomba hiarovana sy hikolokoloana ny fiteny Uyghur ao anatin'ny ala tsiny ara-pitsarana shinoa. Tamin'ny taona 2013 aho nogadraina noho ny fanentanana tenindrazana nataoko. Hatramin'ny taona 2016 aho niasa hikolokoloana ny fiteny Uyghur any amin'ireo ampielezana. Namoaka boky fianarana roa sy fitaovana hafa fampianarana aho. Niasa tamin'ny sekoly roa fiteny aho ary namelona iray tao Ankara, Torkia. Ankehitriny aho mampianatra ao amin'ny sekolin'ny fiteny Uyghur ao Bergen, Norvezy. Eo am-panoratana ny dingana manaraka amin'ny boky fianarana fiteny Uyghur koa aho amin'izao fotoana izao. Izaho ihany koa ny filohan'ny Uyghur Hjelp, fikambanana iray mpanao asa soa miorina eto Norvezy.

RV: Manao ahoana ny fiteninareo ao amin'ny aterineto sy ivelan'ny aterineto?

My language is in danger. It has been used online and offline outside of China.

Tandindonin-doza ny fiteniko. Ampiasaina antserasera sy andavanandro ivelan'i Shina izy io.

RV: Lohahevitra manao ahoana avy no kasainao ifantohana mandritra ny herinandro hitantananao ny kaonty Twitter @AsiaLangsOnline?

I want to focus on imprisoned Uyghur intellectuals, revitalizing Uyghur language and culture outside of China, cultural dialogue between Uyghur and Han ethnic groups. I also want to focus on the the story of camp survivors, especially their memories from their time in prison.

Te-hifantoka amin'ireo Uyghur manampahaizana aho, hamelona indray ny fiteny sy kolontsaina Uyghur ivelan'i Shina, fifampiresahana ara-kolontsaina eo amin'ny vondrom-poko Uyghur sy Han.

RV: Inona no tena antony manosika anao amin'ny fikatrohana antserasera amin'ny fiteninao? Inona no fanantenanao sy ny nofinofinao ho an'ny fiteninao?

I have a strong feeling to speak the language because if not, it is going to die. I think it is important to keep the Uyghur language alive because it makes Uyghur feel united and encourages them to keep their identity.

Manana fahatsapana matanjaka aho hiteny ny fiteny fa raha tsy izany dia ho faty io. Mihevitra aho fa zavadehibe ny mitahiry ho velona ny fiteny Uyghur satria izany no mahatonga ny Uyghur hahatsapa ho tafaray sy mandrisika azy ireo hitahiry ny mari-panondroany.

title: IConstitutional Court Ilahla Udaba Lokuzama Ukukhipha uMugabe Esikhundleni
content:
NgoLwesithathu umthethwandaba waphezulu owe Constitutional Court ulahlele khatshana udaba luka Mnumzana Promise Mkhwananzi, umkhokheli inhlanganiso yeTajamuka-Sesijikile Campaign, alukhweze ecela idale ukuthi libambe ngamandla uMongameli Robert Mugabe ukuba atshiye isikhundla akiso njalo athoniswe amacala akhe okwephula amalungelo oluntu.

UMnumzana Gift Siziba, omunye wabakhokheli benhlanganiso yeTajamuka-Sesijikile koBulawayo, uthe umthethwandaba waphezulu owe Constitutional Court, ulahle udaba luka Mnumzana Promise Mkhwananzi, usithi akalabufakazi obeneleyo obungenza ukuthi leli libe licala ngempela elingathonisiswa umongameli welizwe ngalo.

USiziba uqhubeke esithi uMugabe uhlala ethethisa abakhuluma imbono eyehlukene leyakhe okugoqela abenhlanganiso yeTajamuka-Sisijikile.

Esephatha udaba lwesinqumo esithethwe ngumahluli weConstitutional Court sokulahla loludaba, uSiziba uthe basemukele ngokudana okukhulu ngoba akula ongakwaziyo ukuthi uMugabe wephula ilungelo likazulu weZimbabwe.

Uphinde wathi ingcwethi ezibona ngezemithetho eZimbabwe abasebenzela inhlanganiso ezizimeleyo ezifana leyamagqwetha eye Zimbabwe Lawyers Human Rights sebefakile esinye isicelo emthethwandaba oweHigh Court, ukuze bayikhangele okwesibili lindaba.

Kunjalo nje, uMfundisi Evan Mawarire unikezwe imvumo ngumahluli womthethwandaba weHigh Court, uJustice Clement Phiri sokuthi aphiwe ithuba lokuhlawula imali yesibambiso se bail, samakhulu amathathu amadola- $300.

Phezu kwalokho uMawarire kuzamele anikeze amapholisa awe Avondale Police Station eHarare ugwalo lwakhe lokuhambisa ipassport njalo kumele ayezibonisa emapholiseni manye kabili ngeviki.
summary: Umthethwandaba uthe udaba lolu luswele ubufakazi ngakho-ke kumele lulahlwe lidale leConstitutional Court.

title: Uhulumende Unika Imvumo Inhlanganiso Ezizimeleyo Ukuthi Zisebenze Elizweni
content:
Uhulumende usevumele inhlanganiso ezizimeleyo ukuthi zincedise abantu ngokudla lokunye. Inhlanganiso lezi zamiswa umsebenzi ngaphambilini kokhetho luka June 26 uhulumende ezethesa icala lokuthi zisekela amabandla ezombusazwe aphikisayo.

Lokhu kuzaletha injabulo kuzakhamizi zemaphandleni ngoba indlala isibhahile okwesabekayo. Uhulumende ubesechothozwe kakhulu zinhlanganiso ezilwela amalungelo oluntu lomhlaba jikelele ngokwalela inhlanganiso lezi ukwenza umsebenzi.

title: Ayidlule iCoronavirus Abantu Bakholise Amalungelo Engibapha Wona, Kutsho uMnangagwa
content:
UMongameli Emmerson Mnangagwa uthi ilizwe lizavulwa kancane-kancane njalo uthi abantu abazisebenzayo abagoqela abaphila ngokuthengisa kumele babhalise kuhulumende ukuze bavunyelwe ukuvula amabhizimusi abo.

Kodwa uthi okwamanje ukuvalwa kwelizwe ngenjongo yokuvikela ukumemetheka kweCoronavirus kuzaqhubeka kukuzinga lesibili (Level 2).

Embikweni awethule kumabonakude ngoLwesihlanu, uMnangagwa uxwayise uzulu ukuthi eqhubeke ethatha amanyano okuzivikela agoqela ukuvala amakhala lomlomo ngama-mask emphakathini kanye lokugeza izandla sikhathi sonke.

Uthe abantu kumele baphume ezindlini kuphela nxa kulesidingo esiqinileyo.

Wengeze wathi amabasonto sobevunyelwa ukukhonza, kodwa imibuthano yabo kumele ibe phansi kwabantu abangamatshumi amahlanu.

UMnangagwa uthe njalo abanikazi bezindlu sebevunyelwa ukuhlawulisa amaloja i-rent ebingabhadalwa kunyanga ezimbili ezedluleyo.

Ubonge eleChina ngokuqhubeka liphathisa eleZimbabwe ngezinto zokusebenzisa ukuzivikela kumkhuhlane weCovid-19.

Kodwa kazange aluphathe udaba lokutshaphazwa kwemali kahulumende yinkampani ebikwa ilobudlelwano lemuli yakhe eyeDrax International.

Kudaba olutshiye abanye bekhuza umhlola, uMnangagwa uthe umkhuhlane lo kumele udlule ukuze abantu bakholise amalungelo abawaphiwa nguhulumende wakhe agoqela ukukhuluma yiloba yini abakufunayo lokuvota kukhetho olukhululekileyo.

Ingcwethi kwezombusazwe uMnu Zenzele Ndebele utshele umsakazo weStudio 7 ukuthi lokhu kuyamangalisa ngoba ukwephulwa kwamalungelo oluntu nguhulumende kaMnangagwa kwaqala kudala iCoronavirus ingakafiki.

title: အာရပ္အဖြဲ႔ခ်ဳပ္ ေတာင္းဆိုခ်က္ ဆီးရီးယားပယ္ခ်
content:
ဆီးရီးယားသမၼတ ဘက္ရွာအယ္လ္အာဆတ္ က ဒုသမၼတကို အာဏာလႊဲေျပာင္းေပးေရး အာရပ္ႏိုင္ငံမ်ားအဖြဲ႔ခ်ဳပ္ရဲ႕ အစီအစဥ္ကို ဆီးရီးယားအစိုးရက ျပည္တြင္းေရးကို ၀င္ေရာက္စြက္ဖက္ဖို႔ ႀကိဳးပမ္းတဲ့လုပ္ရပ္ ျဖစ္တယ္ဆိုၿပီး လက္မခံဘဲ ပယ္ခ်လိုက္ပါတယ္။ အာရပ္အဖြဲ႔ခ်ဳပ္ရဲ႕ အဆိုျပဳခ်က္ဟာ ေျပာေျပာင္တင္းတင္း ၀င္ေရာက္ စြက္ဖက္တာလို႔ အစိုးရ တာ၀န္ရွိသူေတြရဲ႕ အေျပာကို ကိုးကားၿပီး ဆီးရီးယား ႏိုင္ငံပိုင္ ႐ုပ္သံကေန ဒီကေန႔ ထုတ္လႊင့္လိုက္ပါတယ္။

ဆီးရီးယားအစိုးရအေနနဲ႔ သီတင္းႏွစ္ပတ္အတြင္း ႏိုင္ငံတ၀ွမ္း အတိုက္အခံေတြနဲ႔ ေဆြးေႏြးေရးနဲ႔ ႏွစ္လအတြင္း အစိုးရသစ္ ဖြဲ႔စည္းေရး အာရပ္အဖြဲ႔ခ်ဳပ္ ႏိုင္ငံျခားေရး၀န္ႀကီးေတြက မေန႔က ေတာင္းဆိုလုိက္တာပါ။ အတိုက္အခံေတြနဲ႔ ေဆြးေႏြးျခင္းအားျဖင့္ လႊတ္ေတာ္နဲ႔ သမၼတ ေရြးေကာက္ပြဲေတြအတြက္ အစပ်ိဳးတဲ့သေဘာ သက္ေရာက္မွာျဖစ္တယ္လို႔ ဆိုပါတယ္။ ကာတာႏိုင္ငံျခားေရး ၀န္ႀကီး Hamad bin Jassim al-Thaniက အာရပ္အဖြဲ႔ခ်ဳပ္ရဲ႕ အစီအစဥ္ကို ကုလသမဂၢ လံုၿခံဳေရးေကာင္စီရဲ႕ ထပ္ဆင့္ ေထာက္ခံခ်က္ရေအာင္ ႀကိဳးပမ္းသြားမယ္လို႔ ဆိုပါတယ္။

တခ်ိန္တည္းမွာပဲ ေဆာ္ဒီႏိုင္ငံျခားေရး၀န္ႀကီး မင္းသားႀကီး Saud al-Faisal က ဆီးရီးယားမွာရွိတဲ့ အာရပ္အကဲခတ္အဖြဲ႔ကေန ေဆာ္ဒီကိုယ္စားလွယ္အဖြဲ႔ကို ႐ုပ္သိမ္းမယ္လို႔ ေၾကညာလိုက္ပါတယ္။ ဆီးရီးယားအေနနဲ႔ အာရပ္အဖြဲ႔ခ်ဳပ္ကို ေပးထားတဲ့ကတိေတြကို မလိုက္နာတဲ့အတြက္ ကန္႔ကြက္တဲ့သေဘာ ေဆာ္ဒီအာေရးဘီးယားႏိုင္ငံက အခုလုိ ဆံုးျဖတ္လိုက္တာျဖစ္တယ္လို႔ ေျပာပါတယ္။
summary: ဆီးရီးယား ဒုသမၼတကို အာဏာလႊဲေျပာင္းေပးဖုိ႔ အာရပ္ႏိုင္ငံမ်ား အဖြဲ႔ခ်ဳပ္ရဲ႕ ေတာင္းဆိုခ်က္ကို ဆီးရီးယားအစိုးရက ပယ္ခ်လိုက္ပါတယ္။

title: ေျမာက္ကိုရီးယားသံအမတ္ မေလးရွားႏွင္ထုတ္
content:
ေျမာက္ကုိရီးယားေခါင္းေဆာင္ Kim Jong Un ရဲ႕ အကုိ၀မ္းကြဲေတာ္သူ Kim Jong-Nam ကုိ မေလးရွားႏုိင္ငံ ကြာလာလမ္ပူၿမိဳ႕ ေလဆိပ္မွာ လုပ္ႀကံသတ္ျဖတ္ခံရၿပီးတဲ့ေနာက္ ႏွစ္ႏုိင္ငံအၾကား တင္းမာမႈေတြ ဆက္လက္ ျဖစ္ေပၚေနတာရဲ႕ ေနာက္ဆက္တြဲအျဖစ္ မေလးရွားက ေျမာက္ကုိရီးယား သံအမတ္ကုိ ေမာင္းထုတ္လုိက္ပါတယ္။

လုပ္ႀကံသတ္ျဖတ္မႈနဲ႔ဆုိင္တဲ့ မေလးရွားရဲ႕ စုံစမ္းစစ္ေဆးမႈေတြကုိ သံအမတ္ႀကီးက ေ၀ဖန္ ေျပာဆုိမႈေတြ လုပ္ေဆာင္ခဲ့ၿပီးတဲ့ေနာက္ သူ႔ကုိ သံတမန္အျဖစ္ မလုိလားအပ္သူအျဖစ္ သတ္မွတ္ေၾကာင္း မေလးရွား ႏုိင္ငံျခားေရးဌာနက ထုတ္ျပန္တဲ့ ေၾကညာခ်က္မွာ ေဖာ္ျပထားပါတယ္။

သံအမတ္ႀကီးကုိ အခုလုိ ေမာင္းထုတ္လုိက္တာဟာ ေျမာက္ကုိရီးယားအေနနဲ႔ သူတုိ႔ရဲ႕ တရားမ၀င္တဲ့ လုပ္ရပ္ေတြအတြက္ မေလးရွားကုိ အသုံးျပဳေနတယ္ဆုိတဲ့အေပၚ မေလးရွားအစုိးရအေနနဲ႔ စုိးရိမ္တဲ့အေၾကာင္း ျပသလုိက္တာျဖစ္တယ္လုိ႔ အဲဒီ ေၾကညာခ်က္မွာ ေဖာ္ျပထားပါတယ္။

သံအမတ္ႀကီး Kang Chol အေနနဲ႔ တုိင္းျပည္အတြင္းက ၄၈ နာရီအတြင္း ထြက္ခြာသြားဖုိ႔ စေနေန႔မနက္က ေျမာက္ကုိရီးယားသံရုံးကုိ မေလးရွားအစုိးရက အေၾကာင္းၾကားစာ ေပးပုိ႔ခဲ့တယ္လုိ႔ ဆုိပါတယ္။

တုိက္ခုိက္မႈအတြက္ ေျမာက္ကုိရီးယားအေနနဲ႔ ေတာင္းပန္ဖုိ႔ မေလးရွားဘက္က ေတာင္းဆုိခဲ့ေပမဲ့ တုံ႔ျပန္ခ်က္ တစုံတရာ မရခဲ့ဘူးလုိ႔လည္း ေၾကညာခ်က္မွာ ေဖာ္ျပထားါပတယ္။

Kim Jong-Nam ကုိေတာ့ အာရုံေၾကာထိခုိက္ေစတဲ့ အဆိပ္ဓာတုပစၥည္းေတြနဲ႔ လုပ္ႀကံ သတ္ျဖတ္ခဲ့တာ ျဖစ္ပါတယ္။ သတ္ျဖတ္မႈကုိ ေျမာက္ကုိရီးယားက က်ဴးလြန္ခဲ့ေၾကာင္း ေတာင္ကုိရီးယားက ျပစ္တင္ ေျပာၾကားခဲ့ပါတယ္။ ေျမာက္ကုိရီးယားကေတာ့ စုံစမ္း စစ္ေဆးမႈဟာ သူတုိ႔ရဲ႕ ရန္သူေတြက ႏုိင္ငံေရးအရ ရည္ရြယ္ရွိရွိ လုပ္ေဆာင္ျခင္းျဖစ္တယ္လုိ႔ ေျပာပါတယ္။

title: Thokozani Khupe: Siyayamukela Impumela Yokhetho Olusanda Kwenziwa eZimbabwe
content:
UNkoszana Thokozani Khupe, umkhokheli welinye lamacele ebandla leMovement for Democratic Change (MDC-T) uthi uyamukela amazwi kaMongameli Emmerson Mnangagwa ukuba kumele kubunjwe amakhomishini azimeleyo azohlolisisa udlakela oluqhamuke ngemva kokhetho kwabulawa abantu abayisithupha.

Kodwa uthe amakhomishini la kumele abunjwe lidale lephalamende.

UNkosazana Khuphe wethule lokhu emhlanganweni lentathelizindaba e weteleni yeHoliday Inn ngemva komhlangano webandla lakhe wokubonisana ngokumele kwenziwe ngemva kokhetho. Uthe ibandla lakhe alusekeli udlakela olwenzakala eZimbabwe.

“Nxa silensolo silandele ama channels aqondileyo ukuthi siyekhuluma ukuthi siyekutsho ukuthi insolo esizibonayo yilezi lalezi lalezi. Ku unfortunate ukuthi okwenzakeleyo kuze kuhlaselwe abantu libutho.

“… Kuthiwa kule Khomishini esifakiwe, sifuna ikhomishini icubungule udaba lolu, ilulungise ukwenzela ukuthi kungaphindi kwenzakale futhi.”

UMaKhuphe uthe njengoba ukhetho seluphelile ufisa ukuba ngabe uMnangagwa uqoqa umhlangano lawo wonke amabandla ezombusazwe aphatheke kukhetho, ukuze bakhulumisane ngentuthuko yelizwe.

Omunye wabathole isikhundla sokumela uzulu edale le phalamende, uNkosikazi Priscilla Misihayirambwi Mushonga, uthe usezoqhubekisela phambili ezinye zezikhalazo ayethe wazethula edale eledlule.

“Okukhulu into yami engihlezi ngikhuluma ngayo, isanitary wear, kumele sibuyele futhi siyekhuluma ngayo, akusebenzi ukuthi singathi silohulumende omutsha, abantwana bethu bengenelisi ukuya esikolo ngoba abala saniatary wear. Secondly, kumele sikhangele into le eye quarter system, bekumele iphele ngo2018 kodwa upresident wayevele evumelane lathi siqalisa ukwenza into zethu zokukhuluma njengabomama, wathi into leyi uzayi extenda, uzavumelana lathi ukuthi ku extendwe. Yiyona nto yakuqala leyo engizokwenza ukuthi umthetho uguqulwe,iqhubekiselwe phambili leyo ndaba ye quarter.”

Uthi uzophakamisa njalo udaba lokutholiswa kwabesifazane amathuba wokungena kwezombusazwe hatshi ngokukhethwa yinkokheli yesilisa emabandleni kodwa bekhethwa ngabenye babo.

Abe MDC-T ekhokhelwa nguMaKhuphe bathi leli lithuba alitholisiweyo uMnangagwa ukumanyanisa ilizwe ukuze lisebenze ndawonye ukuthuthukisa umnotho lesimo kungakhangelanwa ngemihlobo kumbe indawo.

Abezombusazwe kanye laye uzulu uyakhuthazwa ukuba asebenze ndawonye ukuqhubekisela ilizwe phambili hatshi ukube lokhe kudonselanwa.
summary: “… Kuthiwa kule Khomishini esifakiwe, sifuna ikhomishini icubungule udaba lolu (olodlakela), ilulungise ukwenzela ukuthi kungaphindi kwenzakale futhi.”

title: 'Kasisoze Silandela Okukhulunywa NguNelson Chamisa Ofuna Sibuyele eZimbabwe'
content:
Ezinye izizalwane zeZimbabwe ezihlala kwemanye amazwe zithi kazikazimiseli ukubuyela ekhaya okwamanje.

title: Kubuthana Abantu Abedlula 200 Emhlanganweni weWomen of Dominion
content:
Impelasonto edluleyo ibe ngemnandi kumakholwa esiKrestu adabuka eZimbabwe asehlala kwele Melika ababuthene bekhonza uNkulunkulu wabo becula ingoma zokholo njalo bethola intshumayelo, ukudla kwendlebe lomoya, okubisela imicabango yabo ngempilo yasekhaya.

Umuntu ongabe wayelalele ukuxoxa kwabantu becula wawuzakuthi enxenye ngabantu abaphuma ecaweni kweinye indawo eseZimbabwe ikantike ca, lapho kusedolobheni leCincinnati, eOhio, lapho okubuthene abadabuka eZimbabwe abedlula amakhulu amabili inengi labo kungabesifazana abeze emhlanganweni wamakholwa esiKrestu womnyaka owe 4th annual Women of Dominion Conference. kwabanengi abadabuka eZimbabwe abahlala kweleMelika lokhu kwenzeka kuphela nxa kuthe kwaba lemfa kumbe umtshado.

AmaZimbabwe aze ngobunengi besuka endaweni ezehlukeneyo zeUSA, emhlanganweni lo wensuku ezintathu obuthanise abantu abeze lemithwalo yabo lezanhluphe ukuzodinga umusa ukucebisana, ukukhulekelwa lokukenje babelekele ubunzima bempilo usemazweni.

Kube lokufakaza okuthile lokwabelana amacebo emhlanganawenilo obuphansi kwesihloko esithi “Ebenezer siyabonga Nkosi onomusa, lapho osifikise khona namhlanje………..

Abanengi abeze eOhio, babuye ngamabhasi, abanye betshayela izimotha zabo, abanye njalo ngendizamtshina, besiza abanye Labantwana, abangane, abemhuli labomakhelwane.

Inengi belifakaza ukusindiswa elikwenziwe emhlanganweni lowo okokuthi ngomnyaka ozayo kabafuni kukhuthwa yiwo.

Abanye abakade bekhona babalisa abavele kwele South Africa lase Zimbabwe, abafana loNkosikazi Anne Thokozani Ncube ongusomabhizimusi ophumelelayo okwamagama owake wahlala laye emazweni.

AmaZimbabwe amanengi ahlala emazweni athi imihlangano enje iyabanika ithuba lokuhlanganela labanye becebisana, betshelana inhlupho zabo, ukukhuluma nje ulimi lwabo ilanga lonke kungela sikhiwa, ukucula ingoma abzejweleyo, ukudla abakuthandayo lokukhulekelana nje ukuze kubasondeze eNkosini.
summary: Laba bantu inengi labo kungabomama babuthane edolobheni leCincinnati, eOhio, eMelika emhlanganweni wabomama oweWomen of Dominion owenziwa minyaka yonke.

title: Ukususwa KukaMbeki Ukuba Ngumongameli Kungaphazamisa Inkulumo Na?
content:
Inkulumo phakathi kukaMongameli Mugabe lenkokheli yamacele womabili eMDC, oMnu Morgan Tsvangirai lo Arthur Mutambara zikhangelelwe ukuqala njalo eHarare ngeviki ezayo uMugabe sephendukile emhlanganweni weUnited Nations.

Bobathathu bazahlangana bekhuluma ngodaba lokwabelana izikhundla zedale leCabinet.

Kulandela ukumiswa umsebenzi kuka Mnu Thabo Mbeki ukuba nguMongameli weSouth Africa sokusesatshelwa ukuthi inkulumo zeZimbabwe zingaphazamiseka.

Kodwa umanyano weSadc, onikeze uMbeki umlandu wokuba ngumlamulankunzi kudaba lweZimbabwe, uthi ufuna uMbeki aqhubeke. Yena uMbeki ngokwakhe kakatsho lutho ngaloludaba.

Sokusesatshelwa kodwa ukuthi njengoba engasengu Mongameli, abeZanu PF labeMDC balakho ukumeyisa bengasamnanzi.

Kulokwesabela njalo ukuthi ibandla lika Mbeki eleANC lilakho ukungenela kudaba lwakhe lokuba ngumlamulankunzi, okungabangela ukuthi ecine esehluleka ukuwufeza ngokugcweleyo umsebenzi wakhe eZimbabwe.

title: 'Ukutshaywa Kwamalunga Edale Lephalamende Ngabasekeli BeZanu PF Kulihlazo'
content:
Amalunga edale lephalamende aqalise ngoMvulo ukucwayisisa ngodlakela olubekhona kulelidale ngoMgqibelo lapho abasekeli beZanu PF abatshaye khona amalunga alelidale kanye lentathelizindaba.

UMeli weHwange Central njalo elilunga leMDC ekhokhelwa nguMnu Morgan Tsvangirai, uMnu Brian Tshuma ngomunye wabalimelayo kulesisehlakalo wathathelwa imali lomakhalekhukwini wakhe.

Abasekeli beZanu PF laba babikwa behlukuluze njalo umeli weMakonde ephalamende uRisipa Kapesa oweZanu PF, kodwa bathi ngokunanzelela ukuba ungomunye wabo, bamekela.

Amalunga ephalamende akuThematic Committee on Human Rights kanye laweJustice and Legal Affairs Committee awedale lephalamende ehluza udaba lokuthi uzulu ufuna iHuman Rights Commission isebenze njani.

Umlawuli wedale uMnu Lovemore Moyo ubikwa enze imihlangano lomabhalane walelidale uMnu Austine Zvoma ngoMvulo, amapholisa lamaCIO bekhulumisana ngaloludaba.

Lanxa amapholisa ayekhona udlakela lolu lusenzakala, akulamuntu owabotshwayo.

Isikhulumeli seMDC ekhokhelwa nguMnu Welshman Ncube, uMnu Nhlanhla Dube uthe kulihlazo kakhulu okwenzakeleyo, esithi bafuna labo abeza lesisiga babotshwe.

Amazwi kaDube agcizelelwe ngumsekeli wesikhulumeli seMDC ekhokhelwa nguMnu Morgan Tsvangirai, uNkosazana Thabitha Khumalo.
summary: Abasekeli beZanu PF laba bangene ephalamende ngoMgqibelo bahlukuluza amalunga njalo batshaya kakubi umeli weHwange Central

title: Izakhamizi zeHurungwe West:Sizomsekele uMliswa Angancintisa eyiIndependent
content:
Izakhamizi zeHurungwe West esabelweni se Mashonaland West zibikwa zingajabuliswa linyathelo elithethwe libandla leZanu PF lokuxotsha umnumzana Temba Mliswa ebandleni yena engonanga lutho. Abasekeli beZanu PF laba babikwa besithi bafuna uMliswa ukuthi acintise kukhetho lweBye-election ezimele nxa kuthe kwadingeka ukuthi lwenziwe njalo bazamsekela.

Lokhu kuphume emhlanganweni owenziwe kulesi sigaba lapho amalunga eZanu PF ekubeke sobala ukuthi azosekela uMliswa nxa engancintisa ezimele ngemva kokuxotshwa kwakhe ebandleni kumaviki amabili edluleyo.

USobhuku Modekai Chareya nguye obikwa esungule udaba lukaMliswa ngokuthi kasukume emhlanganweni lowo azise umhlangano ukuthi uyemukela na ukuncintisa kulolu khetho engameli bandla kodwa emela uzulu njenge Independent. UMliswa ubikwa evumile phambi kukazulu ukuthi uzoncithisa kulolu khetho njengokucelwa kwakhe ngabantu beHurungwe West abathi balethemba lobukhokheli bakhe.

Lumhlangano ungenwe ngabagcinizihlalo benhlangothi zabasakhulayo lezabesifazana eziqintini ezilitshumi lathoba minwe mibili, induna zalumango osobhuku Kanye labalwa impi yenkululeko.

Umhlangano weHurungwe West wenzelwe esikolweni seKarambazuntu uhlose ukuthakazalela ukuphumelela emihlolisweni kwabantwana besikolo lesi ngesilinganiso esiphezulu esabelweni seMashonaland West kodwa ucine usuhluza indaba zombusazwe. Abantu bacina beveza ukungaphathwa kuhle ngokwenzakala ebandleni leZanu PF langokungena kwezombusazwe komkakhe kamongameli unkosikazi Grace Mugabe obangele ukuxotshwa kweziphathamandla ezinengi ebandleni lakuhulumende okugoqela unkosikazi Joice Mujuru, uMliswa labanye.
summary: Izakhamizi lezi zibikwa zingajabuliswa linyathelo elithethwe yiZanu PF lokuxotsha uMnu. Temba Mliswa ebandleni yikhoke zithi zifuna acintise ezimele kukhetho ukuze zimvotele

title: Bayahlupheka Abantu Emazweni Amanengi Okumemetheka Igcikwane leCoronavirus
content:
Bathithibele abantu emazweni atshiyeneyo ngokumemetheka kwegcikwane leCoronavirus emhlabeni wonke jikelele.

Bakhala ngokumemetheka kwegcikwane leCoronavirus kwele Bhilithane, eMelika, Canada, South Africa, Zimbabwe lakwamanye amazwe.

USipho Phakathi, odabuka eZimbabwe ohlala eLondon, uthi sokusethusa ukukhwehlela emphakathini.

Uthi sokumiswe imidlalo yemincintiswano yenguqu kuzwekazi leEurope. Banengi ababhekane lomkhuhlane lo abagoqela uNkosazana Khanyi, osebenza kwezempilakahle ePennsylvania kwele Melika.

UNkosazana Khanyi uthi labagcinwe ezindlini zabantu asebekhulile kulemithetho emitsha yokubagcina.

Okwethulwe nguNkosazana Khanyi kusekelwe nguNkosikazi Sichasiselo Ndlovu osebenza eMaryland kwele Melika.

Bethuke okufanayo abantu kwele Zimbabwe osokuvinjwe imitshado, imihlangano kazulu njalo lombukiso walonyaka oweZimbabwe International Trade Fair. Kulabanye abantu asebelahlekelwe ngamabhizimusi abanjenge mbongi kazulu uObert Dube.

Uthi abanye abantu balakho ukudala amacala ngenxa yomkhuhlane lo.

Sokuvinjwe indawo zokudlela, izikolo, imicimbi, ezemidlalo lokunye emazweni atshiyeneyo emhlabeni wonke jikelele. Akwaziwa ukuthi umkhuhlane lo uzaphela kumbe uzabamba abantu abanengi.

title: I CPJ Isola Amapholisa Ngokudinga Ukubopha Umhleli WeThe Zimbabwean
content:
Inhlanganiso ekhankasela ukulondolozwa kwamalungelo entathelizindaba emhlabeni wonke jikelele eyeCommittee to Protect Journalists sisole amapholisa ngokudinga ukubopha umhleli wephephandaba le The Zimbabwean uMnu Wilf Mbanga.

Iphepha leli lidinda lise United Kingdom lapho uMbanga ahlala khona.

Amapholisa athi uMbanga wadinda udaba lwamanga ngo 2008 ephepheni lakhe olwalukhuluma ngokubulawa kwesinye isiphathamandla seZimbabwe Electoral Commission nguhulumende kaMongameli Mugabe.

Kodwa uMbanga uyakulandula lokhu, esithi iphephandaba lakhe alizange lidinde udaba olunje. I CPJ ithi amapholisa kumele ayesule i arrest warrant ayifakele umbanga.

Isiphathamandla seMedia Institute of Southern Africa uMnu Nhlanhla Ngwenya utshele iStudio 7 ukuthi inhlanganiso yakhe layo iyalisola inyathelo lamapholisa.

title: Abaphila Lesimo Sejwabu Elingena Ilanga eseAlbinism Bakhala Ngokuswela Amafutha Okugcoba
content:
Abaphila lesimo sejwabu elingena ilanga eseAlbinism bathi ayikho inguquko empilweni yabo ngoba naku inengi labo llokhu lisehluleka ukufinyelela ukuthenga amafutha okumele bawasebenzise kungenxa yomumo womnotho ongamanga kuhle okwenza bengenelisi intengo yawo.

U Nkosazana Gwenlister Mushonga okhokhela inhlanganiso yabaphila lesimo sejwabu lesi, eye Alive Albinism Initiative uthi noma sebeleminyaka leminyaka belwela amalungelo abaphila leAlbinism isimo lokhe sizifananela lalapho ebe sikhona iminyaka emine kumbe emihlanu edluleyo osokufaka impilakahle yabo engozini.

“Inyanga Inye ngainye kumbe phakathi kwenyanga ezimbili silahlekelwa ngumuntu ole Albinism ngenxa ye sifo semvunguzane esihlasela ijwabu labo I skin cancer ngoba bengazi ukuzivikela ngokiswela ulwazi le mali izilonda zize zikhule ziphazamise umzimba wabo,” kutsho uMushunga.

Uthi abantu abaphila le Albinism balamafutha abamele behlale belawo bewasebenzisa ukuzivikela emalangabini awelanga eliyilona isitha sabo esikhulu ngaphandle kokukhangelelwa phansi nguzulu.

Unkosazana Gamuchirai Uzande ophila lalesisimo uthi inkinga yikuthi amafutha akhona sibili kodwa intengo yawo kayifinyelelelwa ngabanengi.

“Amafutha akhona aya dula sibili .Ungakhangela ama futha la abiza I mali efika kumbe ukwedlula ku makhulu amathathu 300 dollars okuyimbodlela okuncane okungatsholutho , pho umuntu osemaphandleni njengomzekeliso angawenelisa na ona edingakala ukuba uwasebenzise nsuku zonke?” kubuza uZande.

UMn. Petro Kamacho olwela amalungelo abale Albinism eloba izingwalo uthi lasemizini esihleli kiyo kulodubo lokubandlulula abale albinism okuyinto emele iphele.Uthi impendulo kunkinga zabo yikubasekela ukuba beziphilise benelise ukuzigcina.

“Kuyadingakala ukuthi abantu abanje bephathiswe ngendlela engenza ukuba bezinakekele ikakhulu ukusungula ama self help projects angabahlanganisa ndawonye bethole inzuzo beziholise benelise ukuthenga lamafutha abo ngoba bengabantu afana nje labanye abantu abenelisa ukuzisebenzela,” kutsho uKamacho.

Asenelisanga ukubamba umphathintambo obona ngezokunakekelwa kwabantu kodwa uhulumende uthi usekulolongeni umthetho ovumeza ukuba amafutha adingakala ngabantu abale Albinism enelise ukungena elizweni kungela mbadalo yomthelo owe duty ukuze lentengo yawo ibe nganeno lapho isithengiswa emavinkilini athengisa imithi eyamaPharmacy.

Inhlolisiso enziwe ngabenhlanganiso eye Alive Albinism Initiative iveza ukuba phakathi kwabantwana abazinkulungwane ezine ezikolo eZimbabwe, oyedwa utholakala ele Albinism njalo leli nani lisengezelelela ikakhulu ezikolo ezisemaphandleni.

title: Ukhansila weMDC Alliance 'Owabulawa Nguhulumende' Ungcwatshiwe eKaroi
content:
Obengukhansila weMDC Alliance kuWard 4 eKaroi uMnu Lovender Chiwaya, ungcwatshiwe ngoLwesithathu.

Ibandla leli lithi uChiwaya wabulawa nguhulumende. Kodwa iziphathamandla zikahulumende ziyakulandula lokhu.

UMnu Chiwaya uvaleliswe yiziphathamandla zebandla lakhe ezinengi ezigoqela uMnu Amos Chibaya labasekeli balo abangena kumakhulu.

I-MDC Alliance ithi ifuna udaba lolu luphenywe kabanzi njalo kubotshwe labo abambulalayo.

UChiwaya watholakala efile duzane lendlu yakhe ngeviki edluleyo.

Amapholisa ethule umbiko esithi phambilini kokubhubha kwakhe, uMnu Chiwaya wabonakala enatha utshwala labangane bakhe.

Athe njalo lapho atholakala efele khona kwakungela zibonakaliso zokulwisana.

Isikhulumeli samapholisa uMnu Paul Nyathi utshele iStudio 7 ukuthi basaphenya loludaba.

Kodwa umgcinisihlalo weMDC Alliance uNkosazana Thabitha Khumalo yena utshele lumsakazo ukuthi lanxa uhulumende ekulandula, abalakuthandabuza ukuthi nguye owabulala ukhansila wabo.

title: Reunion: Mavitrika mibilaogy
content:
(Marihana fa efa tamin'ny volana Septambra taona 2006 ny lahatsoratra teny Anglisy)

Manakaiky an'i Repoblika Demokratikan'i Kongo, iray amin'ireo tontolon'ny bilaogy mavitrika indrindra ao amin'ny firenena miteny Frantsay i Reunion, Departemanta Frantsay am-pitandranomasina miorina ao amin'ny Ranomasimbe Indiana ao Atsinanan'i Afrika. Manazava ny fomba fiasa mavitrika na maneho izany ny vavahadiin-tseraserany Reunion Permanente. Manaraka hatrany ireo bilaogeran'i Reunion am-pitandranomasina, tahaka an'i Sandy ao amin'ny Reunion-USA2 izay monina ao Etazonia mihitsy aza ny vavahadin-tserasera; miezaka manazava ny fomba fijeriny mikasika ny kolontsaina Amerikana ny bilaogy Reunion-USA2. Mpiserasera malaza manokana monina ao amin'ny nosy i Pierrot Dupuy, izay manana bilaogy ahitana vaovao farany hatrany isan'andro mifantoka amin'ny raharaha ankehitriny ao amin'ny nosy sy Maorisy mpifanolo-bodirindrina mahaleotena. Bilaogera hafa, Jean-Paul, mamintina ny vaovao lehibe ao amin'ny nosy ao amin'ny bilaoginy Dijoux.re isaky ny Alahady.

Fahasahiranana vao haingana tao amin'ny vaovaon'ny firenena sy ny bilaogy ny fielezan'ny aretina Chikungunya eo an-toerana sy ny voka-dratsiny eo amin'ny fizahantany, ny fikorianan'ny tain'afotroa matetika miseho miharihary ao amin'ny volokano eo an-toerana izay mampiseho sary amin'izany hatrany ilay bilaogera Audrey monina ao Frantsa ary manana ny bilaogy Reunion Passion. Naelin’ ny Zarabes, bilaogin'ny vondrom-piarahamonina miozolomana Indiana eo an-toerana tamin'ny bilaogy ihany koa ny tantara kolikoly vao haingana mahasaringotra manampahefana ao an-toerana Samia Badat. (Mampihomehy fa araka ny fanazavan'ny lehiben'ny bilaogy, ny voambolana kreôla Zarabes izay ampiasaina ao amin'ny nosy mba hanondroana ny ankamaroan'ny mponina miozolomana Indiana dia avy amin'ny voambolana Frantsay manondro ny Arabo.) Ary tsy tokony mahagaga raha lohahevitra miverimberina ny fifandraisana feno fihenjanana indraindray amin'i Frantsa, anisan'izany ny tolona mahomby manohitra ny fahazarana manavakavaka amin'ny fampiantranoana atao ao amin'ny tanibe Frantsa amin'ireo olom-pirenena Frantsay am-pitandranomasina avy any Reunion, Martinika, Goadelopy, Guyane sy ireo faritany sy departemanta am-pitandranomasina Frantsay.

Tamin'ireo songadina tamin'ny herinandro, Jean-Paul ao amin'ny Dijoux.Re, nanolotra vaovao farany momba ny volokano tao an-toerana, izay mbola mipoitra ka sakanan'ny manampahefana nandritra ny roa taona farany ireo mponina ao an-toerana mba tsy hijery izany zava-mitranga izany. Mikasika ny Chikungunya indray, nanazava ilay bilaogera fa biôlôjista roa no nampifandray vakisiny miady amin'ny bonibony (anti-rubeole) amin'ny fitsaboana mety azo atao. Mandritra izany, tamin'ny fanazavana mazava kokoa, Sandy monina any Etazonia manana ny bilaogy Reunion-USA2 nanazava ny dikan'ny horonatsarimihetsika tantaram-pitiavana ara-poko ao Amerika “Something New“.

(Sary eo ambony: Fipoahan'ny Volokano 2004, Reunion, avy amin'i Hugo aka Hughes Leglise.)

title: Sesiqalisile Ukuhamba Isitimela Esisuka eFrancistown Sisiya koBulawayo
content:
Isitimela esihamba phakathi kwedolobho lako Bulawayo leFrancistown sisungule uhambo lamuhla, osekuthokozise izihambi, ngesikhathi zilungiselela ukuphindela ekhaya ngekhefu leKhisimusi.

Isitimela sezihambi sisuke edolobheni leFrancistown ngehola lesikhombisa lamhla ekuseni, silubhekise koBulawayo.

Isikhulumi sikaloliwe weBotswana Railways (BVR), uMnu. Kebabonye Moreowagae, utshele iStudio 7 ukuthi isitimela lesi silamatolokisi ayaziwa ngokuthi yi-standard kuphela, njalo siyabe sisuka eFrancistown sisiya edolobheni lako Bulawayo nsukuzonke.

Amatolokisi la amatsha asanda kuthengwa kwele Melika emavikini.

UMoreowagae uthe isitimela sizaphakama eFrancistown ngehola lesikhombisa ekuseni nsuku zonke, sikhangelelwe ukuthi sizafika koBulawayo ngehola letshumi lambili emini.

Sizahamba sisima endaweni ezifana lePlumtree le Figtree.

Sizabuyela edolobheni leFrancistown sisuka koBulawayo ngehola lesithathu, siyefika kwele Botswana ngehola lesitshiyagalo mbili ntambama.

Okuthabise inengi yikuthi ukuhamba ngesitimela kulula ngoba kabasozwe bafole kundwendwe eziba khona emngceleni wePlumtree leRamokgwebana.

UMnu. Andreas Sibanda wamukele kakhulu isitimela lesi.

“Ukuphenduka kwesitimela siyakuthakazelela ikakhulu ngalesi sikhathi kulesiphithi phithi emngceleni. Uma uhamba ngesitimela akula kwehla emngceleni, konke kusenziwa phakathi.”

UNkosikazi Emily Tshuma laye uthe nomanje besamukela isitimela, bekungabangcono uma kungafakwa amatolokisi empahla ngoba inengi leZimbabwe livame ukuthwala impahla enengi.

“Kuyinto enhle ukufaka isitimela ngoba ungena uhlale uze uyewela ekhaya, ebesikucela yikuthi bafake amatolokisi emphahla.”

Isitimela salamuhla besithwele iziphathamandla zenkampani yeNational Railways of Zimbabwe leye Botswana Railways.

Ukusungulwa kohambo lwesitimela kuzanceda kakhulu abantu beZimbabwe abathenga impahla kwele Botswana, besiyathengisa ekhaya.

Kukhangelelwe ukuthi ukungena kwesitimela kwehlise inani elisebenzisa umngcele wePlumtree leRamokgwebana wona ominyana okwamagama ikakhulu ngamakhefu afana lawe Khisimusi.
summary: Isitimela sezihambi sisuke edolobheni leFrancistown ngehola lesikhombisa ngoMvulo ekuseni silubhekise koBulawayo.

title: Kuqhamuka Udlakela eMelika Kulandela Ukubulawa Komuntu Onsundu Lipholisa Elimhlophe
content:
Kuqhubekela phambili ukutshengisela kwabantu kwele Melika osokucelwe amasotsha ukuthi angenele kwezinye izabelo kulandela ukubulawa kabuhlungu komuntu onsundu, uGeorge Floyd, eMinneapolis.

Abansundu abazonde okumangalisayo sebephathisana labanye abamhlophe abazonda ubandlululo. Sokubhidlizwe izakhiwo endaweni ezinengi njalo kwabulawa ipholisa kweyinye indawo.

Abasekela ubandlululo abakunhlanganiso ezitshiyeneyo labo sebengenele kudaba lolu bachaphaza izakhiwo ezinengi eziveza inkululeko yabantu abansundu.

UMongameli Donald Trump uthi kumele izabelo zisebenzise ibutho ukwenzela ukumisa udlakela emadolobheni atshiyeneyo.

Kulabanye abatshengisele lesigodlweni sikamongameli abagijimisane lamapholisa ngoMgqibelo kusihlwa.

Obulele uFloyd usebotshiwe wetheswa icala lokubulala umuntu mahlayana.

Izabelo osoluqhamuke udlakela zigoqela eGeorgia, Kentucky, Ohio, Wisconsin, Colorado, Utah, Washington, California, Tennessee, Missouri leTexas.

Kusenjalo, uyamethetheka umkhuhlane weCoronavirus COVID-19 kuzwekazi leAfrica kulabanye abantu abacabanga ukuthi umkhuhlane lo uzabulala abantu abanengi nxa ungavinjwanga ngemfanelo. (VOA NEWS)

title: Sambany i Iceland Mitomany Taorian’ny Namonoan’ny Polisy Lehilahy Iray · Global Voices teny Malagasy
content:
Polisy ao Reykjavik, Iceland. Sary an'i Christopher Porter tao amin'ny flickr (CC BY-NC-ND 2.0)

Nivoaka voalohany tao amin'ny PRI.org tamin'ny 03 Desambra ity lahatsoratra ity sy ny tatitra iray avy amin'i Traci Tong tao amin'ny onjampeo The World, ary naverinay navoaka ao anatin'ny fifanarahana fifampizaràna votoaty.

Lohateny lehibe tsy mbola nisy toa azy tao Iceland tamin'ity herinandro ity — lehilahy iray notifirin'ny polisy ho faty.

“Tohina ny firenena iray manontolo. Tsy mitranga eto amin'ny firenentsika io,” hoy i Thora Arnorsdottir, tonian'ny famoaham-baovaon'ny RUV, ny Onjampeom-Pirenena ao Iceland.

Ilay lahiantitra 59 taona izay maty notifirin'ny polisy tamin'ny Alatsinainy no tiany holazaina eto. Tany aloha ilay lehilahy, izay nanomboka nitifitra ireo polisy rehefa niditra ny trano nisy azy, dia efa nànana tantaranà aretin-tsaina.

Sambany izao no nisy olona iray maty notifirin'ny polisy mitam-piadiana tao Iceland hatramin'ny naha-repoblika mahaleotena azy tamin'ny 1944. Raha ny mahazatra dia tsy mitondra fitaovam-piadiana akory aza ny polisy. Azo ambara ho toy ny tsy misy mihitsy ny herisetra ao Iceland.

“Tsy tian'ilay firenena ny hahita ny polisiny hivimbina fitaovam-piadiana satria mampidi-doza no sady mahatahotra izany,” hoy i Arnorsdottir. “Singa ao anatin'ny kolontsaina izany. Fitondra mihàza ny basy, ho toy ny manao fanatanjahantena, fa tsy hahita basy velively ianao na iray aza.”

Raha ny marina, tsy hoe mankahala ny basy i Iceland. Raha jerena amin'ny isan'ny olona mitàna basy, faha-15 no laharan'i Iceland maneran-tany. Kanefa,tsy fahita mihitsy ity tranga ity ka nahatonga ireo mpifanolo-bodirindrina tamin'ilay lehilahy maty voatifitra hampitaha ilay fifampitifirana amin'ireny sarimihetsika amerikana ireny.

Nilaza ny departemantan'ny polisy ao Iceland fa handalo manoloana ny filankevitry ny alahelo ireo manampahefana tafiditra tamin'izy iny. Sady efa naneho fialantsiny tamin'ny fianakavian'ilay lehilahy maty ny departemantan'ny polisy — na dia tsy dia nilaina loatra aza izany satria tsy nisy hadisoana nataon-dry zareo.

“Heveriko fa feno fanajàna ry zareo,” hoy i Arnorsdottir , “satria tsy misy olona maniry hanaisotra ny ain'ny olona iray hafa izany. “

Mbola misy anefa ny fanontaniana maro ilàm-baliny, isan'ireny ny antony tsy nanandraman'ny polisy nifampiraharaha tamin'ilay lehilahy aloha talohan'ny nidirana tao an-tranony.

“Ampahany iray amin'ny zava-dehibe eto amin'ity firenena ity ny fahafahanao miditra any amin'ny parlemanta ka ny hàny zavatra tokana takian-dry zareo aminao dia ny mba hamonoanao ny findainao, mba tsy hanakorontananao ireo parlemantera mandritra ny resak'izy ireo. Tsy mba manana mpiambina mitam-piadiana izany izahay hoe hanaraka ny praiminisitray na ny filoha. Ampahany iray amin'ireo zavatra goavana azo amin'ny fiainana anaty fiarahamonina milamina izany. Tsy tianay hiova izany”.

title: Izinto Zokulimisa Ziyasilela
content:
Laloba abalimi bekhangelelwe ukuba sebeqalisile ukuphendula umhlabathi belungiselela ukulima, kubikwa kungela malungiselelo alohlonzi enzakalayo elizweni jikelele ngoba kulokusilela kwenhlanyelo lemvundiso. Ngalokhu, abalimi sebesesabela ukuthi isivuno somnyaka ozayo sizasilela, okuzabangela ukuthi indlala iqhubeke isidla ubhedu.

Bathi njalo ukuphuza kwezulu kungaba kuveza sobala ukuthi lezulu lalo lizasilela lonyaka. Ngenxa yesivuno sanyakenye esibe sincane, inhlanganiso eziphathisa uzulu ngokudla zithi izigidi ezintathu zabantu zidinga ukuphathiswa ngokudla okwamanje, besithi umnyaka usiyaphela inani leli lizaqansa liye kuzigidi ezinhlanu.

Ukuze sihlaziye udaba lokusilela kwento zokulimisa lolu, sixhume ingcwethi kwezokulima njalo elilunga ledale lephalamende elimela imangwe edaleni lephalamende uMnu Edward Mkhosi samxhumanisa ndawonye lengcwethi kwezenotho umnu Rejoyce Ngwenya. UMkhosi uthi uhulumende kazihluphi ngokudingela uzulu inhlanyelo lemvundiso laloba nje esithi ulenhlelo zokwenza lokhu.

Njengenjayelo, uSithandekile Mhlanga uxoxe labalaleli bethu abasithumele ama text messages ukuze sizwe imbono yabo ngodaba lokulima lolu. Othe simubize ngokuthi nguMnu. Michael we Njube ko Bulawayo uthi akulula ukuthola inhlanyelo yokuthumezela abazali bakhe eLupane ngoba ingatholakali ezitolo njalo lapho etholakala khona ithengiswa ngemali yakwamanye amazwe engeneliswa ngabanengi.

Omunye njalo umlaleli we studio 7 uMnu. Gordon Dube, isizalwane se Zimbabwe esihlala e South Africa utshele uSithandekile Mhlanga we studio 7 ukuthi bekukuhle ukuthi abantu bezithengele izinto zokulimisa ezitolo ngoba loba ethumele inhlanyelo ekhaya, kasoze enelise ukuthumela konke okudingakalayo ekulimiseni.

Ezinye indaba ze studio 7…

title: Bush Prays for Troops in Fallujah - 2004-11-10
content:
President Bush says U.S. troops fighting in the Iraqi city of Fallujah are battling to ensure Iraq's democratic future. President Bush says U.S. Marines in Fallujah are doing what he calls the hard work necessary for a free Iraq to emerge.

President Bush said, "There are still terrorists there who are trying to stop the march of freedom, and at the request of the Allawi government and alongside of Iraqi troops, coalition forces are now moving into Fallujah to bring to justice those who are willing to kill the innocent and those who are trying to terrorize the Iraqi people and our coalition, those who want to stop democracy, and they are not going to succeed."

The president spoke after visiting wounded American troops at a military hospital outside Washington. He said he and Mrs. Bush are praying for all U.S. soldiers in harm's way.

The president says U.S. commanders on the ground in Iraq are working with the country's transitional government to ensure that sufficient security is established throughout the country to conduct national elections as scheduled in two months time.

The ongoing operation in Fallujah is aimed at retaking the city from armed militants and ending the insurgency there ahead of January's planned vote.
summary: President Bush says US troops fighting in the Iraqi city of Fallujah are battling to ensure Iraq's democratic future

title: UMphoko Wayesithi Uhulumende Uzama Ukumbulala Ngetshefu, Khathesi Usesithi Ufuna Ukumthathela Indlu Yakhe
content:
Owake waba ngumsekeli kaMongameli weZimbabwe uMnu Phelekezela Mphoko walile ukupha umthethwandaba amaphepha endlu yakhe, ama-title deeds, ngoba esithi uhulumende ulakho ukumthathela lindlu.

UMphoko ucele umthethwandaba kamantshi ngoLwesine ukuthi umbuyisele i-passport yakhe, ukuze aye eSouth Africa ukuyahlanagana lomunye aqhuba laye ibhizimusi.

Kodwa umtshutshisi uthe nxa efuna lokho, kumele uMphoko abambise umthethwandaba ama-title deeds endlu yakhe ukuze uhulumende abe leqiniso lokuthi kajonganga ukubalekela icala lenkohlakalo aletheswayo.

Kodwa ukwalile lokhu uMphoko esithi ngcono uhulumende azihlalele le-passport yakhe.

Igqwetha likaMphoko uMnu Zibusiso Ncube utshele iStudio 7 ukuthi lanxa sokutheni uMphoko kasoze aphe umthethwandaba amaphepha endlu yakhe ngoba elakho ukuhle amthathele yona.

UMnu Mphoko, yena owayengomunye wabasekeli bakaMnu Robert Mugabe engakagenqulwa libutho, ubotshwe kunyanga ezisanga kwedlula ngecala lenkohlakalo.

Ekubotshweni kwakhe, wahamba nzima emapholisani ngoba esithi wayelolwazi olwluveza ukuthi Amapholisa ayejonge ukumhlaba ijekiseni eletshefu ambulale.
summary: Owake waba ngumsekeli kaMongameli weZimbabwe uMnu Phelekezela Mphoko walile ukupha umthethwandaba amaphepha endlu yakhe, ama-title deeds, ngoba esesaba ukuthi uhulumende ulakho ukumthathela lindlu, kutsho igqwetha lakhe.

title: Tsirony Kely Avy Amin’ny Mpanoratra Sy Ny Tononkalo Shiliana Fizarana Voalohany · Global Voices teny Malagasy
content:
(Marihina fa tamin'ny 23 Martsa 2007 no nanoratana ny lahatsoratra teny Anglisy)

Fanta-daza ho manana poety maro i Shily, anisan'izany ny Nahazo ny loka Nobel Gabriela Mistral, Amerikana Latina voalohany nahazo ny loka Nobel Prize ho an'ny Literatiora (1945) sy Pablo Neruda, iray amin'ireo poety be mpanaraka indrindra tamin'ny taonjato faha-20 (1971).

Tsy poety fotsiny ihany i Gabriela Mistral (ES), fa sady mpampianatra amin'ny sekolim-panjakana ihany koa izy no mpikatroka revolisionera ihany koa. Niasa mafy izy tamin'ny fanovana ny fomba nahatakaran'ny Shiliana ny fanabeazana. Tamin'ny taona 1922, nahazo fanasana hiasa ho an'ny governemanta Meksikana izy mba hanampiana ny fampandrosoana ny fanavaozana ny fanabeazana. Indro ny santionany tamin'ny sanganasany, avy ao amin'ny tononkalo “Rocking” (ES).

El mar sus millares de olas mece, divino. Oyendo a los mares amantes, mezo a mi niño.

El viento errabundo en la noche mece los trigos. Oyendo a los vientos amantes, mezo a mi niño.

Dios Padre sus miles de mundos mece sin ruido. Sintiendo su mano en la sombra mezo a mi niño

Ny ranomasina sy ireo onja an'arivony, ny vatolampy, toa andriamanitra. Mihaino ny ranomasin'ny mpifankatia Mandrotsirotsy ny zanako aho. Ny rivotra mitsoka amin'ny alina,

Manofahofa ny varimbazaha Mihaino ny rivotry ny mpifankatia, Mandrotsirotsy ny zanako aho.

Andriamanitra, ray ary ny tontolo an'arivony, Mandrotsirotsy tsy misy feo, Mahatsapa ny tanany ao anaty aloka Mandrotsirotsy ny zanako aho.

Mpanoratra fanta-daza Shiliana iray hafa i Isabel Allende (ES). Nahazo loka maherin'ny 20 izy tany amin'ireo firenena samihafa ary boky miisa 16, izay nadika tamin'ny fiteny miisa 10 mahery. Pablo Neruda (ES) ihany koa dia sady poeta fanta-daza no fanta-daza amin'ny fandraisany anjara tamin'ny politika.

Nanaraka taorian'izay ireo taranaka vaovao. Mba hanandramana ny tsirony dia indro misy lahatsoratra iray avy amin'i Lizia (ES) ahitana tononkalo nosoratan'i Armando Uribe (ES) antsoina hoe “No hay Lugar”, Tsy misy toerana.

“Te amo y te odio. Dirás: Cómo es posible. No sé. yo te amo y te odio […]

Lo que amo en ella no tiene edad, no ha nacido […]

No te amo, amo los celos que te tengo, son lo único tuyo que me queda, los celos y la rabia que te tengo, hidrófobo de ti me ahogo en vino. […]

No te amo, amo mis celos, esos celos son lo único tuyo que me queda. Cuando desaparezca en esos cielos de odio te ladraré porque no vienes. […]

La soledad me toma de los pies -como la muerte- y me hace entrar a un mausoleo polvoriento donde juego a las bolitas de mentira […]

Tiako ianao ary halako. Hoy ianao hoe: Ahoana no hahatonga izany. Tsy fantatro. Tiako ianao ary halako […] Ny fitiavako azy dia tsy misy taona, tsy mbola teraka […]

Tsy tia anao aho, tiako ny fialonako, ity fialonako ity dia izay hany mba navelanao ho ahy, ny fialonana sy ny hatezerana, ny tsy tia rano, mamon-divay aho […]

Tsy tia anao aho, tiako ny fialonako, io fialonana io dia izay hany mba navelanao ho ahy. Rehefa manjavona ao anatin'io lanitra feno fankahalana io aho, hovazavazaiko ianao tsy ho avy. […]

Nitondra ahy niala ny tongotro ny fahanginako -toy ny fahafatesana – ary nampiditra ahy tao anaty môzôle feno vovoka izay nilalaovako ny baolina famitahana. […]

Mpanoratra nentim-paharazana namoaka ny sanganasany tao amin'ny tranonkala ny bilaogera Shiliana toa an'i Miguel de Loyola (ES) sy Roberto Fuentes (ES). Literus (ES) ihany koa dia hetsika madinika izay manantena ny fandrisihana ny resaka momba ny literatiora sy ny tononkalo. Tantanan'ireo mpandray anjara ao amin'ny fampianarana poezia ny bilaogy ary tarihan'ilay poety Shiliana fanta-daza Raul Zurita. Namoaka ny antsafa iray [ES] niarahana tamin'i Zurita tamin'ny volana Desambra ihany koa i Paolo Astorga, poety iray hafa.
summary: Fanta-daza ho manana poety maro i Shily, anisan'izany ireo Mpandresy Nobel Prize Gabriela Mistral, Amerikana Latina voalohany nahazo ny loka Nobel ho an'ny Literatiora (1945) sy Pablo Neruda, iray amin'ireo poety be mpanaraka indrindra tamin'ny taonjato faha-20 (1971).

title: Amabhanga Asungula Uhlelo Lokukhweledisa Uzulu Imali Zokubhadalela Ischool Fees
content: Abantu makhaza sebeqalisile ukuthola izikwelede emabhanga eZimbabwe ukwenzela ukuthi bayekukhefu kumbe benelise ukubhadalela indleko yama School fees kanye lemithelo enjenge kagetsi lamanzi. Abaqondisi bamabhanga atshiyeneyo leziphathamandla zawo bathi izikwelede lezi ziphiwa abantu abasebenzayo njalo abalamabhuku okulondoloza imali kulawo mabhanga. Umuntu ngamunye ulakho ukuthola imali elingene leholo lakhe liphindwe kabili. Imali le ibhadalwa phakathi kwenyanga eziyisithupha kumbe umnyaka. Izikwelede lezi zibiselwa zibelethe umthelo ongaba yisilinganiso phose sokungamatshumi amathathu ekhulwini. Amabhanga anika lezizikwelede nganjenge Zimbabwe Banking Corporation, Commercial Bank of Zimbabwe, Metropolitian Bank kanye le Standard Chartered Bank. Umnu.
