title: U-2015 Ubone Ukuqonga Kwenani Labaphila Ngokuthengisa
content:
Umnyaka ka2015 ulethe inengi labantu ezitaladeni ukuzathengisa lizama ukuziphilisa okulitshiye ligijimisana lamakhansili athi akumelanga abantu bathengisele impahla yabo ezinkini yedolobho endaweni ezingalawulwanga, njalo bengahlawulanga, abathengisayo labo besithi indawo abazinikwa yikhansili azeneli, ezinye zikhatshana njalo lemali ehlawulwayo iphezulu kakhulu.

Abadala bathi indlala idlisa amanyala bekubonile ukuthi odubekileyo uphatha ingqamu ngasebukhalini bayo kungela ukuthi angaphephelaphi.

Le impilo yiyo esiphilwa linengi lezizalwane zeZimbabwe eseziphila ngokuthengisa ezitaladeni, inengi lingelamvumo yamakhansili okwenza kudlalwe umacatshelana njalonje.

Kukhanya lokhu kuzakuba yinsakavukela umchilo wesidwaba, izakhamizi ezithengisayo zisithi phinde zisuke ezitaladeni nanku imisebenzi iyaqhubeka iphela, amakhansili lawo afana leyakoBulawayo, etshaya phansi ngendololwane ethi akuzukuvumela abantu bethengisa bengela mvumo njalo bethengisa endaweni ezingekho emthethweni.

Lonyaka bekuyingwe lenja phakathi kwamakhansili labathengisayo, osakhulayo, othengisayo uMnumzana Emmanuel Mpofu, athi kuzaqhubeka ngomnyaka ozayo ikhansili ize iguqule imithetho yayo yokubavalela ukuthengisa.

Usekelwe ngomunye njalo othengisayo, uNkosikazi Mariya Mbiyabolawe, othi ngomnyaka ka2016 uvele akanyikinyeki, uzimisele ukubhekana lamapholisa kamanisipala, abawabiza ngokuthi ngo ‘makokoba’, kazi ukuthi impi yakhona izalanyulwa ngubani.Umeya wedolobho lakoBulawayo, uKhansila Martin Moyo, uthi bayazwisisa ukuthi inotho yelizwe kayimanga ngendlela kodwa kungumlandu wabo ukuthi balandele imithetho yedolobho esithi lingabayini nxa wonke umuntu ozwa kusitsho engayekelwa esendlala impahla yakhe yiloba kungaphi aqale ukuthengisa.

Udubo ikakhulu, uthi yilaba abangalandeli imithetho, abathengisela ezinqoleni lemakhadibhokisini bebhodabhoda bethathela labo abalamalayisensi okuthengisa, ibhizimisi.

Okhokhela inhlanganiso yabathengisayo koBulawayo, iZimbabwe Chamber of Informal Economy Association, uNkosikazi Musawenkosi Nyoni, uthi abakukhwabithi ukuhlala ezitaladeni kodwa benziwa ngumumo welizwe lokwehluleka kukahulumende ukudala imisebenzi. Uthi umeya wedolobho kanye lekhansili yakhe bayalwazi uhlupho lwabo ngoba bahlezi bekhalaza bedinga ukwengezelelwa indawo zokuthengisela kungela obatshaya indiva.

Okhangela amalungelo oluntu njalo esebenza kunhlanganiso kazulu iBulawayo Agenda, uMnumzana Mmeli Dube, uthi ikhansili kumele idele ukutshaya inja ifihla umphini ngokubambelela kumithetho yakudaladala okumele ukuthi aluba seyaguqulwa yalandela umumo wenotho elizweni.

Ukudinga ukuvalela abathengisayo khatshana kwedolobho, uthi akusoke kwasebenza, ngoba labo bafuna ukuba senzikini yedolobho lapho okulebhizimisi khona.

Udaba lwabantu abathengisayo lusuka ludidanise ingqondo ngamandla ngoba luhlezi lungenelwa njalo ngabezombusazwe.

Kuvamile ukuthi iziphathamandla ezitshiyeneyo zikhulume okwehlukileyo ngamalungelo ezakhamizi ukuthengisa ezitaladeni kuthi lalabo abathengisayo bathi bona balosekelo lwabantu abathile kuhulumende lakubandla elibusayo.

UMpofu yena uthi kazukunyikinyeka lapho athengisela khona, kungakhathalekile ukuthi ikhansili ithini, ngoba yena imvumo yokuthengisela khona wayinikwa ngumka mongameli uNkosikazi Grace Mugabe.

Yisisanasana umtshado wezinja, akwaziwa ukuthi iyozalankomoni ngaloludaba ngo 2016.

Izakhamizi lazo zilembono etshiyeneyo ngokuvunyelwa kwabantu ukuthengisa edolobheni, abanye besithi kabayekelwe abantu baselele imuli zabo, abanye kungabathi hayi bo, liyaba lidolobho bani abantu behamba beseqana lempahla ethengiswayo kungathi akulamithetho elizweni.

Lonyaka umphathintambo wogatsha lwezemali, wamisa ukuthengiswa kwempahla eyake yasebenza evela phandle kwelizwe endaweni ebesezisaziwa ngokuthi kuse’Khothama’ kodwa inengi alikulandelanga lokhu.

Abezombangazwe labo bavamile ukusebenzisa abantu lapho kuyiwa kukhetho kuthiwe hlalani lithengise kuthi soludlulile kuthiwe thuthani ngoba alilayo imvumo.

Akwaziwa ukuthi ezombusazwe lezenotho ziliphatheleni ilizwe ngo2016, kungakho akwaziwa lapho okuzawela induku loxakuxaku ngalokhu kuxabana phakathi kwabathengisayo lalabo abaphethe imithetho ngomnyaka ka2016. Ngimele iStudio Seven koBulawayo, nginguNothando Sibanda.
summary: Ukugunyulwa umsebenzi kwenze inengi labe Zimbabwe libanjwe ngamandla ukuphila ngokuthengisa ezitaladeni, lingelamvumo yamakhansili okwenze lidlale umacatshelana lamapholisa.

title: Iqula Likahulumende Lethekelela Amapulazi, Lisole Okwenzakalayo
content:
Iqula elikhethwe yinhloko kahulumende uMnu Morgan Tsvangirai ngoLwesine ukuthi liye hlolisisa okwenzakala empulazini abalimi abamhlophe liqale umsebenzi walo ngoLwesihlanu lethekelele amapulazi athize eChegutu.

Omunye wabasekeli bakaTsvangirai uMnu Arthur Mutambara nguye okhokhele leli qula. Ekhuluma lentathelizindaba kwelinye ipulazi elithunjwe ngabasekeli be Zanu PF, uMutambara usole kakhulu okwenzakalayo emapulazini amanengi wathi uhulumende kumele amise uhlelo lolu ngokuphangisa ngoba luxotsha labo abangaba belesifiso sokuncedisa iZimbabwe ukuvuselela umnotho.

Amapulazi ethekelelwe liqula likaMutambara agoqela ipulazi elithunjwe lilunga leZanu PF njalo enguMongameli wedale le Senate uNkosikazi Edna Madzongwe. Umnikazi wepulazi elihluthunwe nguNkosikazi Madzongwe uMnu Thomas Richard Etheredge uthe uMadzongwe seqede ama orange epulazini lakhe ngokuvuna lapho angalimanga khona.

UMnu Mutambara uxwayise ukuthi uhulumende engaqhubekela phambili ngohlelo lokuthumba amapulazi lolu, ulakho ukuswela abamncedisayo ngemali ukuphuma ebuncimeni abhekane labo. Abalimi beChegutu batshele iqula likaMutambara ukuthi kusukela ekuqaleni kwawonalo umnyaka, abasekeli beZanu PF sebethumbe amapulazi alitshumi lasikhombisa, 17 kulesi sigaba.

Amalunga ekomidi kaMutambara la agoqela, uMnu Giles Mutseyekwa, uMnu Kembo Mohadi, uMnu Joseph Made, uMnu Hebert Murerwa, loMnu Gorden Moyo. UMoyo utshele uNtungamili Nkomo weStudio 7 ukuthi into kazimanga kuhle emapulazini abawethekeleleyo.
summary: Okhokhela leli qula uMnu Arthur Mutambara utshele intathelizindaba kwelinye ipulazi eChegutu ukuthi uhulumende kumele emise uhlelo lolu

title: Kusungulwa Umbukiso weSanganai /Hlanganani Travel Expo eHarare
content:
Umbukiso omkhulu wezokwethekelelana owe Sanganai /Hlanganani usungule ulababukisayo abakumsebenzi wokwethekelelana abavela emazweni amanengi womhlaba ngenhloso yokusebenzelana lokubonisana ngamacebo okuthuthukisa ezokwethekelelwa kwamazwe abo.

Lumbukiso owenziwa kanye ngomnyaka ovule amasango ehwetheleni yeRainbow Towers eHarare ngoLwesine ungenwa ngabenhlanganiso kunye labamabhizimusi aphatheka kwezokwethekelelana akuleli lavela ngaphandle kwelizwe.

Ele zansi ye Africa elivame ukuphatheka ngendlela enkulu kulamanye amazwe awezwekazi le Africa libuye lengezelele indawo ye Mpumalanga okwakuqala kulumbukiso ngokutsho kuka Nkosazana Nomcebo Sibande we Mpumalanga Tourism Agency. Uthi lindawo ilezinyamazane eKruger National Park iphinde ibe lezintaba kunye lezifudlana ezinengi okungajabulisa izethekeli.

Isabelo se Limpopo sona sitshengisa amasiko abantu baso e Vembe. Unkosikazi Rudo Mucharambeyi uthi lindawo ilokunengi okuhuga izethekeli ezivela endaweni ezitshiyeneyo zelizwe lemhlabeni jikelele. Uthi ukusebenzelana ndawonye kwamabhizimusi ezansi ye Africa kulumbukiso kuzaphathisa amazwe womabiliukuba ethuthuke kwezomnotho lakumisebenzi yokuvakatshelana.

Ele Zimbabwe likhuthaza izizalwane zalo ukuba zithathe isikhathi lazo sokuhlaba ikhefu zethekelele indawo ezehlukeneyo zelizwe ngoba inengi labantu kuleli likhanya lingazihluphi ngaloludaba.

Ugatsha lokugcinwa kwembali yesizwe lubukisa amasiko akuleli kunye lokuqakatheka kukugcinwa lokulondolozwa kwezemvelo.

Lumbukiso ungenwa ngabathengi abedlula abangamatshumi atshiyangalombili kunye lababukisi abavela emazweni ahlanganisela I China, United Kingdom, Italy, France, Germany Kenya,le South Africa.
summary: Lumbukiso ovule amasango ehwetheleni yeRainbow Towers eHarare ngoLwesine ungenwa ngabakubhizimusi lezokwethekelelana aweZimbabwe lawakwamanye kwamazwe

title: 'Akusoze Kube Lokuxokozela eBeitbridge Lonyaka'
content:
Kuvamile minyaka yonke ukuthi ngesikhathi sekhefu lekhisimusi kuphithizele emngceleni weBeitbridge, izizalwane zeZimbabwe ezihlala kwele South Africa seziphindela emakhaya ukuyabonana lezihlobo labangane.

Indwendwe zivame ukuba zinde okwesabekayo kulumngcele abantu becine beqeda imihla lamalanga bemelele ukuthi badindelwe izincwadi zabo.

Kodwa lokhu kungaba yinto yayizolo lonyaka kulandela ukungenela osokwenziwe yiwofisi kaMnu Gorden Moyo, yena ongumphathintambo obona ngokwenzakala emawofisini enhloko kahulumende uMnu Morgan Tsvangirai.

UMoyo uthi wethekelele kulumngcele ngoMvulo lapho akhulumisane khona leziphathamandla zenhlangothi ezitshiyeneyo ezibona ngokuhamba kwabantu bavumelana ukuthi kususwe izigwenxa ezivame ukubangela indwendwe ezinde kulumngcele.

Silokhu sikudaba oluphathelane lezizalwane zeZimbabwe ezikwamanye amazwe, ngolweSithathu siphathe udaba lwemizamo enziwa nguhulumende, eyokudinga ukuhlawulisa abantu laba umthelo ukuze beqhubeke beyizizalwane zeZimbabwe lokuthi benelise ukuvota.

Lokhu kuphume kugwalo olwethulwe ngumphathintambo wezemali uMnu Tendai Biti ekuqaleni kweviki eLondon. Abahlala kwamanye amazwe kabavumelani ngalokhu. Kodwa bayavumelana uuthi lokhu yindlela kahulumende yokudinga imali.

Ukuhlaziya udaba lolu, sixhume ingcwethi ecubungula ezombusazwe, uMnu Brilliant Mhlanga ohlala eBritain lomkhokheli weAssociation of Zimbabweans Based Abroad uMnu Dumaphi Mema ohlala America.

UMnu Mhlanga usekela imizamo kahulumende le, kodwa uMnu Mema uyayiphikisa esithi uhulumende kumele edinge imali ngezinye indlela hatshi ngokuthi ehlawulise izizalwane zeZimbabwe ezikwamanye amazwe umthelo.
summary: Uhulumende uthi sethethe amanyathelo okwenqabela ukuxokozela okuvame ukuba khona emngceleni lo ngesikhathi sekhefu lekhisimusi

title: “Aiza No Tena Nalehan’ireo Nanjavona?” · Global Voices teny Malagasy
content:
Fihetsiketsehana noho ny antson'ny Agrupación de Familiares de Detenidos Desaparecidos [Fianakavian'ireo Vondron'olona Voafonja Nanjavona]. 2009, Santiago, Chile. Sary avy amin'i antitezo tao amin'ny Flickr (CC BY-NC-SA 2.0)

Tao anatin'ny lahatsoratra teo aloha, nitrandraka ny sasantsasany tamin'ireo tantara sy hetsika nataon'ireo fianakavian'ny olona nanjavona tao Amerika Latina izahay. Nanatona akaiky naka ireo fijoroana vavolombelona, nanala sarona ireo vanim-potoana, sy nampiditra ireo hira malaza izay mitaky ny hoe “Aiza No Tena Nalehan'ireo Nanjavona?”

Taorian'ireo fanontaniana tsy nahitàm-baliny nandritra ny ampolo taonany sy ireo tranga izay mitohy mampitombo isa ny lisitr'ireo niharam-pahavoazana, azonay lazaina, ary isaorana ny fianakavian'izy ireny, fa azo jerena ety anaty tambajotra sosialy ety amin'ny aterineto ireo olona nanjavona sy ny tantaran'izy ireny, na dia ho virtoaly ihany aza.

Hitanay, araka izany, ireo fianakaviana sy namana manao ezaka hiady mba tsy ho iray hafa isan'ny iharam-pahavoazana noho ny fanjavonana an-terisetra toy izany koa ireny fahatsiarovana ireny. Amin'ity fomba ity, ny aterineto dia manjary loharano tsy mety ritra amin'ny resaka fandraisana andraikitra sy tantara izay miady manohitra ny tsimatimanota sy ny fiverenana amin'ny lasa.

Manokana habaka izahay ao anatin'ity lahatsoratra ity ho an'ny lohahevitra ao Però, Goatemala, Orogoay ary Meksika. Tahatahaka izay ihany, Tsipihanay ihany koa ny fandraisan'ny arcoiris TV [es] anjara, izay mahatonga ho azo tsidihana ny fanadihadiana iray [es] notantanan'i Ángel Palacios mikasika ireo nanjavona an-terisetra tao Venezoela.

Ao Però, ny fifandirana eo amin'ny Fanjakana Peroviana, Sendero Luminoso (Làlankely Mazava) sy ny the MRTA (Hetsika Revolisioneran'ny Túpac Amaru) no loharano nipoiran'ireo heloka bevava izay niteraka ny fisian'ireo nanjavona an-terisetra.

Ampolo taona taorian'ny nanolorana ny Tatitry ny Kaomisionan'ny Fahamarinana sy Fampihavanana, mamoaka voka-pandinihana ny Spacio Libre [es] mikasika ireo vokatra natolotry ny fitsarana Peroviana momba ireo niharam-pahavoazana noho ny fanjavonana an-terisetra. Ao amin'ny matoan-dahatsorany, voaaro ny zon'ireo niharam-pahavoazana hahazo valiny, ary natao lisitra ireo fampanantenana tsy tanteraka izay tsy manana alàlana hanaitra ny fitsaràna Peroviana :

Muy poco se ha avanzado en materia de reparaciones y sobre todo en la búsqueda de la verdad y de un proceso sincero de reconciliación, luego de la violencia desatada por la insanía terrorista de Sendero Luminoso y el MRTA y la respuesta brutal de un Estado que no dirimió entre inocentes y culpables y mató tan igual que el enemigo que perseguía.

Y es que no se puede hablar de reconciliación, cuando un sector bastante influyente de la clase política ha pretendido silenciar y desprestigiar un trabajo realizado con ahínco, con compromiso y con un interés concreto de generar memoria y buscar un camino para recuperar la esperanza de miles de familias que perdieron a un ser querido y que en muchos casos (15 mil) no tienen ni idea de donde están.

Kely ny dingana vita raha resaka fanonerana, ary ambonin'ny zavatra rehetra, amin'ny resaka fikarohana ny marina sy hisian'ny tena fampihavanana tsy misy raorao, taorian'ny herisetra nateraky ny hadalan'ireo mpampihorohoro avy amin'ny Sendero Luminoso sy ny MRTA ary ny valinteny mitratrevatreva avy amin'ny fanjakana izay tsy manisy fanavahana eo amin'ireo tsy manan-tsiny sy ireo meloka sady mamono fotsiny tahaka iretsy fahavalo enjehany ihany.

Ary ny tena zavatra dia ireto isika tsy afaka ny hiresaka mikasika ny fampihavanana, rehefa ny sehatra manana ny lanjany eo amin'ny politika no miezaka manampim-bava sy mampihen-danja ny zava-notratrarina ao anatin'ny ezaka, miaraka aminà marimaritra sy fironana mivaingana ho amin'ny famoronana fahatsiarovana iray ary fikatsahana làlana iray hamelomana fanantenana ho an'ireo fianakaviana an'arivony izay namoy ny havan-tiany tanatinà tranga marobe (15.000), tsy manan-kevitra ny amin'izay toerana misy azy ireny.

Mbola ao Però ihany, i Renzo Salvador Aroni [es], mpahay tantara dia nanangona ireo tantara sady nandalina ny toe-javatra nitranga tamin'ireo fianakaviana izay mbola manatena hatrany hahita mangirana mikasika ireo havany nanjavona. Ao anatin'ny lahatsorany “Ny Fianakavian'ireo Nanjavona”, arovan'ilay bilaogera ny maha-zava-dehibe ny famerenana ny fahatsiarovana ara-tantaran'ny firenena ary sorìtany fa io koa dia mifaningotra amin'ny “famerenana ny fahatsiarovana ireo izay tsy eo”:

[…] La memoria de los familiares de los desaparecidos, siguen aguardando la posibilidad de que sus seres queridos aparezcan. […] Para los familiares es muy difícil aceptar un hecho aún no concluido.

[…] Ny fahatsiarovana ny havan'ireo fianakavian'ny nanjavona, mitohy mino hatrany ry zareo fa hoe, indray andro any, mbola hiseho tava ireo havan-tiany. […] Sarotra ho an'ireo fianakaviana ny hanaiky tranga iray tsy voavaha.

Manazava ihany koa ny mpanoratra ny amin'ny toerana tànan'ireo sombintsombim-pahatsiarovana eo amin'ny fiainana andavanandron'ny olona. Hazavainy fa trangam-piainana mangirifiry izy ireny ary matetika ry zareo no maneho izany amin'ny alàlan'ny fitantarana am-bava, anaty fampisehoana ara-javakanto, anaty nofinofy, ary endrika hafa enti-milaza, sady mitanisa ampahany amin'ireo fijoroana vavolombelona ataon'ny renin'ny iray amin'ireo olona tsy hita nanjavonana.

- Si lo veo, me dice: “mamá no llores por mí”.

Así me habla. Ya no lo he vuelto a ver [a mi hijo: Segundino Flores Allcaco], sólo en mis sueños. Lo veo con la misma ropa que tenía puesta.

- Raha hitako izy, hiteny amiko hoe: “Neny, aza mitomany ahy”.

Izany no fomba firesany amiko. Tsy nahita azy intsony indray aho [ny zanakolahy : Segundino Flores Allcaco], anatin'ny nofiko sisa. Hitako izy miaraka amin'ireo fitafiana nanaovany farany.

Any Goatemala, toerana izay ankalazàna isaky ny 21 Jona ny andro natokana ho an'ireo olona voafonja na tsy hita nanjavonana, ny bilaogy Comunidades de Población en Resistencia (Vondrom-piarahamonin'ireo Vahoaka anatin'ny Fanoherana) [es] dia manazava fa zavatra efa mahazatra iainana amin'izao fotoana ny fanjavonana an-terisetra ao Goatemala, izay nihanaka nankany amin'ny faritra sy mifampiankina amin'ny firaisana tsikombakomba mangina ataon'ny fanjakana:

La desaparición forzada en Guatemala no es un hecho del pasado. Es un crimen de lesa humanidad de carácter imprescriptible instaurado en América Latina, que también permanece vigente por su continua utilización como mecanismo de control social y dominio político; así como por la impunidad que persiste sobre los hechos cometidos y que hoy se expresa, entre otras cosas, en la reconfiguración de las estructuras de poder que articularon, financiaron y callaron estos crímenes.

Tsy tantara fahiny akory ny fanjavonana an-terisetra ao Goatemala. Heloka bevava atao amin'ny zanak'olombelona izany, amin'ny endriny tsy hay lazaina napetraka ao Amerika Latina, izay mbola mitoetra ho manan-kery ihany koa noho ny fampiasàna azy mitohy ho toy ny fifehezana ara-tsosialy sy rafitra politika mibahan-toerana; ary hatramin'ny hoe noho ny tsimatimanota izay midongizina mikasika ireo hetsika natao sy naseho androany, ankoatry ny zavatra hafa, amin'ny fanitsiana ny rafitry ny fahefana izay rantsa-mangaika, mamatsy sy manafina ireny heloka bevava ireny.

Ny bilaogy Familiares de Desaparecidos [Fianakavian'ireo Nanjavona] [es] koa dia mampivondrona ny fianakavian'ireo Orogoaiana tsy hita nanjavonana, izay tsy mitsahatra mikaroka sy manambara ny ezak'ireo olona monina ao Orogoay na any an-tsesitany :

Desde la apertura democrática caminamos juntos respetando la diversidad de pensamientos que nos caracteriza pero unidos en torno a nuestros principales objetivos: MEMORIA, VERDAD, JUSTICIA Y NUNCA MÁS

Hatramin'ilay fisokafana demaokratika niarahantsika rehetra nitandrozotra tanaty fanajàna ny fahasamihafàn'ny fomba fisaina izay manamarika antsika, saingy niray nanodidina ny tanjona iraisantsika: FAHATSIAROVANA, FAHAMARINANA, RARINY ARY TSY HIVERINA MANDRAKIZAY

Any Meksika, mipoaka avy amin'ny adin'ireo mpandraharaha amin'ny resaka zava-mahadomelina ny fanjavonana an-terisetra. Nanao bokikely azo entin-tànana ny kaomity Meksikana Comité Cerezo [es], nantsoiny hoe “What to do in case of forced disappearance [es]” (Inona no atao raha tratry ny fanjavonana an-terisetra), azo trohana avy ao amin'ny pejin'ny tranonkalany.

Zava-dehibe ny anampiana hoe ilay lohahevitra momba ny fanjavonana dia tsy natokana fotsiny ho an'i Amerika Latina ary tsy hoe mamorona fotsiny ny ampahany amin'ny fahatsiarovana ara-tantara. Kanefa dia goavana ny isan'ireo olona izay manjavona amin'ny fomba mampiahiahy, ary marobe ireo izay nampanginina na nihorohoro tamin'ireny heloka bevava ireny.

Noho izany, ho famintinana azy, zava-dehibe ny hanasongadinana fa ny tolon'ireo fianakaviana dia mitohy ivelan'ny aterineto. Sady koa ireny fandraisana andraikitra sy hetsika ireny dia mahita ny akony ety anaty aterineto aloha sy aorian'ny andro iraisampirenena ho fahatsiarovana an-dry zareo. Amin'io fomba io, ny media sosialy dia manampy amin'ny famelomana ireo fahatsiarovana sy mampifandray ny vondron'ireo olona ivelan'ny sisintany misy azy ireo. Ny ambohipihaonan-dry zareo: ny fitadiavam-baliny sy ny tolona iraisana hisian'ny fahamarinana.
summary: Ny aterineto dia loharano iray ahitana ireo fandraisana andraikitra sy tantara tsy hita faritra, izay  mampahatsiahy ireo nanjavona sy ny tolona hanoherana ny tsimatimanota.

title: Aleo Hanome Aingam-Panahy Anao ny Faritra Issyk-Kul Ao Kyrgyzstan
content:
Toerana fandehanan'ny mpanao vakansy hatry ny ela tao amin'ny Firaisana Sovietika taloha ny ‘maso’ manga-safiran'ny tangorombohitra Tien-Shan ao Kyrgyzstan sy ny endritany mikitoatoana manodidina azy. Ankehitriny ry zareo efa manana lahatsary fampiroboroboana mifanaraka tsara amin'izany.

title: Shina: Hanadio ny aterineto?
content:
(Lahatsoratra teny Anglisy efa tamin'ny volana Desambra 2009)

Araka ny filazan'ny Beijing News sy Mingpao androany, manomana hanadio ny aterineto manontolo noho ny filazana fa fielezan'ny pôrnôgrafia amin'ny fitaovana finday ny Ministeran'ny Indostria sy ny Teknolojian'ny Fampahalalam-baovao (MIIT).

Nilaza momba ny fivoriana vao haingana tao amin'ny MIIT ny Beijing News, namintina sy nanazava ny politika anatin'ny fepetra 5 (amin'ny dikanteny Danwei):

1. Set up a blacklist to prevent the owners of domain names found to be in violation from applying for additional domain names.

2. Tighten registration procedures to ensure that all application documents are accurate. Transfer of a domain name

3. Unregistered domain names will not be resolved:

Domestic websites are usually registered with MIIT, but because some of them were in existence before the establishment of the registration system, some websites have not registered. Many foreign domain names have not registered with MIIT. Domain-name resolution may be blocked for these websites, so access from China will be endangered. (Note: DNS hijacking of unregistered websites)

4. Suspension of DNS service to violating websites and to any other domain names in the possession of the same domain name holder.

5. Overhaul of registrars: CNNIC has already taken action against three service providers: Zhengzhou Dahuang Network Development Company, Beijing Xinnet Digital Information Technology Company, and Beijing Blinux Network Technology Company.

1. Mametraka lisitra mainty mba hanakanana ny tompon'ireo anaran-tsehatra hita fa mandika lalàna mba tsy hahazo anaran-tsehatra fanampiny.

2. Manamafy ny dingana fisoratana anarana mba hiantohana fa marina ny antontan-taratasy fangatahana rehetra. Famindrana anaran-tsehatra

3. Tsy ho voavaha ny anaran-tsehara tsy voasoratra anarana:

Matetika voasoratra anarana amin'ny MIIT ireo tranonkala eo an-toerana, saingy efa nisy talohan'ny fametrahana ny rafitra fisoratana anarana ny sasany tamin'izy ireo, ary tsy nisoratra anarana ny sasany tamin'ireo tranonkala. Maro ireo anaran-tsehatra vahiny tsy voasoratra anarana amin'ny MIIT. Mety voasakana ny famahàna anaran-tsehatra amin'ireny tranonkala ireny, ka mety hidiran-doza ny fidirana avy any Shina. (Fanamarihana: Fijirihana DNS amin'ireo tranonkala tsy voasoratra anarana)

4. Fampiatoana ny tolotra DNS ho an'ireo tranonkala mandika lalàna sy ho an'ireo anaran-tsehatra hafa manana anaran-tsehatra mitovy.

5. Fametrahana ny birao fisoratana anarana: efa nandray fepetra tamin'ireo mpanome tolotra telo ny CNNIC: Zhengzhou Dahuang Network Development Company, Beijing Xinnet Digital Information Technology Company, ary ny Beijing Blinux Network Technology Company.

Taloha, dia nikendry ireo tranonkala ampiantranoina ao amin'ny lohamilina eo an-toerana, toy ny tranonkala any ampitan-dranomasina ny rafitra fisoratana anarana tranonkala, nosakanan'ny Great Fire Wall (GFW – fanivanana aterineto) teo ambany rafitra fanivanana na fanivanana voambolana manandanja ireo tranonkala ara-politika saro-pady. Na dia izany aza, mbola afaka miditra amin'izany ireo mpiserasera amin'ny alalan'ny proxy na TOR. Raha hanadio ny aterineto manontolo ny MIIT, dia hamadika ny aterineto Shinoa ho anaty intraneto ary hanimba ny ankamaroan'ny fitaovana fandinganana izany.

Na dia izany aza, tsy mbola mazava tsara raha hiitatra any amin'ny tranonkala vahiny ny rafitra fisoratana anarana. Araka ny antontan-taratasy ofisialin'ny MIIT momba ny hetsika iadiana amin'ny fiparitahan'ny pôrnôgrafia amin'ny fitaovana finday, ny dingana voalohany (Nov-Des 2009) tamin'ny hetsika fanadiovana dia nanomboka tamin'ny fandraràna ny fisoratana anaran'ny tsirairay amin'ny anaran-tsehatra CN. Ny dingana faharoa, izay tafiditra ao anatin'izany ny voalazan'ny Beijing News (fanamafisana ny fisoratana anarana tsy misy filazalazana manokana ho an'ny tranonkala any ivelany), dia hatao eo anelanelan'ny Jan-Sep 2010. Ny dingana farany dia eo anelanelan'ny Oktobra sy Desambra 2010. Ahitana fanarahamaso feno sy fandalinana ny angon-drakitra sy ny loharanom-baovao an-tserasera ireo fepetra mba hamantarana ireo hetsika tsy ara-dalàna sy tsy mahazo fankatoavana.
summary: Araka ny filazan'ny Beijing News sy Mingpao androany, manomana hanadio ny aterineto manontolo noho ny filazana fa fielezan'ny pôrnôgrafia amin'ny fitaovana finday ny Ministeran'ny Indostria sy ny Teknolojian'ny Fampahalalam-baovao (MIIT).

title: Siyahlamuka Isigaba seMashonaland Central Phezu Kobukhokheli beZanu PF
content:
Isigaba seMashonaland Central kubandla leZanu PF sithi sifuna abasekeli bakaMongameli Mugabe bakhethwe ngamalunga aleli bandla hatshi nguMugabe.

Isigaba lesi sithi njalo omunye wabasekeli bakaMugabe kumele abe ngumuntu wesifazana.

Umgcinisihlalo weMashonaland Central uMnu Dickson Mafios utshele iphephandaba leHerald ukuthi ukukhetha abasekeli bakaMugabe kumele kube ngumlandu wezigaba zonke zebandla leli, hatshi okaMugabe.

Eminyakeni edluleyo abasekeli bakaMugabe bebekhethwa ngamalunga eZanu PF, kodwa lokhu kuguqulwe libandla leli emizameni yokwenqabela ukudlephana okukhona.

Sokulokucabangela ukuthi iziphathamandla zeMashonaland Central zilakho ukuxotshwa kuZanu PF njengabanye abagoqela uNkosikazi Joice Mujuru.

Kodwa ummeli wePelandaba-Mpopoma edale lephalamende njalo elilunga leZanu PF uMnu Joseph Tshuma utshele iStudio 7 ukuthi amalunga ebandla lakhe alelungelo lokuveza imbono yawo.

“Ibandla leZanu PF libandla elikhulu elilamalunga alembono etshiyeneyo njalo umuntu wonke uyavunyelwa ukutsho akucabangayo,” kutsho uMnu Tshuma.

“Kodwa okuslayo yikuthi intando yabanengi yiyo elandelwayo.”

title: Umgcinisihlalo WeMDC-T Owasongelana loNkosazana Thokozani Khuphe Khona Ezajeziswa
content:
Umgcinisihlalo webandla leMDC-T esigabeni seMatabeleland South, uMnu. Solani Moyo elokhu engakathoniswa libandla kucala lokuphoselana aqatha lomsekeli kamongameli webandla, unkosazana thokozani khuphe.

Iphephandaba le the Sunday Mail lithi uMoyo ubuyiselwe esikhundleni sakhe sokuba ngumgcinisihlalo wesigaba seMatabeleland South.

Kkodwa umgcinisihlalo webandla leli ilizwe jikelele, uMnu. Lovemore Moyo uthi Solani Moyo ubevele engakamiswa umsebenzi ngoba ikhomidi ethonisa amacala, eye Disciplinary Committee ayikahlali ukuthi ucubungule loludaba.

Leliphephandaba lithi lokhu kutshengisa ukuthi uTsvangirai weyise uMakhuphe kodwa lelibandla liyakulandula lokhu.

USolani Moyo ubikwa waphoselana aqatha lomakhuphe kulandela umhlangano owenziwa esigabeni sakhe esithi uMakhuphe wayengamtshelanga ukuthi uyeza.

Lokhu kwaba yisisusa sokufuthelana phakathi kwaba bili laba okwabangela ukuthi uMakhuphe alobele idale lokuthoniswa kwamacala incwadi yokukhuthaza ukuba uMoyo amiswe ukuba ngumgcinisihlalo wesigaba seMatabeleland South.

Sixoxe loMnu. Lovemore Moyo ukuze sizwe okunengi ngaloludaba.

“Engingakutsho yikuthi njengehofisi kamgcinisihlalo webandla sithole umbiko, ugwalo lulotshwe ngumsekeli kamongameli, umama uMakhuphe ukuthi umgcinisihlalo weMat South ngenxa yezizatho kade ezihlelile yena njengokubona kwakhe. Silendlela esisebenza ngayo njengenhlanganiso ikakhulu nxa kuyikuthi kulokufisa ukumisa ilunga le National Council, ugwalo lolu luyathathwa luyethulwa enkundleni ye National Executive,” kutsho uMoyo.

title: AbeMDC Alliance Bethula Ingwalo Zokusetshenziswa Kwemali, iAudit Report
content:
Abebandla leMDC Alliance bathi loba bengatholanga imali okwakumele bayithole kuhulumende, benelisile ukuqhubeka ngenhlelo zabo lokubhadalela indleko ezigoqela iholo lezisebenzi.

I MDC Alliance ithi ingwalo zabo email zihlanzekile njalo ibandla lile mali eneleyo yokusebenzisa.

Ekhuluma lentathelizindaba eHarare umgcinisikhwama weMDC Alliance, uMnu David Coltart uveze ukuba inkampani ye Auditax International yiyo eqhatshwe ukuba icubungule amabhuku ayo email, i-Auditing. Ukucutshungulwa kwamabhuku aweMDC Alliance kuza ngesikhathi kulemibiko ebisiphuma kumaphephandaba isithi inkokheli yebandla leli yantshontsha izigidi ezimbili zamadola e Zimbabwe- 2 million.

UColtart uveze ukuba inkampani le, icubungule ukusetshenziswa kwemali eyaphiwa ibandla nguhululumende lemali eyavela kumaluna ayo ngomnyaka owedluleyo ka 2019. Ethi ibandla lakhe lenze lokhu ukuze uzulu lohulumende we Zimbabwe afunde ukuba imali zikazulu kumele zisetshenziswe kakuhle.

“Sifuna ukutshengisa ukuba izinto ezinhle ziqala ngekhaya. Kumele silethe inguquko esifuna ukuyiletha kuzulu wonke. Sisenza icongress yethu eGweru kumnyaka ophelileyo savumelana ukuba sizakwenza izinto ezizenza singasolwa nguzulu”

Uqhubeke uColtart ethi lokhu abakwenzileyo kuyinto okumele ilandelwe zinhlanganiso zonke zeZimbabwe.

“Lokhu esikwenzayo kungenza engathi kuyinto encane kodwa kuyinto ezakuba nkulu hatshi kubandla leli kuphela kodwa emuntwini wonke. Siziletha kuzulu ukuba acubungulisise limali ikakhulu kumali esayithola kuzulu we Zimbabwe”

Unobhala wabatsha kuMDC Alliance uMnu Gift Ostallos Siziba uthe ibandla leli lizaqhubeka likubeka sobala ukuba lisebenzisa njani limali.

“Esikwenzileyo njenge MDC, yikuthi sense iaudit yemali esayiphiwa ngabantu, languhulumende. Lokhu sikwenzele ukuba silandele umthetho webandla lethu lokuba sense abantu basithembe”

Intathelizindaba azenelisanga ukuhlola ingwalo zemali ezeMDC Alliance kodwa uMnu Coltart uthe bazimisele ukupha intathelizindaba umbiko wengwalo zemali lezi, iAudit Report.

AbeMDC Alliance bathi kodwa badaniswa yikuba imali obekumele bayithole evela kuhulumende isisiya kubandla le MDC-T elikhokhelwa nguNkosazana Thokozani Khupe besithi lokhu akukho emthethweni.

Ngemva kokuba ibandla le MDC-T elikhokhelwa nguMaKhupe seliphiwe imvumo yokuba lilakho ukuxotsha amalunga edale lephalamende abavotelwa bekubandla le MDC Alliance, iMDC Alliance yahle yehluleka ukuthola imali efika izigidi eziyisikhombisa zamadola-7 million eyayimele ivele kuhulumende.

Ingcitshi zithi okwenziwe libandla le MDC Alliance akujayelekanga njalo kumele kube yisibonelo esihle kumabandla wonke ezombusazwe kanye lenhlanganiso ezizimeleyo.

NgoNhlolanja lonyaka kwaphuma umbiko othi abeMDC Alliance banyamalalisa izigidi ezimbili zamadola eMelika. Lumbiko ophume kuphephandaba leNewsday uphikiswe libandla leli kodwa umonakalo wawuvele usudaliwe ngoba ngemva kokuphuma kwawo kwenza ukuba labo abanceda ibandla leli bathukuthele.

INewsday yabika ukuba ukunyamalala kwemali le, yikho okwenza kube lophenyo lokudingisisa ukuba imali le ingabe yasiwa ngaphi, ibandla lahle lasungula uhlelo lokuthi kucutshungulwe ingwalo zemali emizameni yokuzihlambulula ngoba besesabela ukuthi ababancedayo ngemali bangathukuthela ngamandla, kodwa uColtart ukulandule lokhu lapho ebuzwa intathelizindaba.
summary: I MDC Alliance ithi ingwalo zalo zemail zihlanzekile njalo ilemali eneleyo yokusebenzisa ngoba zihlolwe ngabenkampani eye Auditax International edume ngokuhlola ingwalo zemali i-Auditing emhlabeni jikelele.

title: MPOI: Inhlolisiso Iveza Abanye Abantu Besithi Bayemethemba uMugabe
content:
Inengi labantu elizweni libikwa lisithi liyamethemba umongameli Robert Mugabe, isilinganiso sokungamatshumi phose amahlanu-47%, labo besithi bazimisele ukumvotela kukhetho lukamongameli laloba lungenziwa kusasa. Kodwa isimanga yikuba abanengi bathi abakhululekanga ukumchothoza, bevumelana njalo ekuthini umnotho welizwe uyaqhubeka usiba mubi.

Impumela yalenhlolisiso eyenziwe yinhlanganiso ye Mass Public Opinion Institute- MPOI, eyenziwe ngoNtulikazi lonyaka, ezigabeni zonke zelizwe, imangalise abanengi, kulokwehlukana kwemibono eveziweyo.

Ingcwethi kwezomnotho zicabangela ukuba lokhu kwehlukana kumibono, kubangelwa yikwesabela ukuhlukuluzwa, ngoba besazikhumbula izehlakalo uzulu athe wahlangana lazo eminyakeni edlule.

Umnumzana Brian Kauma ongomunye wabathatha izifundo zaphezulu ze Masters kuhlangothi lwezomnotho ekolitshini leUniversity of Zimbabwe. Lanxa imangalisa abanengi limpumela, uKauma uthi zinengi izizatho ezicatshileyo ezibangela indlela uzulu abeka ngayo imibono yaloluhlobo.

UKauma uthi akaboni isiba khona inguquko emicabangweni kazulu, ngoba labontanga beqhubeka befunda kulokho abakubona kusenziwa ngabadala, bezaqhubeka belandela indlela ezigcwele ukwesaba.

Umnumzana Vuyisile Prescious Moyo ungomunye wabacubunguli abaphatheke kulenhlolisiso, eyisifundi njalo se University of Zimbabwe. UMoyo uthi akamangaliswa yilokho kupicana kwemicabango yabantu.

Uzulu ulale imibono ngoba sewalahlekelwa lithemba kumabandla ezombusazwe aphikisayo elizweni kutsho uMoyo.

Isimanga njalo yikuba uzulu othembela kumongameli Mugabe, engazithembi inhlangothi azikhokhelayo, engazithembi ngitsho lakancane.

Lezi ngezibalisa olubona ngezokuqhutshwa kokhetho olwe Zimbabwe Election Commission – ZEC, amapholisa, olubona ngezokuhlawuliswa kwemithelo olwe Zimbabwe Revenue Authority – ZIMRA kanye lokuba isilinganiso phose sokuphakathi laphakathi, sabantu elizweni sebalahla ithemba kumabandla ezombusazwe aphikisayo.

Ingcwethi kwezomnotho lokucubungula zona ziqina ngelokuthi okuvezwe nguzulu, kubangelwa yikusilela kolwazi elizweni phezu kwezokuqhutshwa kwenhlelo zentuthuko elizweni.

Kukhanya uzulu ebeka ezinye inkokheli umlandu wokungaqhubi kuhle umsebenzi, uMugabe embona njengomuntu omsulwa kulokho kwehluleka kwazo, ophoxwa yilabo abakhethayo ukuba baqhube limisebenzi.
summary: Laloba impumela yenhlolisiso eyenziwe yinhlanganiso yeMPOI, iveza lokhu abantu babikwa belembone enje ngokumesaba kanye lokungethembi amabandla aphikisayo

title: Inkokheli yeMthwakazi Isa Udaba "Lobandlulo" ko Pick N Pay eSouth Africa
content:
Ibandla leMthwakazi Republic Party lithi selilindele impendulo evela esigodlweni sevinkili lePick and Pay kweleSouth Africa, ngemva kokunikeza abakhokheli balesi isitolo ugwalo lwezikhalazo olwe petition, olusola ukuqhatshwa kwabantu abavela kwezinye izigaba zelizwe endaweni yalabo abahlala koBulawayo.

Ugwalo lolu lubetha amagama abakhokheli bevinkili le Pick N Pay elithi balobandlululo kanye labantu besiNdebeleni ababikwa baxotshwa ukwenzela ukuthi kuqhatshwe abesiShoneni.

Imizamo yokukhulumisana leziphathamandla zePick and Pay ngaloludaba yehlule.

Ngeviki edluleyo amalunga eMRP akhokhele ukutshengisela ngensolo yokuxotshwa kwabeSindebele okithiwakwenziwa ngu manager we Pick N Pay okusekelwe yizakhamuzi zako Bulawayoezinengi kwaze kwabotshwa enye inkokheli ye MRP.

Imizamo yokukhuluma lesiphathamandla se TM Pick N Pay, uMnu. Ntini.

Okunengi ngaloludaba asikuzweni kungxoxo loMnu. Njabulo Ngwenya, unobhala obona ngobudlelwano lamanye amazwe kubandla leMthwakazi Republic Party, okuqula eliqhube ugwalo lwepetition eSouth Africa.

“Sike sakhulumisana labo siding ukuthi kube le official communication evela kubo eqondana lalwona daba basitshele ukuthi hayi balwamukele udaba lwethu basalukhangela,” kutsho uNgwenya.

Uthi babakhuthaze iziphathamandla ze Pick N Pay ukuthi zihluze loludaba ngesiphangiphangi.

Wengezelele esithi udabo lolu asilo daba oluncane ngoba luthinda indaba ezinengi zelizwe.

“Thina asizange sithi kukhethwe umhlobo othile kodwa sibona kuqatshwa abohlobo lunye kuphela,” kutsho uNgwenya.

Uthi kumele abantu basebenze ezigabeni zabo hatshi ukuyathathela imisebenzi abahlala lapho ngoba udaba lwe devolution lukhuthaza ukuthi izigaba zelizwe zizibonele.
summary: Ugwalo lolu lubetha amagama abakhokheli bevinkili le Pick N Pay elithi balobandlululo kanye labantu besiNdebeleni ababikwa baxotshwa ukwenzela ukuthi kuqhatshwe abesiShoneni.

title: Kubunjwa Elinye Njalo Ibandla Elikhankasela Uzibuse weMthwakazi
content:
Elinye njalo ibandla elikhankasela uzibuse wezigaba ezigoqela esemaNdebeleni elizibiza ngokuthi yi Mthwakazi Republic Party libunjiwe ko Bulawayo ngempelaviki edluleyo.

Okhokhela lelibandla nguMnumzana Mqondisi Moyo, obeyisiphathamandla se Mthwakazi Youth Joint Resolution, esekelwa nguNkosazana Sithabile Masina. Umgcinisihlalo walelibandla nguMnu. Zakhele Ndebele.

Ezinye inhlanganiso ezilenjongo efanayo zibalisa i-Matabeleland Liberation Organisation, ebikwa ikhokhelwa nguMnu. Paul Siwela, i- Patriotic Union of Matebeleland ekhokhelwa nguMnu. Wilson Bacinyane-Ndiweni, kanye le Matebeleland Liberation Front esebenzela kwele South Africa.

UMnu. Mqondisi Moyo uthi ibandla lakhe lizafeza injongo yalo iminyaka emibili elandelayo ingakedluli. UMoyo utshele uSithandekile Mhlanga weStudio 7 ukuthi iMthwakazi Republic Party ithi izakhulumisana lezinduna, uhulumende, amazwe atshiyeneyo, kanye lenhlanganiso ezizimeleyo emhlabeni jikelele ngenjongo yokufeza injongo yawo iminyaka emibili ingakedluli.

title: Ukugula Komsekeli Kamongameli uConstantino Chiwenga Kutshayanisa Abantu Amakhanda
content:
Abantu abanengi eZimbabwe bathi umsekeli kamongameli uRetired General Constantino usehlale isikhathi eside esibhedlela kwele China ngakho kumele amiswe umsebenzi nguMongameli Emmerson Mnangagwa.

UChiwenga wathwalelwa eChina esuka esibhedlela kwele South Africa lapho ayeselatshwa khona kulandela ukugula kwakhe okungavezwanga nguhulumende. USeleminyaka phose emibili egula.

Abantu sebekhuluma okungapheliyo ngokugula kwakhe okwambamba kakhulu ngesikhathi encedisana loMnangagwa ekususeni owayengumongameli uMnu. Robert Mugabe embusweni ngomnyaka ka2017.

Omunye wabakhuluma kakhulu ngodaba lolu nguNkosazana Sethekele Nyathi odabuka eMatabeleland North.

UMaNyathi uthi kumele uChiwenga amiswe umsebenzi ngoba usebenzisa imali enengi ehlawulwa nguzulu.

Uthi uzulu kumele avimbe ukusetshenziwa kwemali ngendlela engaqedakaliyo.

Kodwa uMnu. Malaki Nkomo okubandla leZanu PF uthi abantu kumele babekezele ngoba uChiwenga kazange adinge ukuthi agule.

Umsekeli kamongameli ukhethwa ngumongameli olamandla okumxotsha umsebenzi.

UMnu. Kucaca Phulu, omelet iNkulumane edale lephalamende ekumanyano weMDC Alliance, uthi kungeke kwasetshenziswa isisekelo sombuso ukuthi uChiwenga axotshwe umsebenzi.

Kasenelisanga ukuxoxa ngodaba lolu leziphathamandla zikahulumende. Abadala bathi sizayicela isivuthiwe.

title: Fanamby Sasany Amin’ny Fampiasana Ny Teny Tz’utujil Maya Ao Amin’ny Media Sosialy · Global Voices teny Malagasy
content:
Vaovao momba ny tetikasa nahazo vatsy avy amin'ny Rising Voices

San Juan La Laguna, Goatemala. Sary avy amin'i imsbildarkiv, voaaro amin'ny zon'ny mpamorona CC BY-NC-ND 2.0 license.

Tiako ny manasongadina ny fisian'ireo fanamby mba handrisihana olona maro kokoa amin'ny andraikitra fanoratana ny teny Maya ao amin'ny media sosialy. Ny fanapariahana manerantany ny teny Espaniola no tena fanamby goavana indrindra hoan'ireo teny indizeny sy hoan'ireo teny Maya Tz'utujil.

Mivoaka amin'ny teny manjaka (Espaniola) ny fampahalalam-baovao rehetra ary manao izany izy ireo noho ny fampiasam-bola goavana avy amin'ireo mpanao dokambarotra. Ary mety misy koa ny fikasana politika amin'ny fanaraha-maso ny vahoaka rehefa maro ny olona mampiasa teny tokana. Tsy mba manana fahafahana hivelatra ireo teny indizeny, ary misy ny fironana mankany amin'ny fihenana, maro ankehitriny ho ohatra ireo teny indizeny tsy ampiasaina intsony raha tsy ao an-trano.

Misy ny kolontsaina mampirona mankany amin'ny fanjifana hatrany eo amin'ny fanjifana ny vaovao avy amin'ny fampahalalaham-baovao, saingy tsy amin'ny tenim-piarahamonina. Tsy misy ihany koa ny ezaka hiantohana ny faharetany holovain-jafy. Raofi-pananana na henjehina ho radio “piraty” ireo loharanom-baovao goavana vitsy avy amin'ny vahoakan'i Goatemala satria nametraka lalàna manome vahana ireo orinasam-pampahalalaham-baovao lehibe ny fanjakana. Koa raha misy onjam-peom-paritra mipoitra, dia tampenam-bava haingana iny. Ny fanamby hafa dia ny rafi-pampianarana nasionaly izay manana tanjona voalohany hanangana fiarahamonina mitovy endrika ao anatin'ny firenena manankarena ara-kolontsaina sy ara-pomba amam-panao.

Hoan'ireo mpiteny Maya izay mianatra any amin'ny sekoly tsy miteny afa-tsy espaniola ihany, dia mora ho azy ireny ny mamaky izany teny izany (Espaniola) noho ny tenin'izy ireo manokana. Toa hita fa misy sakana ara-tsaina ny famakiana ny teny Maya satria vakian'ilay olona amin'ny fomba firafi-teny espaniola ilay teniny manokana.

Afaka miresaka momba ny fanavakavahana ataon'ny tena atao amin'ny teny indizeny ihany koa izahay. Tonga hatrany amin'ny ambaratonga hitsipahany ny mari-panondroana ny tenany [amin'ny teniny] ny fanavakavahana. Maro ireo manasokajy ny teny indizeny ho efa ntaolo manelingelina ny fandrosoana ankehitriny. Hitanay rehefa misy ray aman-dreny manana fiaviana indizeny Maya miteny ireo zanany amin'ny teny espaniola, fa manapaka ny fampitana ny teny Maya izany. Izany ny zava-manahirana mitoetra maharitra amin'ny teny maro.
summary: Ao San Juan La Laguna, mizara ny sasany amin'ireo fanamby atrehin'ny fiarahamonina Goatemalteka miezaka mampiroborobo ny fampiasana ny teny indizeny ao amin'ny media sosialy i Israel Quic.

title: MDC Alliance: Isimo Esibi Sezombusazwe Yiso Esibangela Umonakalo Kusimo Somnotho weZimbabwe
content:
Abebandla leMDC Alliance bathi isimo somnotho weZimbabwe sesifike esibangeni esibi kakhulu kubangelwa yikungamanga kuhle kwesimo sombusazwe ngakhoke akusoze kwaba lokuzinza elizweni nxa kungasathathwanga amanyathelo okuwulungisisa. Lokhu kuvezwe ngomunye wabasekeli bomkhokheli weMDC Alliance, umnumzana Tendai Biti emhlanganweni lentathelizindaba phezu kwesimo somnotho elizweni owenzelwe emahofisini awe SAPES TRUST, eHarare, ngoLwesibili emini.

Lanxa kuke kwaba lokuxokozela ngaphambilini kwalumhlangano kubangelwa ngabacatshangelwa ukuthi ngabasakhulayo beZanu Pf, ucine uqhubeka. UBiti utshele intathelizindaba ukuba inkinga ezibhekane lelizwe zavele zabangelwa yikungaqhutshwa kuhle kokhetho ngemva kokuhluthunelwa kukamuyi uMnu Robert Mugabe intambo zombuso, ngabebutho. "Ukuziqinisa kwabeZanu Pf lokuziqinisa kuka Mongameli Emmerson Mnangagwa, yikwenza nje kuphela lona ilizwe libhekane lobunzima obukhulu kwezomnotho. Sesifike kusibanga lesiyana ingcwethi kwezokukhulumisana bathi ngesilimaza umnini waso, into zonke sezimi mpo, kungekho okuhambayo. Sesikusibanga sokuthi akusabuyelwa emuva kungakho sizidinga lezongxoxo. Kulula kakhulu uMnangagwa amele akwenze, akhethe phezu kokuthi axoxisane loNelson Chamisa kumbe amelane lomonakalo ozakuba khona lapho uzulu esetshengisa ukukhonona kwakhe. Udubo yikuba nxa sekukuleso simo ke, kuchitheka igazi."

Ingcwethi ecubungula ezombusazwe umnumzana Mlindelwa Mancitshana uthi, " Kuyinto emgceke leyi ekhulunywa nguTendai Biti ukuthi nxa kungalungisiswanga indaba zokuqhutshwa kokhetho, ukulandelwa komthetho elizweni njalo lokukhangela amalungelo abantu ukuthi alandelwe yini, ukuvusa ilizwe leli kuzakwala kuyinto enzima. Ngoba akula phela ozalethe imali yakhe elizweni lapho abona khona ukhetho luntsontshwa, izinto ziqilwa ngendlela esegcekeni. Kutsho ukuthi lawe nxa uthe waletha imali yakho, izabuye intshontshwe futhi okusegcekeni kungela lapho ozakuya khona ngoba nanko phela lamaCourts ankhona ayabe etshengisa ukuthi alohlangothi alulandelayo. So indaba ye legitimacy iyabuyela khonaphana ukuthi ama Courts akini aqhuba njani, indlela ama Courts ethu aqhuba ngayo, yiyo esuka ibuyisele ilizwe phansi. Umthetho kawusebenzi, ilizwe leli lifile, libulewe yikungalandeli umthetho, langenkethayabetshabi yona leyo ukuthi hayi, umthetho kawusebenze uqamele icele lami kuphela." Uqhubeke ethi ngaphandle kokuba uMongameli Emmerson Mnangagwa akhulumisane lomkhokheli weMDC Alliance umnumzana Nelson Chamisa, eleZimbabwe alisoze lafa laphuma kunkinga elibhekane lazo kwezomnotho. UBiti uphinde wasola kakhulu ukuphathwa okwenziwe ukuqhamuka kwegcikwane leCovid 19 nguhulumende ongazange abambisane ngokugcweleyo labenhlangothi zonke zempilo ukuvikela uzulu nanku leli gcikwane selisidla njalo amahabula ngemva kokuthatha kwakhe inyathelo lokuvula izikolo kungela Ndlela ecacileyo yokuvikela abantwana besikolo lababalisi. Kodwa isiphathamandla sogatsha lokwethulwa kwemibiko ebandleni elibusayo eleZanu PF, uMnu. Tafadzwa Mugwadi, utshele lumsakazo ukuthi akakhulumi iqiniso uBiti ngoba umumo wezombusazwe bawulungisisa ngomnyaka ka2017 baze bakhuthaze uMugabe ukuba ehle embusweni bazoqhuba ukhetho olubalulekileyo ngomnyaka owalandelayo ka2018 lapho okwanqoba uMnangagwa ngakhoke abasoze balalela amanga kaBiti lebandla lakhe. "Leyo nkinga, isekhanda legqwetha. Umuntu oligqwetha ongaziyo ukuba vele umsebenzi wakhe yiwuphi, yikho kungamangalisi ukubona ekhuluma phezu kwendaba zezemali, umnotho, ezemithetho kanye lezombusazwe. Yikwenza komuntu ozitshelayo ukuba wazi konke kodwa akusebenzi kanjalo, kumele aphelele kundaba zakhe zokuya emithethwandaba. Indaba zomnotho lezemali zinzima kakhulu kuye. Akukho angasitshela khona ngoba umhlaba wonke kanye lozulu weZimbabwe bayazi mhlophe lapho okulenkinga khona, ukuthi itholakala khona ebandleni le MDC Alliance, yinto emgceke leyo." Kunje uthe uhulumende weZanu PF usephume lenhlelo ezinengi zokuthuthukisa umnotho welizwe, umsebenzi wokulima, ukulungisa imigwaqo lokunye okunengi nengi.

title: Tell စကားလံုး အီဒီယံအသံုးအႏႈန္း
content:
ဒီတပတ္ တင္ျပေပးမယ့္ အေမရိကန္ အီဒီယံအသံုးအႏႈန္းမ်ားမွာ tell me about it နဲ႔ tell it like it is တုိ႔ျဖစ္ၾကပါတယ္။ပထမဦးဆံုး တင္ျပေပးမယ့္ အီဒီယံအသံုးမွာ tell me about it ျဖစ္ပါတယ္။ Tell က ေျပာဆိုသည္၊ Me က မိမိကုိယ္၊ About It က အဲဒီအေၾကာင္း တုိ႔ ျဖစ္ၾကပါတယ္။ စကားစုတခုလုံးရဲ ႔ တိုက္ရိုက္အဓိပၸါယ္က အဲဒီအေၾကာင္းကုိ ငါကုိ ေျပာပါ ျဖစ္ပါတယ္။ အီဒီယံအသံုးကေတာ့ တစံုတရာေၾကာင့္ ကိုယ္မွာ စိတ္အေႏွာက္အယွက္ ျဖစ္လာရင္ ကိုယ့္ရဲ ႔ ခံစားခ်က္ကို ေဖာ္ျပရာမွာ ေျပာဆိုတဲ့ အသံုးအႏႈန္း ျဖစ္ပါတယ္။ George Crows ေပးတဲ့ ဥပမာမွာ သူက လက္ထပ္ေတာ့မယ့္ဆဲဆဲ လက္ထပ္ပြဲနဲ႔ ပတ္သက္ၿပီ စိတ္ေသာကျဖစ္စရာေတြ ျဖစ္လာတာကို ၾကားသိရတဲ့အေၾကာင္းကုိ သူ႔သူငယ္ခ်င္းက လာအေမးမွာ သူကျပန္ေျဖပံု ျဖစ္ပါတယ္။ ျပန္ေျဖရာမွာ ဒီ အီဒီယံကို အသံုးျပဳဖို႔ ရည္ရြယ္ရင္ ဘယ္လိုေလသံ ေလးေလးနက္နက္နဲ႔ ေျပာရတယ္ဆိုတာကို ဂရုစို္က္ နားေထာင္ပါ။

"Hey, tell me about it. First, Susie's wedding grown caught fire at the dress-maker. Then, my best man Tom fell and broke his ankle. I'm going crazy trying to find somebody to take his place.""ေျပာမေျပာခ်င္ပါဘူးခင္မ်ား။ ပထမဦးဆံုး ျဖစ္ပံုကေတာ့ Susie ရဲ ႔ မဂၤလာေဆာင္ဝတ္စံုက ခ်ဳပ္ေနတဲ့ဆိုင္မွာ မီးေလာင္းသြားတယ္။ အဲဒီေနာက္ က်ေနာ္သတိုးသား အရံ Tom လိမ့္က်ၿပီး ေျချခင္းဝတ္ က်ဳိးသြားတယ္။ က်ေနာ္ သူ႔အစား လူပ်ဳိးရံ ရွာဖို႔က ဦးေဏွာက္ ေျခာက္စရာ ျဖစ္ေနတယ္။"

ေနာက္အဓိပၸါယ္တမ်ဳိးနဲ႔လည္း tell me about it ကို သံုးလို႔ရပါတယ္။ ဒီေနရာမွာ သူကို တျခားတေယာက္က လာေျပာထားလို႔ ၾကားသိထားတာကို ေနာက္ထပ္ပိုသိခ်င္လို႔ ေမးျမန္းရာမွာလည္း ဒီအသံုးကို သံုးစြဲေျပာဆိုႏိုင္ပါတယ္။အခုတင္ျပေပးမယ့္ ဥပမာမွာ George Crows က လူေျပာတဲ့လူ နဲ႔ သူကို္ယ္တိုင္ သိထားၿပီး သူတို႔ႏွစ္ေယာက္စလံုး သေဘာက် ႏွစ္ၿခိဳက္မိတဲ့ အမ်ဳိးသမီးငယ္တေယာက္ဟာ သူထက္ အသက္လည္းႀကီး၊ နာမည္ပ်က္လည္း ရွိထားတဲ့ အမ်ဳိးသားတေယာက္နဲ႔ ၿငိစြန္းေနတဲ့အေၾကာင္း သူ႔မိတ္ေဆြက အံ့အားသင့္ ေျပာၾကားပံု ျဖစ္ပါတယ္။

"Yeah, tell me about it. This guy drinks, gambles, and spends money like water, but he's sure a way with women. I'm worried she ends up really getting hurt by this guy." "ေအးဗ်ာ ေျပာစမ္းပါရေစ။ ဒီေမာင္က အရက္ေသာက္တယ္၊ ေလာင္းကစားလုပ္တယ္၊ ၿပီးေတာ့ ေငြကို ေရလိုသံုးတယ္။ ဒါေပမယ့္ သူက မိန္းမေတြ အေၾကာေကာင္းေကာင္းသိတယ္။ ဒီေမာင္ေၾကာင့္ အမ်ဳိးသမီး တကယ္ဒုကၡေရာက္မွာကို က်ေနာ္စိတ္ပူပန္မိတယ္။"

ဒုတိယတင္ျပေပးမယ့္ အီဒီယံအသံုးကေတာ့ tell it like it is ျဖစ္ပါတယ္။ Tell က ေျပာသည္၊ It is က အဲဒီအတိုင္းျဖစ္လို႔ တုိ႔ျဖစ္ပါတယ္။ စကားစုတခုလံုးရဲ ႔ တိုက္ရိုက္အဓိပၸါယ္က အဲဒီအတိုင္း ေျပာျခင္း ျဖစ္ပါတယ္။ အီဒီယံအဓိပၸါယ္ကလည္း အရွိကိုအရွိအတိုင္း ပြင့္ပြင့္လင္းလင္း ေျပာဆုိျခင္း ျဖစ္ပါတယ္။ ဘယ္လိုမွ ၾကားရတဲ့လူ သက္သာေအာင္ ဖာဖာေထးေထး ေျပာဆိုျခင္း မရွိျခင္း၊ ဒဲ့ဒိုးေျပာျခင္း ျဖစ္ပါတယ္။သူ႔အေနနဲ႔ ဇနီးျဖစ္သူကို ကြားရွင္းခြင့္ ေတာင္းရတဲ့အေၾကာင္း သူ႔ခံစားခ်က္ကို ထုတ္ေဖာ္ေျပာဆိုတဲ့ ခင္ပြန္းသည္တဦးရဲ ႔ ေျပာဆိုပံုအတိုင္း George Crows ေျပာဆုိထားပံုကို ေလ့လာၾကည့္ရေအာင္ပါ။

"To tell you like it is. I think you are the most selfish person on earth. You know why you don't care about our marriage. You don't share any interest with me. All you care about is your own career.""ရွင္းရွင္းပဲေျပာပါရေစ။ မင္းဟာ ကမာၻေပၚမွာ တကိုယ္ေကာင္းအဆန္ဆံုးလူလို႔ ကိုယ္ထင္တယ္။ ဘာလို႔လဲသိလား။ မင္းဟာ ကိုယ္တို႔ အိမ္ေထာင္ေရးကို နည္းနည္းမွ ဂရုမစိုက္ဘူး။ စိတ္ဝင္စားမႈလည္း ဘာမွမရွိဘူး။ မင္းဂရုစိုက္တာကေတာ့ မင္းရဲ ႔ဘဝ တိုးတက္ေရးအတြက္ မင္းအလုပ္အကိုင္ပဲျဖစ္တယ္။"

ဒီအသံုးနဲ႔ ပတ္သက္ၿပီး ေနာက္ထပ္တင္ျပေပးမယ့္ အသံုးျပဳပံုက ႏုိင္ငံေရးအႀကံေပးပုဂၢိဳလ္ကေန သူ႔ရဲ ႔ ဆရာသမားျဖစ္သူ လႊတ္ေတာ္အမတ္နဲ႔ ပတ္သက္လို႔ လာမယ့္ေရြးေကာက္ပြဲမွာ လူထုစစ္တမ္းအျမင္ကို ေကာက္ခံခဲ့တဲ့ အေျဖမ်ားအေၾကာင္း အရွိကိုအရွိအတိုင္း ပြင့္ပြင့္လင္းလင္း ေျပာဆိုဖို႔အခ်ိန္တန္ၿပီလို႔ ယူဆတဲ့အေၾကာင္း George Crows ေပးထားတဲ့ ဥပမာျဖစ္ပါတယ္။

"Sir, you drop another 20 percent in the opinion poll. I tell it like it is. Voters are fed up with your silence on gun control and health care. If you don't say something quick, I'm afraid this time they vote you out of office.""လူႀကီးမင္းခင္မ်ား။ လူထုစစ္တမ္းေကာက္ခံရမွာ ေထာက္ခံမႈ ေနာက္ထပ္ (၂၀) ရာခိုင္ႏႈန္း က်ဆင္းသြားျပန္ၿပီ။ အရွိကိုအရွိတိုင္း ေျပာခ်င္တာကေတာ့ လူႀကီးမင္းက ေသနတ္ထိန္းခ်ဳပ္မႈအျပင္ က်န္းမာေရးျပဳစု ေစာင့္ေရွာက္မႈတို႔မွာ ႏူတ္ငံုတိတ္ဆိတ္ေနတာနဲ႔ ပတ္သက္လို႔ မဲဆႏၵရွင္ေတြက စိတ္ပ်က္ေနၾကတယ္။ တခုခုကို အျမန္မလုပ္ရင္ ဒီတႀကိမ္ ေရြးေကာက္ပြဲမွာ အရႈံးနဲ႔ေတြ႕ရလိမ့္မယ္။"
summary: မတ္ ၀၁၊ ၂၀၁၀ - ဒီတပတ္ English Learning: America Idioms and Expressions က႑မွာ တင္ျပေပးထားတဲ့ အီဒီယံအသုံးအႏႈန္းမ်ားမွာ tell me about it န

title: Odokotela Bathi Kababuyeli Emsebenzini Lanxa Besethuselwa Ngumqhatshi
content:
Sekuzinsuku ezedlula inyanga odokotela bekhalala umsebenzi besithi iholo labo alisabavumeli ukuthi benelise indleko yokuya emsebenzini. Batshilo njalo ukuthi iholo liya lisiwa isisindo laloba uhulumende ethembise ukulikhuphula ngesilinganiso esingamatshumi ayisithupha.

Odokotela bathi lokhe belethemba ukuba kuzaze kutholakale indlela engcono yokuthi bazwisisane lohulumende ukuze babuyele emsebenzini hatshi ukuba bethuselwe njengalokhu okukhulunywe ngumphathintambo wezempilakahle umnumzana Obadiah Moyo.

UDokotela Mthabisi Anele Bhebhe uthi ukuze babuyele emsebenzini kumele bazwanane lomqatshi ukuba uzabapha imali eyanelayo njalo iqansa maviki onke.

“Lamuhla lilanga lesi 35, lokhe siku incapacitation singela mali yokuya emsebenzini. Odokotela bonke eZimbabwe lathi esiko Bulawayo kasiyi emsebenzini. Lokhe simelele i ministry of health lo minister uDoctor Obadiah Moyo le Health Services Board, kuyibo abasibhadalayo ukuthi basiphe imali ezikwanileyo zokuthi siye emsebenzini. I fuel silokhu iqansa every week so asilayo imali yokuya emsebenzini, so esikumeleleyo khathesi yikuthi baqalise ukuthi sikhulume sizwanane ngokuphangisa and inkulumo zakhona kumele ziphele ngokuthi siphiwe imali ezabe iyenelisa, ikhwela ngeviki ngeviki ukuthi siye emsebenzini.”

UDokotela Tawanda Zvakada unobhala jikelele wenhlanganiso yabo dokotela uthi lokhe belethemba ukuba ngemva kokukhulumisa kabanzi lohulumende hatshi okwethuselwa kuzaze kube lempumela enhle.

“Mhlaka 3 Nkwenkwezi odokotela batsho ukuba abasenelisi ukuya emsebenzini ngoba iholo lingeneli hatshi ukuba bakhalala umsebenzi. Siyananzelela ngokudana ngamazwi akhulunywe ngu minister ngoMqibelo emini, kulusizi ngoba amazwi akhe ngeke anelise ngitsho lodokotela oyedwa, kanye labanye bonke ukubuyela emsebenzini.Lokhe sithemba ukuthi impendulo izaze itholakale ngenva kokukhulumisana kabanzi, hatshi ukwethuselwa.Kulusizi ngoba lamuhla sekukwane amalanga angamatshumi amathathu lanhlanu izibhedlela zingasebenzi kuhle.Kusobala ukuthi kumvukela okhona olethwa yikunganaki kukamqatshi ukuthi angenele masinya kulokhu.”

Umnumzana Anthony Majongosi omela abongi besibhedlela seUBH uthi akusasebenzeki ezibhedlela.

“Indaba yama doctors ukuthi aku strike, akusebenzeki kuhle. Ngoba odokotela kuyibo aba admitter ama patients njalo ebhale imithi yokuthi sinike ama patients, so akusebenzeki kuhle. Ukuthi umsebenzi wethu uhambe phambili kumele sisebenze sonke. Lathi futhi indaba yemali engasakwani,izinto azisathengeki, ukhwela every day. Siyafuna ukuthi ama doctors aphenduke emsebenzini ukuthi sisebenze kuhle siqhubekela phambili. Njalo futhi ama patients ethu asikwanisi ukubanceda ngoba ama doctors engekho.”

Omunye wezakhamuzi zakoBulawayo unkosikazi Sihle Ndlovu uthi umumo lo okhona ezibhedlela uyingozi kumpilakahle kazulu.

“Sizwa sisesaba njalo silokudana okukhulu ngomumo lo osezibhedlela. Abantu sebesithi bengagula babulawe yi stress sokuthi ngizelwatshwa ngubani odokotela bengekho. Uhulumende kumele aphange alethe impendulo ngoba ukungabi khona kukadokotela kuyingozi kumpilakahle kazulu ngoba abantu abaselatshwa ngokugcweleyo ezibhedlela. Uhulumende kabaphe imali ngoba impilo ezitshabalalayo singeke senelise ukuzithenga futhi.” Odokotela bathi abakhalalanga umsebenzi kodwa imali yiyo engabavumeliyo ukuya emsebenzini. Abenhlanganiso yabodokotela eye Zimbabwe Hospital Doctors Association bethule umbiko izolo besithi njengoba kusobala ukuthi uhulumende akazimiselaga ukulungisisa izikhalazo zabo sebekhuthaza abamankampani lozulu ukuthi bangenele ekukhulumisaneni lohulumende ukuthi kungenziwani.
summary: Odokotela bathi lokhe belethemba ukuba kuzaze kutholakale indlela engcono yokuthi bazwisisane lohulumende ukuze babuyele emsebenzini hatshi ukuba bethuselwe njengalokhu okukhulunywe ngumphathintambo wezempilakahle umnumzana Obadiah Moyo.

title: Ingayithatha Na Inkezo yePSL iChicken Inn?
content:
Iqembu leChicken Inn selikhokhela ngemiklomelo emibili kungalane yePremier Soccer League ngemva kokuba ngutshiki lobhanqa 1-1 leWhawha ngempelasonto.

Kuzinga lesibili kuleqembu leFC Platinum, lona elinqobe litshaye iCity nge2 ka nya. Leliqembu lilemiklomelo engamatshumi amahlanu lambili.

Iqembu leDynamos likuzinga lesithathu njalo lilemiklomelo engamatshumi amane lasitshiyagalombili. Lona libe ngutshiki lobhanqa 1-1 leCAPS United.

Kumidlalo yalo emithathu elisele layo iqembu leChicken Inn lizadlala leqembu leTsholotsho, lidlale njalo leHarare City, beselicina leFlame Lily.

Iqembu leFC Platinum lona lizadlala leleFlame Lily, libuye lidlale leCAPS United, kuthi emdlalweni walo wokucina lizabhuqana leDongo Sawmills.

IDynamos yona izadlala leDongo Sawmills, ibuye idlale leChapungu, ibisigqiba imidlalo yayo ngokubhuqana leBuffaloes.

Kusenjalo, iqembu leHighlanders likhuphuke layahlala kundawo yethoba munwe munye kungalaneni yemiklomelo ngemva kokunqoba iBuffaloes eBabourfields.

Ngaphansi kwengalane iqembu leTsholotsho lithuthukise amathuba alo okusinda ekugunyulweni kuLeague ngokunqoba iqembu leHwange nge 1-0.

Emidlalweni yeEnglish Premier Soccer League iqembu leManchester City lalele phezu kwengalane lanxa nje libe ngutshiki lobhanqa 0-0 leAston Villa.

Kuzinga lesibili kuleArsenal, yona ebe ngutshiki lobhanqa 1-1 leTottenham.
summary: Iqembu leChicken Inn selikhokhela ngemiklomelo emibili kungalane yePremier Soccer League ngemva kokuba ngutshiki lobhanqa 1-1 leWhawha ngempelasonto.

title: Asebeluphele Bakhalaza Ukuthi Uhulumende Abancedise
content:
Abadala abaleminyaka eyedlula amatshumi lesithipha-60 sebekhuthaze uhulumende ukuthi abanakekele ngoba bengelandlela yokuziphilsa njengoba imali yabo yempentsheni leyinye ababeyigcinile yehla isisindo ilizwe selisungule uhlelo lokusebenzisa imali yamadola eMelika.

Inkuthazo le iphume ngoLwesithathu emkhosini obuqoqwe yinhlanganiso ye Zimbabwe Older Persons Organization, o wokunanza ilanga elabekwa ngumanyano we United Nations elokuhlonipha amalungelo abantu dala eleWorld Elder Abuse Awareness Day, eledlule mhlaka 15 kuyonale inyanga kaNhlangula.

Iziphathamandla zalinhlanganiso, kanye labadala abakade bekulumkhosi bathe abantwana babo abenelisi ukubagcina njengoba labo beswela imisebenzi.

Bagcizelele ukuthi kufanele uhulumende asungule isikhwama sokubagcina njalo kungakhalazwa ukuthi bebhadale indleko zamagetsi lamanzi.

Lanxa uhulumende wabumba I Board Yokunanza asebegugile, I- Old Persons Board, uthi kalamali yokubenzela inhlelo zokuthi impilo yabo ibengcono.

Ukuze sizwe okunengi ngaloludaba, sixoxe lomlobi uMnu. Isaac Mpofu, yena ogcizelela kungxoxo ayiqhube loSithandekile Mhlanga weStudio 7 ukuthi ngempela abadala njengaye bathwele amagabha avuzayo.
summary: Lanxa uhulumende wabumba I Board Yokunanza asebegugile, I- Old Persons Board, uthi kalamali yokubenzela inhlelo zokuthi impilo yabo ibengcono.

title: ေဒၚစု ႏုိင္ငံေရးခရီး ထြက္မည္
content:
NLD အမ်ဳိးသား ဒီမိုကေရစီ အဖြဲ႕ခ်ဳပ္ ေခါင္းေဆာင္ ေဒၚေအာင္ဆန္းစုၾကည္ဟာ ႏိုင္ငံေရးကိစၥနဲ႔ ၾသဂုတ္လ ၁၄ ရက္ေန႔က်ရင္ ပဲခူးၿမိဳ႕ကို သြားဖို႔ရွိပါတယ္။ ေနအိမ္အက်ယ္ခ်ဳပ္က လြတ္ေျမာက္ခ်ိန္တည္းက ဆိုရင္ ႏိုင္ငံေရး လုပ္ငန္းေတြအတြက္ ပထမဆံုး ရန္ကုန္အျပင္ဘက္ထြက္မယ့္ ခရီးစဥ္လည္း ျဖစ္ပါတယ္။

ပဲခူးၿမိဳ႕မွာ စာၾကည္တိုက္တခု ဖြင့္ပြဲကို တက္ဖို႔နဲ႔ ပဲခူးၿမိဳ႕က NLD လူငယ္ေတြနဲ႔ ေတြ႕ဆံုဖို႔ ေန႔ခ်င္းျပန္ သြားမယ့္ခရီး ျဖစ္တယ္လို႔ NLD ေျပာခြင့္ရသူ ဦးဉာဏ္ဝင္းက တနဂၤေႏြေန႔မွာ သတင္းေထာက္ေတြကို အသိေပးခဲ့တာ ျဖစ္ပါတယ္။

တရားမဝင္ ပါတီအျဖစ္ အစိုးရက ေၾကညာထားတဲ့ NLD ပါတီ ႏိုင္ငံေရး လႈပ္ရွားမႈေတြ လုပ္တာကို သတိေပးတဲ့ အေနနဲ႔ ဥပေဒနဲ႔အညီ လိုက္နာပါ ဆိုတဲ့စာကို ပါတီေခါင္းေဆာင္ေတြဆီကို ျပည္ထဲေရး ဝန္ႀကီးဌာနက ဇြန္လကုန္ပိုင္းက ေပးပို႔ခဲ့ပါတယ္။

ဇူလုိင္လတုန္းကေတာ့ ေဒၚေအာင္ဆန္းစုၾကည္ဟာ သူ႔သားငယ္နဲ႔အတူ ပုဂံဘက္ကို ခရီးထြက္ခဲ့ပါတယ္။ အပန္းေျဖခရီး ျဖစ္တာမို႔ အစိုးရက ခရီးစဥ္ကို ခြင့္ျပဳခဲ့ေပမဲ့ အေျခအေနကို အခြင့္ေကာင္းယူၿပီး ႏိုင္ငံေရး စည္း႐ံုးလႈပ္ရွားမႈေတြ မလုပ္ဖို႔ သတိေပးခဲ့ပါတယ္။

လာမယ့္ တနဂၤေႏြေန႔က်ရင္ေတာ့ ေဒၚေအာင္ဆန္းစုၾကည္ဟာ ႏိုင္ငံေရး လႈပ္ရွားမႈ တခုအျဖစ္ ပထမဆံုး နယ္ခရီးထြက္မွာ ျဖစ္ပါတယ္။

title: Imali Yama Toll Gates Kanti Vele Iya Ngaphi?
content:
Ezinye ingcwethi zenotho zithi imali ethiwa nguhulumende yiyo esayatholakala kuntuba zomgwaqo, ama tollgates, engamadola angamatshumi amahlanu lasikhombisa, i$57 million, selokhu zaqalwa lezintuba ngomnyaka ka 2013.

Umkhokheli wogataha olubona ngemali yama toll gates, uNkosikazi Bridget Ledwaba utshele ikhomidi yedale lephalamende ukuthi kube lomehluko ekubutheleleni limali kulandela ukusetshenziswa kwemitshina yama computer.

Okhokhela ugatsha lwezokubuthelela imali yama tollgates, uMnu. Moses Juma laye uvumile ukuthi kulezigidi zamadola ezanyamalalayo ngesikhathi kungakasetshenziswa ama computer.

Sixoxe lengcwethi ecubungula ezenotho, uMnu. Masimba Kuchera utshele iStudio Seven ukuthi imali etholakalayo kayiphathisi ekulungiseni imigwaqo kumbe ukuyilondoloza.

"Nxa sikhangele imali ekhulunywayo ngibona ungani ilutshwana kakhulu nxa sikhangele inani lama toll gates elise lizweni," kutsho uKuchera.

title: Kusungulwa Uhlelo Lokusiza Izizalwane zeZimbabwe Kwele South Africa
content:
Inhlanganiso elwela amalungelo ezizalwane zeZimbabwe esezihlala kwele South Africa eyeZimbabwe Diaspora Foundation, isisungule uhlelo lokuphathisa amalunga adinga usizo lwesiphangiphangi endaweni ezitshiyeneyo kweleSouth Africa, kanti isiqalile njalo ukuqoqa imali ezasetshenziswa kuloluhlelo.

Linhlanganiso ebunjwe ngo 2015, ithi ububi besimo somnotho kwele South Africa, ukuswelakala kwemisebenzi, ukwanda kwemikhuhlane, ukwanda kwezehlakalo zokuchasana ngobuzwe, ukuqiniswa kohlelo lukahulumende lokubopha abaselizweni ngokungekho emthethweni lokunye, sekubangele ukuqonga kwenani lezizalwane zeZimbabwe ezidinga usizo lwesiphangi phangi kodwa zingalutholi.

Obona ngokuqoqwa kwenhlelo zeZimbabwe Diaspora Foundation, uNkosazana Nobalozwi Moyo, uthi bafuna ukupha usizo kuloba ngubani odabuka eZimbabwe.

“Utholukuthi kwesinye isikhathi abantu bayabotshwa abawazi amarights abo ngama documents. Recently kuke kwaba lexenophobia, abantu bayabe bedinga usizo. Abanye kwesinye isikhathi utholukuthi may be bayatshelwa zindayo lapho abahlala khona, basuke baswele la abangayahlala khona. Sifisa ukuthi uzulu wonke weZimbabwe athole ukusizakala ngesikhathi.”

Umkhokheli weZDF, uMnu. Azaria Dube Nduna, uthi uhlupho oluseZimbabwe selubangele ukuthi kugcwale izizalwane zeZimbabwe endaweni zonke zakweleSouth Africa.

“Sifuna every province yala eMzansi Africa, mayibe no province diaspora coordinator. Uzothi ma kusenzakala ingozi asheshe asazise thina, iZimbabwe Diaspora Foundation, kusuke abantu benemali zokuthi bayesiza la okwenzeke ingozi abantu bethu bangahlupheki for isikhathi eside kakhulu”

Unkosazana Moyo uthi zinengi indlela abazihlelele labo abafuna ukubambisana labo kuloluhlelo.

“Sicela ukuthi umphakathi usisize ngamadonationas like lingasisiza ngama R12 through ama SMS. And then kwabanye abantu abasebenzayo lilakho ukuthi lisisize ngama R20 every month. Silama accounts ethu eCapitec leFNB. Obusiness men bayakwazi ukuthi basixhume through iwebsite yethu.”

Kantike umnumnzana Nduna uthi benze konke okudingakalayo ukuze kungabi lamathuba okuhuquluza imali lezinye impahla abayabe beziphiwe ukuthi basize uzulu.

“I organization yethu leyi it’s registered long back. Abantu bake basibona sisiza abantu ma kuvela ingozi. Sizofuna uChief Accountant aphume emphakathini, ozobe eliphathela izimali. Sile FNB leCapitec wonke they are registered alamasignatories abantu abale i organization, ayizange yasayinwa ngumuntu oyi 1. Ukhona ozobe ebheke imali ukuthi isebenza kanjani.”

AbeZimbabwe Diaspora Foundation bathi isigaba sakuqala sohlelo lwabo lolu bakhangelele ukuhamba endaweni zonke zakweleSouth Africa behlangana labantu bebafundisa ngamalungelo abo kanye lokwethula inhlelo zenhlanganiso le emphakathini.
summary: Obona ngokuqoqwa kwenhlelo zeZimbabwe Diaspora Foundation-ZDF, uNkosazana Nobalozwi Moyo, uthi bafuna ukupha usizo kuloba ngubani odabuka eZimbabwe.

title: Woza Friday: Imbongi Njalo Engumculi uFlowSick
content:
UTinashe Rodrick Ncube waziwa ngegama lomsebenzi elithi FlowSick njalo uqale ukubhala inkondlo ngesikhathi efunda eGreenfield Primary School ko Bulawayo ngemva kokuba engene kumncintiswano owawuqoqwa yisikolo se Girls College.

"Lumncintiswano wawusiba khona minyaka yonke njalo labo ababesenza kuhle ezikolo ezehlukeneyo babesiyancintisana khona esikolo se Girls College. Mina ke ngahle ngaqala ukuthola imivuzo ngisase nguGrade 4.

UFlowSick uthe ekuphutsheni kwakhe izifundo esikolo se Milton High wasefundela ukupheka ezikolo ezibalisa eZDECO, eBulawayo Polytechnic kanye lase Pretoria kwele South Africa.

Uthole umsebenzi eHarare lapho ahlangane khona labanye bakhe babumba iqembu le 2 Sick 3 lona elilamalunga ayisithupha.

Iqembu le 2 Sick 3 liledlalade elilodwa elibizwa The 2 Sick 3 EP njalo uFlowSick uthi bekulidlalade elokuphembela ukuba bengamukelwa njani nguzulu.

"Idlalade leli silibize The 2 Sick 3 kuligama esilithethe ku code yelizwe le Zimbabwe ethi 263 kodwa thina sikuguqule kancane lokhu sizama ukukhombisa imidumo etshiyeneyo etholakala kwele Zimbabwe.

Abanye abaculi uFlowSick asebenzisane labo ekuphekeni lelidlalade ngabagoqela uEx-Mile, uSway The 3rd, uRicco Andrews kanye lo Langelihle Ndlovu njalo lelidlalade licindezelwe eSpinalong Studios esigodlweni iHarare.

Amanye amalunga eqembu le FlowSick and The 2 Sick 3 ngabalisa u BK otshaya ingungu, uStanley Stanley otshaya ikatali, uRicco otshaya ipercussion aphinde acule njalo babiza umculo wabo ngegama elithiwa yi Painted Poetry.

Imisebenzi yabo iyatholakala ebulenjini ku reverbnation laku soundcloud njalo uFlowSick uthi isifiso sabo ngesokuba baphume phandle beyetshaya kwamanye amazwe.

Baphume enkundleni ngengoma ethiwa Ngize Ngomsebenzi abayenze besebenzisana lo Langa Ndlovu.
summary: Kuliviki kuhlelo silembongi ezibiza ngegama elithi FlowSick yenake uhlanganisa inkondlo lomculo njalo ehamba ndawonye leqembu le 2 Sick 3.

title: Kambe UMfundisi Mawarire Engabe Esebenzelana LeZanu PF?
content:
Ukubotshwa kukaMfundisi Evan Mawarire owayebaleke eZimbabwe sokudale imbuzo eminengi okumangalisayo.

Abanye babuza ukuthi yindaba ephendukile kwele Zimbabwe njalo ubethembeni ekwenza lokhu.

UMawarire wasuka elizweni nyakenye ngemva kokuba icala lakhe ayeletheswa elokufuna ukugenqula umbuso kaMongameli Robert Mugabe lilahliwe.

Kodwa amapholisa asemethesa icala elifanayo engezelela ngelokuthi watshotshozela uzulu ukuthi ahlamukele uMugabe edolobheni le New York ngesikhathi umongameli ekhonale.

Abanye ngabathi uMawarire engaba esebenzelana lebandla leZanu PF ukwenzela ukuxexebula usekelo lwamabandla aphikisayo.

Ukuhlaziya loludaba sixoxe lengcwethi ecubungula ezombusazwe, uMnu. Mxolisi Ncube, njalo oyintathelizindaba, lelunga lomkhankaso we Tajamuka Sesijikile, uMnu. Gift Siziba.

USiziba uthi: "Okokuqala ngithanda ukwamukela uMawarire, okwesibili angivumelani lokubotshwa kwakhe ngoba engelacala njalo okwesithathu amacala awetheswayo angivumelani lawo."

UNcube yena uthi uyavumelana lo Siziba kokunye kodwa wathi: "UMfunidisi Mawarire wasuka esithi kasaphephile eZimbabwe kodwa khathesi usephendukeleni bona abantu ababalekeleyo belokhu besakhona. Isibindi esingaka usesithethe ngaphi?"
summary: Kulabanye abathi uMawarire engabe esebenzelana lebandla leZANU PF kubekhona njalo abamsekelayo abathi wenze kahle ukuphenduka ekhaya.

title: Umongameli Mugabe Uxolela Inkulungwane Ezimbili Zezibotshwa Emajele
content:
Umongameli Robert Mugabe, usexolele izibotshwa ezingaba zinkulungwane ezimbili-2000 ukuth zikhululwe emajele lapho ezikade ziphika inengi lazo kungabesifazana.

Leli nyathelo ulithethe esebenzisa amandla awaphiwa yisisekelo sombuso ezikhathini ezinengi kuhle kukhululwe abeZanu PF abayabe bebotshelwe ezombusazwe.

Emajele wonke aselizweni angamatshumi amane lasithupha-46, kubikwa kulezibotshwa ezizinkulungwane phose ezingamatshumi amabili-19,900 okulinani eledlula lelo elakhelwa amajele elenkulungwane ezilitshumi lasikhombisa-17 000.

Izibotshwa ezixolelweyo zibalisa abatshontsha inkomo lamanye amacala amancane nje angagoqeli ababulalayo.

Lokhu kutshiye amajele abesifazane esebethwa ngumoya kulababili kuphela abatholakala belecala lokubulala abamele ukulengiswa.

Uzulu weZimbabwe wamukele ngemibono ehlukeneyo leli nyathelo likamongameli abanye besithi leli liqinga lokuqalisa ukudinga amavoti kukhetho luka 2018. Abanye njalo besithi uhulumende ubone ukuthi akasela mali yokuthengela laba bantu ukudla yikho ebafuqele empakathini abanye babo abasengozini yokudala amanye amacala bahle babuyele ejele.

title: Kwenziwa Umhlangano Omkhulu Wenhlanganiso Ezizimele Zodwa
content:
Inhlanganiso ezizimele zodwa zithe gwaqa koBulawayo lapho ezisemhlangagweni omkhulu wokuhluza okucatshangwa kwele Zimbabwe owe Ideas Festival oqoqwe yinhlanhlaniso kazulu eyeBulawayo Agenda.

Umnu. Mmeli Dube omele umqondisi wenhlanganiso le uthi kulenhlanganiso ezedlula amatshumi ayisithupha – 60 ezizadlana ingqondo ngokwenzakalayo elizweni okunjengo kwezombusazwe, ezomnotho, inhlalakahle kazulu kanye lesimo samalungelo oluntu.

UDube uthi kuzakwenziwa imihlangano emncane eminengi yenhlanganiso lezi ezitshiyeneyo kusukela lamuhla kuze kuyefika ngoMgqibelo.

Uthi okunye okuzakwenziwa yikutshengisa uzulu imifanekiso lokunye okwehlukeneyo okwenziwa zinhlanganiso lezi nsukuzonke.

Isihloko somhlangano lo we Ideas Festival lonyaka sithi: Transformative Ideas for a Better Society.

UDube utshele uGibbs Dube weStudio 7 ukuthi bakhangelele njalo ukukhuluma ngensolo kazulu yokuthi inhlanganiso ezizimele zodwa zidlelana lamabandla ombusazwe osokutshiye abantu abanengi bengakwazi abangakwenza.

title: Venezoela: Mpisera Twitter notanana noho ny fampielezana vaovao ” manakorontana”
content:
(Marihina fa tamin'ny volana Martsa 2013 no nivoahan'ny lahatsoratra teny Anglisy)

Toa niverina nandray fepetra indray hanoherana ny fahalalahana maneho hevitra an-tserasera ny manampahefanan'ny governemanta ao Venezoela taorian'ny fahafatesan'ny filoha Venezoeliana Hugo Chávez ny volana Martsa 2013. Ny 14 Martsa 2013, notanan'ny Fitsarana Siantifika sy Sampana Fanadihadiana Heloka Bevava (CICPC, amin'ny teny Espaniola ) i Lourdes Alicia Ortega Pérez satria voalaza fa “nisandoka ny mari-panondroana an'ilay manampahefana tao amin'ny Sampan-draharaha Mahaleotena amin'ny Fisoratana Anarana sy ny Mpirakitsoratra ara-panjakana ” ary nandefa sioka noheverin'ny fitondrana fa “manakorontana ny firenena”.

Sary avy amin'ny mkhmarketing. (CC BY-2.0)

Araka ny filazan'ny El Nacional, @Ulilou no solon'anaran'i Ortega ao amin'ny Twitter ary efa mpikambana nanomboka tamin'ny 9 Jona 2009 izy. Nilaza ny gazety fa nalefa tamin'ny 8 Martsa 2013 tamin'ny 8:20 hariva ilay sioka nanfintohina, ho valin'ny fanehoan-kevitra nataon'ny mpisera @douglirodil, izay nanontany ny olona namono ny filoha Hugo Chavez. Namaly i Ortega hoe: “Tsy fantatro fa lasa saribakoly savoka izy.”

Namoaka fanambarana an-gazety tao amin'ny tranonkalany ny Ministeran'ny Atitany sy ny Fitsarana izay nanamarika fa nalain'ny polisy ny solosaina manokana an'i Ortega, “izay nandefasan'i [Ortega] tsaho tao amin'ny kaontin'ny tambajotra sosialy Twitter hanintonana [vahoaka].”

Tranga maro samihafa ahitana ny sivana an-tserasera no notaterina tao Venezoela tato anatin'ny taona vitsivitsy. Tamin'ny tranga niseho tamin'ny 2010 izay nitovy tamin'ny an'i Ortega, mpisera Twitter roa no notànan'ny polisy noho ny filazana fa “nampiely tsaho” momba ny rafitry ny banky.

Tao amin'ny tontolon'ny Twitter Venezoeliana, nanomboka nampiasa ny tenirohy #tuitdesestabilizador (#siokamanakorontana) ny mpisera aterineto mba ho fanoherana ny fitazonana an'i Ortega ary mba hanaovana vazivazy sy fanehoan-kevitra ihany koa momba ny toe-draharaha politika tao an-toerana.

Tsy misy rano ato an-tranoko. #siokamanakorontana

Mafana [tsara] i Capriles . #siokamanakorontana

Sioka iray dia efa afaka manaisotra ny fahafahanao ato amin'ity firenena demaokratika ity.

Ry vahoaka, atsaharo miaraka amin'ny tenirohy #siokamanakorontana izany satria aiza no ametrahan'izy ireo ny olona maro [raha] mampiditra antsika any am-ponja ny #CICPC ?

Nanambara ny Minisitry ny Atitany sy ny Fitsarana, Néstor Reverol, fa “hitandro ny fandriampahalemana sy ny filaminana ho amin'ny fahamarinan-toerana ao amin'ny firenena” izy ireo ary nilaza izy fa : “Ho mailo izahay, tsy hamela ny fanakorontanana izahay na dia kely aza.” Araka ny fantsom-baovaom-panjakana , VTV , nanambara ihany koa i Reverol fa hanohy “hanara-maso ny hafatra amin'ireo tambajotra sosialy izay mikasa ny hanakorontana ny firenena” ireo manampahefana.

Nanambara ihany koa ny Minisitra fa hotsaraina eo ambanin'ny Lalànan'ny Heloka An-tserasera any Venezuela i Ortega. Mety iharan'ny lalàna 2010 izay mandràra ny votoatin'ny aterineto rehetra “mampiroborobo ny korontana eo amin'ny olom-pirenena na manelingelina ny filaminam-bahoaka” ihany koa i Ortega.
summary: Ny 14 Martsa 2013, notanan'ny manampahefana Venezoeliana i Lourdes Alicia Ortega Pérez  satria voalaza fa "nisandoka ny mari-panondroan'ilay manampahefana tao amin'ny Sampan-draharaha Mahaleontena amin'ny Fisoratana Anarana sy ny Nôtera " ary nandefa hafatra tao amin'ny Twitter izay noheverina fa "manakorontana ny firenena".

title: UMugabe Uvula Okusemthethweni Idale
content:
UMongameli Robert Mugabe uvule ngokusemthethweni isigaba sesihlanu esokucina kulelidale lephalamende esikhangelelwe ukuba sizokuba ngesifitshane njengoba sokubangwa kukhetho luka 2018.

UMugabe uxwayise abaphathintambo ngokuqakatheka kokuphatheka kwabo emsebenzini wedale lephalamende.

Abammele izigaba ezehlukeneyo bamukele ngenjabulo amazwi kaMugabe wokukhuza abaphathintambo abaqholozayo, abengezi edale lephalamende lalapho kumele bazokupha ubufakazi kokwenzakala kungatsha zabo.

Amalunga alelidale ahlezi ekhala ngokuthi abaphathintambo abazihluphi ukuza edale ukuzachasisa ngeziphathelene lengatsha zabo.

Ummeli weGwanda Central, owangena nge Proportional Representation ngaphansi kwebandla le MDC-T, uNkosikazi Nomathemba Ndlovu, uthe akamangaliswa ngokwenza kukamongameli, ongazange atsho lutho, ngodaba lokulungisiswa kwemithetho elawula ngezokhetho elizweni, ukuze ihambelane lesisekelo sombuso.

Ingcwethi ecubungula ezombusazwe, uMnu. Themba Khumalo, usole ibandla eliphikisayo ele MDC-T, esithi yilo eliyekethisa lapho kumele bamfuqe ngamandla,uhulumende weZanu,ekulungisisweni kwemithetho ephathelane lezokhetho.

Usole njalo lenkulumo kaMongameli Mugabe, esithi okumqoka uzulu obekukhangelele, ukufezwa yiphalamende le, okumunyethwe yisisekelo sombuso, okubalisa udaba lokunikeza amandla ezigaba kunkokheli yazo, iDevolution akwenzakalanga.

Okunye obekukhangelelwe ukuba uMugabe, aphathe ngakho yimithetho efana lowe Public Health Act, wona osule sikhathi ukhalwa ngawo ukuba lokhe ungakaguqulwa selokhu wabunjwayo ngomnyaka ka 1924.
summary: UMugabe uxwayise abaphathintambo ngokuqakatheka kokuphatheka kwabo emsebenzini wedale lephalamende.

title: UMnu Hlalo Uphikisa Ukukhethwa KukaBanda
content:
Onqotshwe kukhetho lokudinga umgcinisihlalo weMDC-T koBulawayo uMnu Matson Hlalo secele idale leHigh Court ukuthi lesule impumela yokhetho lolu ngoba lungaqhutshwanga kakuhle.

UHlalo uphikisa ukukhethwa kukaMnu Gift Banda esithi uBanda ubengamelanga angene kulesisikhundla ngoba engakafikisi iminyaka edingakalayo elilunga lebandla ukuze enelise ukuncintisa kukhetho.

UMnu Hlalo umangalele umkhokheli webandla uMnu Morgan Tsvangirai, umgcinisihlalo webandla uMnu Lovemore Moyo laye uMnu Banda.

Udaba lolu luhluzwe ngumthethwandaba namuhla njalo umahluli uthe uzakwethula isinqumo sakhe ngoLwesine.

Kunjalo nje, Ibandla leMDC-T lithi selizilungiselele ukuqhuba umhlangano walo weCongress ekupheleni kwenyanga lapho okuzakhethwa khona abakhokheli balelibandla abatsha.

Ibandla leli ligqibe ngempelaviki edluleyo uhlelo lokukhetha abazancintisa ezikhundleni ezitshiyeneyo kuCongress eqala mhlaka 30 iphele mhlaka 1 ngenyanga ezayo.

Sixhume umsekeli kamabhalane obona ngokuqoqwa kwenhlelo zalelibandla uMnu Abednico Bhebhe.
summary: UHlalo uphikisa ukukhethwa kukaMnu Gift Banda esithi ubengamelanga angene esikhundleni lesi ngoba engakafikisi iminyaka edingakalayo elilunga ukuze enelise ukuncintisa kukhetho.

title: ယီမင္ အတိုက္အခံ ေခါင္းေဆာင္ကို ဖမ္းမိန္႔ထုတ္
content:
ယီမင္ႏိုင္ငံမွာ တနလၤာေန႔ကတည္းက အစိုးရတပ္ေတြနဲ႔ တိုက္ပြဲေတြ ျဖစ္ေနတဲ့ အတိုက္အခံ လူမ်ဳိးစု တိုင္းရင္းသားေတြရဲ႕ ေခါင္းေဆာင္ကို ဖမ္းဆီးဖို႔ ယီမင္သမၼတ အလီ အဗၺဒူလာ ဆာေလး (Ali Abdullah Saleh) က အမိန္႔ေပးထားပါတယ္။

ဟာရွစ္ဒ္ (Hashid) လူမ်ဳိးစု တိုင္းရင္းသားေတြရဲ႕ ေခါင္းေဆာင္ ရွိတ္ခ္ ဆာဒစ္က္ အယ္လ္ အာမာ (Sheikh Sadiq al-Ahmar) ကို သစၥာခံသူေတြဟာ ဆာနာ (Sana'a) ၿမိဳ႕ေတာ္မွာ ယီမင္ အစိုးရတပ္ေတြနဲ႔ တိုက္ပြဲေတြ ဆက္ျဖစ္ေနတဲ့အေလ်ာက္ မစၥတာ အယ္လ္ အာမာကို ဖမ္းဆီးဖို႔ ကာကြယ္ေရး ဝန္ႀကီးဌာနက ေၾကညာသြားတာပါ။

ယီမင္သမၼတ ဆာေလးဟာ ႏိုင္ငံကို ျပည္တြင္းစစ္ျဖစ္ေအာင္ ဖန္တီးတယ္လို႔ မစၥတာ အယ္လ္ အာမာက အယ္လ္ဂ်ာဇီးယား (Al Jazeera) ႐ုပ္ျမင္သံၾကားနဲ႔ ေမးျမန္းခန္းမွာ စြပ္စြဲသြားပါတယ္။ သမၼတ ဆာေလး ရာထူးကေန ႏႈတ္ထြက္ေပးဖို႔ တျခား အာရပ္ႏိုင္ငံေတြ ဖိအားေပးၾကပါလို႔ သူက တိုက္တြန္းသြားခဲ့ပါတယ္။

ဗုဒၶဟူးေန႔ ညပိုင္းနဲ႔ ၾကာသပေတးေန႔ အေစာပိုင္းေတြက တိုက္ပြဲေတြေၾကာင့္ လူအနည္းဆံုး ၂၄ ဦး ေသဆံုးသြားရတယ္လို႔ အစိုးရ သတင္းရပ္ကြက္နဲ႔ မ်က္ျမင္သက္ေသေတြကို ကိုးကားၿပီး အေနာက္တိုင္းက သတင္းေတြမွာ ေဖာ္ျပထားပါတယ္။

ဒီသီတင္းပတ္ အေစာပိုင္းက တုိက္ခိုက္မႈေတြေၾကာင့္လည္း စစ္သားေတြနဲ႔ တိုင္းရင္းသားေတြ အမ်ားႀကီး ေသဆံုးသြားရပါေသးတယ္။

ေနာက္သီးျခားျဖစ္ရပ္မွာေတာ့ ၿမိဳ႕ေတာ္က လက္နက္သိုေလွာင္႐ံုမွာ ေပါက္ကြဲမႈ ျဖစ္ပြားၿပီး လူ ၂၈ ဦး ေသဆံုးသြားရတယ္လို႔ ကာကြယ္ေရး ဝန္ႀကီးဌာနက ေျပာပါတယ္။ ဒါေပမဲ့ အတိုက္အခံေတြကေတာ့ အစိုးရက လူေနရပ္ကြက္ထဲကို အျပင္းအထန္ ပစ္ခတ္လို႔ လူေတြ ေသဆံုးရတာဆိုၿပီး ျငင္းေနတယ္လို႔ AP သတင္းတရပ္မွာ ေဖာ္ျပထားပါတယ္။

ၾကာသပေတးေန႔ အေစာပိုင္းကေတာ့ ဆာနာၿမိဳ႕ေတာ္မွာ လက္နက္ႀကီးေတြနဲ႔ ပစ္ခတ္သံေတြ၊ ေပါက္ကြဲသံ အက်ယ္ႀကီးေတြ ၾကားေနရတယ္လို႔ မ်က္ျမင္သက္ေသေတြက ေျပာပါတယ္။

လွ်ပ္စစ္မီးက ပ်က္တခါ လာတလွည့္ ျဖစ္ေနၿပီး အတိုက္အခံ တိုက္ခိုက္ေရး သမားေတြက အစိုးရ သတင္းဌာန ဆာဘာ (Saba) ရဲ႕ ႐ံုးခန္းေတြ အပါအဝင္ အစိုးရ အေဆာက္အဦး အမ်ားအျပားကို ထိန္းခ်ဳပ္ထားတယ္လို႔လည္း ဆိုပါတယ္။ ၿမိဳ႕ခံေတြကေတာ့ ဗုဒၶဟူးေန႔တည္းက ကားေတြနဲ႔ ထြက္ေျပးသြားခဲ့ၾကပါတယ္။
summary: ယီမင္ႏိုင္ငံမွာ အတိုက္အခံ လူမ်ဳိးစု တိုင္းရင္းသားေတြရဲ႕ ေခါင္းေဆာင္ကို ဖမ္းဆီးဖို႔ ယီမင္သမၼတ အလီ အဗၺဒူလာ ဆာေလးက အမိန္႔ေပးထားပါတယ္။

title: MDC Alliance: Abantu Bayasihlupha Befuna Ukuzwa Ukuthi Bengenzanjani Ukuthi Bangamelwa Ngamalunga eMDC-T
content:
Ibandla leMDC Alliance lithi abantu bayagcwala emahofisini alo koBulawayo kusukela kunsukwana ezedluleyo, bekhalaza ngokuthi bengenzani ukuthi amalunga ebandla leMDC-T angathathi izinkhundla zalabo abaxotshwa edale lephalamende njengalokhu osekuhlelizwe yinhlanganiso ebona ngezokuqhutshwa kokhetho eyeZimbabwe Electoral Commission, i-ZEC.

Umkhokheli weMDC-T uNkosazana Thokozani Khuphe ukhangelelwe ukuphindela ephalamende ukuba lilunga lalelidale labanye bakhe abalitshumi lane, njalo i-ZEC isithe abalesizathu sokuthi abeMDC-T bengangeni kulezi izikhundla kufanele bazise linhlanganiso kungakedluli iviki.

Ababephethe lezi izikhundla abavotelwangwa kodwa bakhethwa. Isikhulumeli seMDC-T uMnu. Khaliphani Phugeni usanda kutshela lumsakazo ukuthi engaba khona ozakhonona kuZEC akulandaba ngoba bazakhetha omunye njalo ukuthi angene kulesi isikhundla.

Ukususwa kwamanye amalunga eMDC Alliance edale lephalamende kulandela isinqumo somthethwandaba esokuthi uMnu. Nelson Chamisa kasomholi oqotho walelolbandla.

Ngalokho, uNkosazana Khuphe, osaphethe isikhundla somkhokheli weMDC-T kungakaqhutshwa umhlangano omkhulu wecongress ezakhetha umkhokheli omutsha, nguye umholi oqotho wamabandla la, ngoba womabili esuka kuMDC-T, kukanti akulabandla okuthiwa yiMDC Alliance.

Isikhulumeli seMDC-T uMnu. Khaliphani Phugeni usanda kutshela lumsakazo ukuthi engaba khona

Okunengi ngaloludaba, asikuzweni kungxoxo uSithandekile Mhlanga weStudio 7 ayiqhube loMnu. Swithern Chirowodza, ikikhulumeli seMDC Alliance koBulawayo.
summary: Ukususwa kwamanye amalunga eMDC Alliance edale lephalamende kulandela isinqumo somthethwandaba esokuthi uMnu. Nelson Chamisa kasomholi oqotho walelolbandla.

title: Banengi Abathakazelela Usuku Lwe International Women's Day
content:
NgoLwesithathu bekulusuku oluqakathekileyo empilweni yabesifazana ngoba bekunanzwa imisebenzi abayenzayo olwe International Womens’ Day.

Usuku lolu belukhangela ukuphumelela kwabo emisebenzini eyehlukeneyo.

UNkosikazi Nomsa Muleya, owaziwayo ngabanengi abamsekelayo emsebenzini wakhe wokuhlekisa abantu ngegama elithi Ms Dee, utshele iStudio 7 ukuthi njengoba ngoLwesithathu kulusuku lokuthakazela imisebenzi yabesifazana, abesilisa labo badlala indima yokusekela abesifazana ukuze labo baphumelele.

​UMs Dee uphinde wathi uyaziqhenya ngokuba ngumuntu owesifazana wakuqala okumsebenzi wokuba ngumlingisi owenza ezokugumbaqumba uzulu koBulawayo.

UNkosikazi Chealsea Mguni, omunye wesifazane ophumelela okwamagama emsebenzini wakhe wokuba ngumculi, uthe abesifazana baqakathekile kakhulu empilweni.

UMguni uphinde wavumelana lombono kaNkosikazi Muleya, esithi abesilisa balendima yokusekela abesifazane ukuze baphumelele.

Umsakazo we Studio 7 ufisela bonke abesifazana usuku oluhle olulenjabulo olwe International Woman’s Day. Ukuze lani lisitshele imibono yenu mayelana ngokuqakatheka kwabesifazana siyalinxusa kuhlelo lwethu olwe The Women’s Round Table/Asiyihluzeni Bomama lapho elizabe lilo Marvellous Mhlanga lo Praxedes Jeremiah, ngoLwesine.
summary: Abantu abanengi abagoqela abaculi bananze usuku lwe International Women's Day oluqakathiswa ngumhlaba wonke jikelele.

title: IMDC Yalelwa Ukwenza Umhlangano Wokumhlangabeza uTsvangirai Elizweni
content:

title: Lugqitshwa Kulensolo Uhlelo LweVoter Registration
content:
Uhlelo lokubhaliswa kwabantu abalelungelo lokuvota olweMobile Voter Registration lugqitshwe ngeSonto inengi likhonona ngokuthi aluqhutshwanga kuhle njalo kumele luqhubeke.

Ikomishini ebona ngezokhetho, Zimbabwe Electoral Commission ithi ayenelisanga ukufinenyelela zonke izigaba zelizwe ngezizatho ezehlukeneyo ezigoqela ukusilela kwemali.

Umthetho uthi nxa uMongameli Robert Mugabe sesayine isisekelo sombuso esitsha saba ngumthetho opheleleyo, kumele iZEC iqhube olunye njalo uhlelo lokubhalisa abantu.

Isikhulumeli seMDC uMnu Nhlanhla Dube uthi nxa solusenziwa njalo loluhlelo, kumele uhulumende elungiselele ngokugcweleyo kubhaliswe bonke abafisa ukubhalisa.

Amazwi kaDube agcizelelwe yisikhulumeli seZanu PF, uMnu Rugare Gumbo.
